izzyondroid:com.htetznaing.adbotg.name: ADB⚡OTG
izzyondroid:com.htetznaing.adbotg.summary: Run ADB commands without a computer (no ROOT needed)
izzyondroid:com.htetznaing.adbotg.description:
You can use ADB commands by connecting your Android smartphone to your smartphone.
 You can use it simply by installing the app without rooting or additional process.
 When developing, we usually install *.apk files using adb install . As Android system itself is based on Linux, can we use an Android phone to perform adb install for another phone?
 OTG allows our android mobile phone to act as a PC-like host, which can be connected to other devices (such as keyboard, mouse, USB flash drive), of course, can also be connected to other Android mobile phones, most mobile phones support this technology.
 That done, you cannot only use adb install to install apps on the other device, but run other ADB commands as well – as you would do from your computer.

fdroid:bilalsul.rzr.name: RZR
fdroid:bilalsul.rzr.summary: Beautifully made mobile code and markdown reader.
fdroid:bilalsul.rzr.description:
RZR is a mobile code reader for reading git projects in a code editor. Download source code from GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket in owner/repo format and read it on the go.
 Features 
 Download GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket repos as zip with the in-app Zip Manager plugin.
 Read source code in the Monaco editor with support for 100+ programming languages. Customizable with plugins.
 In-app folder/file tree browser for managing extracted zip projects once enabled.
 Read-only code editor with Monaco syntax highlighting (via WebView).
 Instant Markdown preview for README files and .md files once enabled.
 Rich settings for managing file explorer and editor options (word wrap, minimap, line numbers, zoom) through the Plugins system.
 Supports English and 13 other languages.
 The app uses the INTERNET permission to download repository archives. No tracking or analytics.
 How to Use 
 Download any repository as .zip from GitHub, GitLab, etc.
 Open Repo Zip Reader (RZR) 
 Tap Import Project → select your .zip file
 Wait for extraction (progress shown for large projects)
 Browse, search, and read code offline!
 Read the RZR user guide here 
 Help us translate the app to your language and check local strings here .

fdroid:com.ventoid.app.name: Ventoid
fdroid:com.ventoid.app.summary: Prepare Ventoy-style bootable USB drives from Android without root.
fdroid:com.ventoid.app.description:
Ventoid is an Android utility for preparing Ventoy-style USB drives directly from a phone.
It is built for users who want a clean, open-source path to writing a multi-ISO boot USB without using a desktop app for every change.
What Ventoid does:
- Detects supported USB mass-storage devices connected over OTG
- Requests Android USB permission only when needed
- Writes a Ventoy-compatible MBR or GPT layout
- Writes the Ventoy boot core and EFI image, including the x86_64 Secure Boot chain
- Formats the main data partition as exFAT
- Shows a concise install status and progress bar
Why it is useful:
- No root required
- No ads
- No account
- No analytics
- No cloud dependency
Important:
- Ventoid writes directly to the selected USB drive, so choosing the correct target device matters
- A working OTG adapter or powered hub is required for actual USB writing
- Device compatibility can vary depending on the phone, cable, USB bridge, and flash drive controller
Ventoid is intended for advanced users, repair kits, travel setups, and people who want a portable boot-media workflow from Android.

fdroid:dev.mateusznowak.demodulate.name: Demodulate
fdroid:dev.mateusznowak.demodulate.description:
Demodulate is a no-frills radio app, powered by React Native. There’s a search box and local stations list (based on data from radio-browser.info), favorites and history, and the minimal player UI. That’s it.
Demodulate has a simple yet beautiful user interface based on Material 3. The UI has large elements to make it easy to use on the go or in a car, even in the split-screen mode.
Demodulate can reliably do things many other apps can’t. It will show current track info, play in the background, handle headset buttons, restore playback after a call, and recover from many types of network failures.
Demodulate will cache favorites and history info and switch between available server instances automatically. You can send your playback history if you’d like to make the local station list better for everyone, or if you just want to get updated stream URLs.

Texts and Scripts:

Features:
• Folio / Paged Mushaf View: Centred IndoPak paged layout with waqaf symbols, surah headers, and bismillah markers
• Verse-by-verse Card View: Read Arabic, translation, and transliteration side by side with customisable visibility

JustQuran is completely free and open source (MIT licence). It contains no advertisements, no subscriptions, no user tracking, and requires no account.

fdroid:org.openttd.fdroid.description:
NOTE: This is a fork of https://github.com/pelya/openttd-android since development there is on hold currently.
OpenTTD is an open source reimplementation of the Microprose game Transport Tycoon Deluxe (TTD). As president of a start-up transportation company in (typically) 1950, you have a choice of building rail, road, air and maritime transportation routes to build up your transportation empire. Outsmart your competition by beating them to attractive passenger and commodities routes to become the game's highest-ranking transport company by the year 2050.
OpenTTD is based on Chris Sawyer's Transport Tycoon Deluxe and introduces a whole set of new features, including multiplayer support, better stations and vehicles, larger maps and a host of other options. 
Posting a full list of features would be futile as it would mean updating this page almost daily, and even then some things might be forgotten. Play with the game to experience all the features yourself, or take a look at the Manual for a more thorough listing and explanation of the features and possibilities available.

* Scroll the map with two fingers, when you are building roads or stations.
* Close dialogs by dragging them to the screen edge.

 Key Features:

• Bank Integration & Reconciliation : Connect directly to supported banks via FinTS or reconcile transactions manually against your bank statements for pixel-perfect balance tracking.

• Web Interface for Desktop : Access and manage your transactions from any web browser on your local network.

 Permissions Transparency:

A username and a password are enough. No phone number, no email, no SMS code. You get recovery codes instead — keep them, and only you can get back in.
ENCRYPTED END TO END
Messages, photos, video, voice messages, video circles and files of any size are encrypted on your device and decrypted on your friend's. The server holds ciphertext and cannot read it.
If encryption is not up in a chat yet, Zollo explains why and asks before anything goes out in the clear. It never happens silently.
THE SERVER FORGETS
Messages, media and the call log are deleted from the server after 7 days, and the retention period can be set per chat. What stays on your own device is up to you.
ENCRYPTED CALLS
Audio and video calls are end-to-end encrypted and go device to device whenever possible. The call screen shows when the connection is encrypted and verified.
EVERYTHING A MESSENGER SHOULD DO
• Voice messages and video circles
• Photos, video and files of any size
• Reactions, replies, forwarding, editing, delete for everyone
• Pinned messages, scheduled messages, read receipts
• Stickers, themes and chat wallpapers
GROUPS AND CHANNELS
Group chats with admins, join requests and bans. Channels where only the owner and admins post, with a public address for links and search.
STORIES, POSTS AND LIVE
Share a story, publish a post, follow people and channels — in the same app, next to your chats. Go live, see who is watching, let viewers ask to join. Post captions translate with one tap.
ON EVERY SCREEN YOU OWN
iPhone, iPad and Mac. Every device has its own keys and the same conversation. The list of linked devices is always visible — revoke anything you do not recognise.
PRIVACY CONTROLS
Private account, blocking, hidden from search.
FREE, WITH AN OPTIONAL PREMIUM
Zollo is free and shows ads. Premium removes them completely.
Zollo Premium is an auto-renewable subscription that removes ads.

fedora-packages:kefir/kefir.description: an implementation of C17 language compiler from scratch. No existing open source compiler infrastructure is being reused. The main priority is self-sufficiency of the project, compatibility with platform ABI and compliance with C17 language standard. Any omissions or incompatibilities between the language standard and Kefir behavior which are not explicitly documented (see Implementation & Usage quirks section below) shall be considered bugs. Kefir supports modern x86-64 Linux, FreeBSD, OpenBSD and NetBSD environments (see Supported environments section below). Compiler is also able to produce JSON streams containing program representation on various stages of compilation (tokens, AST, IR), as well as printing source code in preprocessed form. The compiler targets GNU As (Intel syntax with/without prefixes and ATT syntax are supported) and Yasm assemblers. Kefir is able to produce debug information in DWARF5 format for GNU As. Position-independent code generation is supported. Kefir features cc-compatible command line interface.

fedora-packages:lua-luautf8/lua-luautf8.description: This module adds UTF-8 support to Lua. It uses data extracted from the [Unicode Character Database](http://www.unicode.org/reports/tr44/), and is tested on Lua 5.2.3, Lua 5.3.0 and LuaJIT. parseucd.lua is a pure Lua script to generate unidata.h, to support conversion of characters and to check the category of a characters. It is compatible with Lua's own string module, and it passes all string and pattern matching tests in the lua test suite. It also add some useful routines for UTF-8 features, including: - a convenient interface to escape Unicode sequences in string. - string insert/remove, since UTF-8 substring extract may expensive. - calculating the Unicode width, which can be useful when implementing a console emulator. - an interface to translate Unicode offset and byte offset.

firefox-addons:2935148.name: Input Translator: AI Translate While Typing
firefox-addons:2935148.summary: Translate text inside any input box in place. Press Space 3× or Alt+T on Discord, Slack & email — free Google/Microsoft or AI.
firefox-addons:2935148.description:
Input Translator lets you translate text directly inside any input field without switching tabs or copy-pasting. Type in your native language, trigger translation in place, and send your message instantly.
POPULAR USE CASES
• Chat fluently on Discord, Slack, Telegram Web, and WhatsApp Web
• Write emails in Gmail and Outlook without jumping to a translator tab
• Post and reply on X (Twitter), Reddit, LinkedIn, and YouTube comments
• Open GitHub issues, pull requests, and code reviews in English or any target language
THREE EFFORTLESS TRIGGERS
• Triple Space — Press Space 3 times at the end of your text to translate immediately
• Keyboard Shortcut — Press Alt+T (customizable in your browser's shortcut settings)
• Context Menu — Right-click inside any input box and choose "Translate Text"
FLEXIBLE TRANSLATION ENGINES
• Free by Default — Works out of the box with Google Translate and Microsoft Translator, zero setup required
• AI Translation with Imp Credits — Connect an Imp account for pay-as-you-go AI translation with no API key management or monthly subscription
• Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) — Configure your own OpenAI API key or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (OpenRouter, DeepSeek, etc.) for natural, context-aware translations
KEY FEATURES
• In-Place Replacement — Translates and replaces text directly inside standard inputs, textareas, and rich text editors
• Auto-Detect Source Language — Automatically detects what you typed and translates to your chosen target language
• Lightweight & Open Source — Clean UI with automatic Light & Dark mode, GPL-3.0 licensed on GitHub
PRIVACY
• No personal data collection or browsing history tracking
• API keys stay stored locally in your browser
• Text is only sent to the translation engine you configure when you explicitly trigger translation
Source code: https://github.com/rxliuli/input-translator 
Support & Community: https://discord.gg/gFhKUthc88

bluejetty:00165251:android.description:
Chargeback is your all-in-one solution for managing subscriptions, organizing bills, and optimizing your budget. Acting as a subscription manager, bill organizer, and budgeting app, Chargeback offers everything you need to take control of your finances and track spending effortlessly.
Chargeback provides a powerful subscription tracker to monitor and manage recurring payments. With an intuitive dashboard, you can organize all your subscriptions, unsubscribe from unused services, and cancel subscriptions in just a few steps to avoid unnecessary costs. By tracking each recurring expense, you gain clarity on where your money goes, making it easier to plan your financial future.
As a bill tracker, Chargeback simplifies the process of tracking payment due dates. Use its bill calendar to ensure no payment is missed and set reminders for upcoming expenses. Whether you’re dealing with monthly utilities, streaming services, or other recurring payments, Chargeback’s bill organizer has you covered. This feature keeps your financial obligations on track and eliminates the stress of forgotten bills.
Chargeback goes beyond simple tracking by acting as a budget planner that provides actionable insights. Its robust budget tracker helps you monitor your spending and keep your savings on course. With detailed analytics, Chargeback gives you a clear view of your income, expenses, and overall financial health. It's a finance tracker, allowing you to stay on top of your goals and make smarter financial decisions.
For those focused on building their financial stability, Chargeback also functions as a savings app and money manager. Use the savings tracker to help you focus on saving money and reducing expenses. Whether you need to cut back on unused services, adjust your spending habits, or allocate funds for future plans, Chargeback provides the tools to guide you every step of the way.
The app’s payment tracker makes managing recurring expenses by organizing them in one convenient location. It also acts as a monthly budget planner, helping you allocate funds to different categories and optimize your spending patterns. Chargeback’s intuitive design makes it easy to track monthly expenses while planning for savings and other priorities.
With its unsubscribe me functionality, Chargeback makes it simple to cancel subscriptions and stop wasting money on services you no longer need. Easily manage your recurring payments with its subscription manager, ensuring your spending aligns with your financial goals. This feature is useful for streamlining subscriptions across multiple merchants, making it a valuable tool for managing personal or shared finances.
Chargeback is ideal for users seeking an all-in-one solution for financial clarity. Its features cater to individuals, families, and professionals looking to manage bills, optimize spending, and focus on saving money. By integrating tools for budgeting, money management, and subscription tracking, Chargeback ensures your finances are always under control.
Use Chargeback as your go-to app for tracking bills, managing recurring payments, and maintaining a structured monthly budget planner. With detailed insights into your financial habits, you’ll discover opportunities to save, improve your money budget, and plan for long-term goals. The app’s versatile functionality supports all aspects of financial management, from monitoring income to reducing unnecessary costs.
From organizing subscriptions to tracking bills and optimizing your budget, Chargeback provides all-in-one money management. A budget tracker, savings tracker, and bill tracker. Chargeback helps you take charge of your personal finances and achieve greater financial stability. Whether you’re educing monthly expenses, building savings, or managing shared costs, Chargeback has the features you need to streamline your financial life.

bluejetty:00069061:ios.description:
Space crisis! The most notorious fugitives in space are acting recklessly! Purple Pink and other space policemen need your help! As the caption and commanding officer of Papo Town Spaceship, you should lead your super fleet to fight with the criminals, defeat them and maintain the peace and stability of the universe! 
Welcome on board captain! In Papo Town: Spaceship, you could fully explore every room of the spaceship! The scenes include the cockpit, laboratory, the maintenance cabin, bedroom and dining room! Feel free to visit each and every scene, and you could find all the hidden surprises and play mini games!
In order to fight with the criminals, you should go to different planets to recruit new staff and upgrade your spaceship! Complete the missions to earn space coins for recruitment and upgrade. Try to finish as many missions as possible to catch the bad guys and also to improve your battle experience! 
Great news! We are going to launch a new app Papo Town: World! It contains all the fun places and locations like home, school, amusement park, playground, police office and fire department! Please stay tuned! 
Play and learn with Purple Pink!
【Features】
 Catch the space villains!
 Recruit new staff and upgrade spaceship!
 More than one hundred interactive items!
 5 scenes of the spaceship for exploration!
 Designed for children!
 No rules, more fun!
 Explore creativity and imagination
 Looking for surprises and discover hidden tricks!
 No Wi-Fi needed. It can be played anywhere!
This version of Papo Town Spaceship is free to download. Unlock more rooms through in-app purchase. Once complete the purchase, it will be permanently unlocked and bound with your account. 
If there are any questions during the purchase and playing, feel free to contact us via contact@papoworld.com
[About Papo World]
Papo World aims to create a relaxed, harmonious and enjoyable game play environment to stimulate children's curiosity and interest in learning. 
Focused on games and supplemented by fun animated episodes, our preschool digital educational products are tailored for children. 
Through experiential and immersive gameplay, kids could develop healthy living habits and arise curiosity and creativity. Discover and inspire talents of every child!

bluejetty:00078432:ios.description:
Welcome to Mindblow: Guess the Word! Experience a word-guessing game like no other, where every image cleverly hides a word. Unlike other games, this game isn’t just a mix of stock images, but we've carefully created each level’s image to challenge your brain! Discover the word through a concept creatively depicted in each picture.
A New Kind of Puzzle: Forget what you know about word quiz games. In Mindblow: Guess the Word, each image has a special word for you to guess. It’s not just about looking at the picture, but understanding the clever idea behind it.
Can you guess the word implied in the picture?
- See a worm in a book? The word is "bookworm."
- A brick dressed as a superhero, running fast? Say hello to "breakfast."
Unique and Eye-Catching: Our images are unlike anything you’ve seen before. They’re not just pretty; they make you think and smile when you guess the word right.
Fun for Everyone: Mindblow: Guess the Word is great for kids, adults, and even your grandparents. Play with friends or family and share the fun of cracking these clever puzzles.
Challenges for All: From easy peasy to brain-busters, we’ve got levels for every player. Earn coins for right guesses and use them for hints when stuck.
Always Fresh: Keep Mindblow: Guess the Word handy on your device. New levels are added to Mindblow every month, so there’s always something fresh to enjoy.
More Languages Coming Soon: We’re working on making Mindblow: Guess the Word available in many languages. Get ready for a global word-guessing party!
With Mindblow: Guess the Word, start your journey of amazing pictures and satisfying word discoveries. Are you up for the challenge?

bluejetty:00035545:ios.description:
Welcome to Oxycise!
Join us for zero-impact workouts for any age or fitness level, in as little as 15 minutes a day using the power of oxygen. Get a complete aerobic workout while keeping joints, bones, knees, and back safely. These at-home workouts are doable, yet effective for anyone - whether you're a beginner or a fitness expert - whether you have 5 pounds to lose or over 100.
You will learn a very powerful breathing system, combined with flexing and contracting all your major muscle groups, that anyone can do — no matter your age, size, shape, or fitness level. This powerful diaphragmatic breathing technique increases cell oxygenation throughout the entire body and thereby weight loss.
With your membership, enjoy unlimited access to our growing library of zero-impact, oxygen-powered workouts, including effective chair workouts, challenging core balances, buns & thigh burners, and relaxing stretches. Work out in the comfort of your home, or wherever you like!
FEATURING:
• full-body workouts in only 17 minutes a day
• targeted workouts
• senior exercises
• barre fitness
• flexibility focused
• workouts for the office
• seated/chair workouts
• workouts you can do in bed (yes, really)
• even a workout you can do in your car!
No equipment is needed, but feel free to add weights for extra strengthening and toning. Each workout combines the proven Oxycise! breathing technique with stretching and strengthening exercises to safely and effectively reduce stress, increase energy, and transform your body.
You can download workouts for offline viewing on mobile devices, save your favorites for easy access, or filter by your favorite instructor. Easily beam videos from your device to Chromecast or AirPlay-enabled devices.
Plus, join us in our private Facebook group for extra support - ask questions, engage in polls, share your success, and make some oxy-friends!
Oxycise! gives you everything you need to lose weight and keep it off for life. Safely and effectively transform your body with the proven Oxycise! breathing technique.
MEMBERSHIP & FREE TRIAL:
-Already a Member? Sign-In to access your subscription.
-New? Subscribe and get an all-access free trial. You can cancel anytime.

Step into the thrilling underworld with Gangster Prison Escape Game! 💰 Experience the most authentic 3D open-world action game where you become a true gangster, trapped in the city's most notorious prison. ⛓️ Ultimate Prison Break Experience:
Master the art of prison escape by planning your moves, outsmarting guards, and finding hidden pathways. Survive the harsh realities of a realistic prison life simulator, where you'll manage resources, forge alliances, and navigate complex inmate relationships. Every decision matters in this intense jailbreak game as you strive to secure your freedom and achieve the grand escape!

Experience real gangster simulator action, from high-speed police chases to intense street fighting and gun battles.

Develop your Gangster character by leveling up skills, mastering criminal trades, and customizing your look to fit your gangster life style. Immerse yourself in a gripping action adventure game with a rich storyline and challenging missions. Experience fast-paced fighting game mechanics and strategic combat encounters against rival gangs and corrupt police forces. This simulation game allows you to make choices that truly shape your destiny in the criminal underworld.

Witness breathtaking visuals with 3D game graphics that bring the gangster city and prison environments to life. Enjoy realistic physics and dynamic camera angles during every action-packed mission and high-speed chase.

Download Gangster Prison Escape Game today and carve your legacy as an underworld legend! 🚀 Get ready for the ultimate gangster escape adventure! 🎉

Aeroski workouts are designed for all fitness levels, allowing you to improve your strength and endurance without adding impact on your joints. TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
Seeing is believing. Set your goals and track your progress as you keep enjoying the most fun cardio machine for a total body workout.
NUTRITION GUIDE
Our 28-day Meal Plan was created by a certified nutritionist, to make healthy eating simple and part of your everyday life.

· 100% unlimited cashback on public transportation + earn ₩100 mileage on every ride! Earn up to ₩5,000 every month and enjoy discount benefits when you take a SWING.
· Get ₩10,000 in SWING Taxi coupons + 10% off every ride!
· SWING+ Essential Membership benefits included!
[NEW] From daily trips to further travels, earn 5% benefits each time you rent with SWING Rental Car!
· Move farther with SWING! Enjoy expanded movement with a rental car.
· Earn 5% guaranteed each time you rent! Enjoy discount benefits when you take a SWING.
· 4 million members’ choice, SWING – now with rental cars.
[HOT] The SWING Taxi friend invite event is on! You and your friends earn ₩5,000!
· If you take a SWING Taxi and invite a friend, your friend gets a discount and you earn points!
· Share your invite link with a first-time SWING Taxi rider. When your friend takes their first ride, they get 50% off, you get ₩5,000!
· Earn ₩5,000 extra for each new friend invited! Invite more friends and earn infinite points.
[Recommended] 700k users' choice, Korea's lowest-price mobility membership, SWING+
· SWING+ Basic (₩4,900/mo): 10-minute scooter and e-bike rides just ₩1,000! Affordable riding without limits, recommended for those who take short rides often.
· SWING+ Essential (₩5,900/mo): The membership with all the benefits of movement on SWING! Recommended for cost-savvy riders.
· Unlimited free unlocks on scooters & e-bikes
· 10% off every SWING Taxi ride
· 1 hour free on regular bikes daily
· ₩5,000 off the Swap Subscription every month
· Ride 3 times a month and get guaranteed benefits!
[Recommended] Take a SWING&deer on our 170,000 devices you can find easily, everywhere!
· The largest scale in Korea, 90,000 e-scooters: With more devices than any other app, you only need to find a SWING.
· 30,000 e-bikes you can ride without a license + 10,000 eco-friendly regular bikes
· Find hidden discounted devices! You can take a device in a reported no-parking zone 100% free. Help tidy our streets with free rides.
· On foreigner-friendly SWING, foreigners can join with social account login!
· Overseas-issued cards can be used on SWING no problem.
[Required Permissions]
· Device & App Records: Used to check app version and improve usability
· Location: Used to find nearby devices and check live locations
[Optional Permissions]
· Bluetooth: Used to connect and control IoT devices wirelessly
· Camera: Used to scan device QR codes and take return photos
· Notifications: Used to notify of discounted devices nearby, taxi arrival, etc.
· Contacts: Used in point sharing and gifting events
· Microphone: Used to connect with the driver when using taxi services
[Usage Inquiries]
· Homepage: SWING MOBILITY 
· Inquiries/Suggestions: hello@theswing.co.kr

bluejetty:00087264:ios.description:
Step into “Idle Super Mall” and embark on your idle mall adventure! Here, every store is a new world waiting for you to discover and create. From glittering jewelry stores to aromatic coffee shops, from high-end clothing boutiques to unique ballet dance experience stores, your mall will become synonymous with fashion.
Game Features:
Diverse Shops: Manage a variety of stores, including clothing shops, coffee shops, jewelry stores, lounges, hat shops, shoe stores, cinemas, and more.
Fashion Transformations: Assist customers in choosing the perfect outfit, from clothes to shoes, making them shine on the runway.
Personalized Experience: Offer customers a personalized shopping experience, including vending machines, photo booths, and more.
Game Highlights:
Strategic Layout: Skillfully arrange the mall’s layout to attract more customers and enhance their shopping experience.
Fashion Runway: Host runway shows to display the latest trends and become a fashion trendsetter.
Creative Design: Freely mix and match stores to create your unique mall.
Gameplay:
Easy Management: Simple idle gameplay lets you effortlessly manage your own mall.
Fashion Upgrades: Unlock more fashion elements through upgrades, making your mall even more distinctive.
Customer Satisfaction: Meet customers’ needs and provide the best shopping experience.
Are you ready to take on the challenge? Join “Idle Super Mall” and become a leader in the fashion mall industry, making your mall the brightest star in the city!

• the garage door is left open
• the dog walker or cat sitter arrives
* There's flooding or a water leak in your basement
• Your children open your medicine or liquor cabinets
• Someone changes your thermostat settings
• Your security system is disarmed (And who disarmed it)
• Someone attempts to log into your account
• And more!

bluejetty:00128077:ios.description:
WINNER of the 2020 XYZZY Awards (Best Game)
The elders have entrusted you, an elite vampire courier, to deliver their secrets. Can you outrun the hunters, the other drivers, and the rising sun?
"Vampire: The Masquerade — Night Road" is an interactive horror novel by Kyle Marquis, based on "Vampire: The Masquerade" and set in the World of Darkness shared story universe. Your choices control the story. It's entirely text-based—without graphics or sound effects—and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination. It won the "Best Game" award in the 2020 XYZZY Awards for interactive fiction.
It’s a new Dark Age for the dead. When the Second Inquisition's vampire hunters hacked phone lines and computer networks to expose and destroy vampires all over the world, the elders turned to undead couriers like you. For ten years, you’ve raced across the desert between cities, delivering vital information and supplies. But when an old friend reappears with a plan to disrupt the blood trade across the American Southwest, everything you’ve built starts crashing down.
Outrun the Competition. Drive, hide, or fight back! Unleash the powers of your blood in ancient Disciplines to change form, vanish from sight, or dominate the minds of your enemies. Employ blood magic, inhuman strength, and the creatures of the night to escape destruction—or just run your enemies off the road and keep going.
Deliver or Die. All secrets have an expiration date—and so do you. Race across the desert to deliver secrets, promises, and threats. Do whatever it takes to drop off your parcel. But when the job is done, will you stick around to exploit the situation?
Run Down Your Prey. Only blood can sate the Hunger. Charm, seduce, or seize what you need, but don’t let anyone know what you are. If you break the Masquerade, your fellow vampires will destroy you for your indiscretions, assuming the Second Inquisition doesn't find you first.
• Winner of the 2020 XYZZY Awards for interactive fiction (Best Game)
• Play as male, female, or nonbinary.
• Hunt the alleys and back roads of the American Southwest to stave off hunger and resist the frenzied call of the Beast.
• Join the Camarilla—the immortal society of the vampire elite—or break its hold on the border states.
• Confront the horrors of your immortal existence in illegal hospitals, disease-ridden prison camps, and forgotten research facilities littered with failed experiments.
• Modify your car for speed, durability, or smuggling, but remember—wherever you're going, you have to get there by dawn!
Death is a hard road. You drive it every night.

bluejetty:00076108:ios.description:
With this biometric passport photo app, you can format, print, or save passport photos in seconds.
It comes with passport photo templates for 100 countries. As well as passport photos, this app is ideal for printing photos for job applications. More than ten popular formats for job application photos have also been predefined.
This app can store, print, or email multiple passport photos on photo paper. The resulting images can be printed directly, or ordered later (not from the app) from the photo lab of your choice on the Internet.
To produce the passport photos, a photo can be taken from the camera or loaded from the album. The next step is to adjust the picture by multi-touch gestures with your fingers (position, zoom and rotation). After that, the saturation, brightness, and contrast can be corrected.
Photo paper (cm): 9x13, 10x13, 10x15, 11x15, 13x18, single image (selected size)
Photo paper (inch): 3½x5¼, 4x5¼, 4x6, 4½x6, 5x7, single image (selected size)
This app supports printing on an AirPrint-compatible printer. The print size can be adjusted in the app if needed. The passport photo will be automatically printed slightly larger in order to facilitate cutting it out.
The app already provides passport photo templates for the following countries:
Albania, Algeria, Argentina, Armenia, Australia, Austria, Azerbaijan, Bahamas, Bangladesh, Belarus, Belgium, Bolivia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Brazil, Bulgaria, Cambodia, Cameroon, Canada, Chile, China, Colombia, Croatia, Cuba, Cyprus, Czech Republic, Denmark, Dominican Republic, Ecuador, Egypt, El Salvador, European Union, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Guatemala, Honduras, Hong Kong, Hungary, Iceland, India, Indonesia, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Jamaica, Japan, Kazakhstan, Kenya, Kyrgyzstan, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Macedonia, Malaysia, Mexico, Moldova, Mongolia, Morocco, Myanmar, Netherlands, New Zealand, Nicaragua, Nigeria, Norway, Pakistan, Panama, Papua New Guinea, Paraguay, Peru, Philippines, Poland, Portugal, Qatar, Romania, Russia, Spain, Saudi Arabia, Serbia, Singapore, Slovakia, Slovenia, South Africa, South Korea, Spain, Sri Lanka, Sudan, Sweden, Switzerland, Taiwan, Thailand, Turkey, Turkmenistan, Uganda, Ukraine, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom, United States, Uruguay, Uzbekistan, Venezuela, Vietnam
We do not accept any liability for the correctness, accuracy, or up-to-dateness of the passport photo templates. Please check that the templates are suitable for you before using them. You should also find out about passport photo regulations from the relevant authorities. In particular, make sure that the shot you take is correct and meets the current regulations.

bluejetty:00071428:ios.name: Jaguar Route Planner
bluejetty:00071428:ios.summary: To be used in conjunction with Jaguar vehicles which are fitted with the next-generation infotainment system, InControl Touch Pro, the Jaguar Route Planner App allows you to navigate from door to door. Before setting out from your home, set
bluejetty:00071428:ios.description:
To be used in conjunction with Jaguar vehicles which are fitted with the next-generation infotainment system, InControl Touch Pro, the Jaguar Route Planner App allows you to navigate from door to door. Before setting out from your home, set your destination from your smartphone and you’ll be directed to your Jaguar as the app detects your vehicle's location. The smartphone app will then automatically sync with your Jaguar's navigation system using the Cloud so your car will be ready to take over navigating soon after you get in. Once you've finished your in-car journey, navigation is then handed back to your smartphone, which provides any final public transport and pedestrian directions to your final destination.
In addition the Route Planner app also allows you to pre-plan trips and holidays by searching for places of interest or restaurants and saving them as favourites from your smartphone. You will then be able to access these saved locations from the in-car navigation system at a later date. 
Note:
• Requires InControl Navigation Account to sign-in. Account can be registered from either your Jaguar’s navigation settings or jaguar.here.com.
• As we systematically introduce InControl, specific features, options and its availability remain market dependent. This app requires that your vehicle be fitted with its relevant connectivity package as well as a Micro SIM card with a suitable data contract. 
Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00089658:ios.description:
With mobile ticketing and trip planning, the MyDART app is your all-in-one tool for taking transit in Greater Des Moines.
Buy your bus pass in the MyDART app and start using it on your schedule. DART offers one-way, day, 7-day and 31-day passes for use on all services. When ready to board the bus, activate the mobile ticket you want to use and show your phone to the bus operator to pay fare. If you are a Paratransit or Half Fare customer, contact Customer Service at 515-283-8100 to add those tickets to your MyDART account.
Use the MyDART app to plan a trip and access real-time arrival of buses. Enter your starting point and ending destinations for trip options that best fit your schedule. Use the Next DART Bus feature to get the real-time arrival of buses and view a map of DART bus stops near your location.

bluejetty:00035922:ios.name: Monster Sandbox Playground 3D
bluejetty:00035922:ios.summary:
Welcome to sandbox game. It is a playground with creative where you can customize your world. Embark on an exciting journey with fun and amazing monsters, diving into a world full of mysteries and possibilities.
Explore Incredible Worlds:
bluejetty:00035922:ios.description:
Welcome to sandbox game. It is a playground with creative where you can customize your world. Embark on an exciting journey with fun and amazing monsters, diving into a world full of mysteries and possibilities.
Explore Incredible Worlds:
Immerse yourself in amazing locations filled with diverse landscapes and unique creatures. From green meadows to fiery wastelands - each world brings new adventures and secrets of simulator games. Explore vast expanses, discover mysterious dungeons and build your corner in this diverse world.
Control the Monsters:
Become the master of monsters! You have the unique opportunity to control various characters - from cute and funny to powerful and frightening. Each monster has its own unique abilities, adding a strategic element to your gaming experience. Summon monsters into battle, use sanbox, create teams, and apply your skills to overcome all challenges.
Create and Build:
Build your perfect home, castle, or even a city. Use various blocks and materials to bring your creative ideas. The possibilities are enormous: create bridges, build dungeons, fly in a helicopter, or float in a hot air balloon. Your imagination is the only limit. Expand your adventure with a variety of user-generated content, including new monsters and exciting gameplay features.
Journey to the Skies:
Soar in the high clouds on your own aircraft. Develop your flying skills, explore islands, search for treasures, and uncover new, previously unexplored areas. Discover endless horizons and make your world even more amazing.
Battles and Quests:
Engage in thrilling battles with other monsters, showcase your skills, and become a monster legend of simulator games. Take part in exciting quests, unravel mysteries, explore dark corners and battle bosses to achieve fame and wealth.
Play with monsters
Spawn monsters and create, fight, and explore together. Work together to overcome challenges and share your creative discoveries. Create your own rules and adventures to make the gameplay even more engaging.
Evolve and Improve:
Gain experience and level up, unlocking new opportunities and abilities for your monsters. Upgrade your equipment, enhance skills, and become a true hero of this amazing world.
This game is a place where your imagination becomes reality. Are you ready for endless adventures and creative inspiration? Download the game now and immerse yourself in the fascinating world and let your imagination run wild as you customize your gameplay to match your preferences.

【Features】
・Adorable characters enjoyable for children of young ages.
・Easy to start
bluejetty:00145565:ios.description:
Santorini Island, the beautiful blue and white town spread out on the Aegean Sea.
Can you escape from this town, which is riddled with puzzles and items?
【Features】
・Adorable characters enjoyable for children of young ages.
・Easy to start for first players. Let’s challenge!
・There are Hints, so Don’t worry!
・Auto-save function!
・No need for paper and pen! Swipe left from the right edge of the screen to take notes!
【How to play】
Very easy operation method!
・Search by tapping the screen.
・Change the viewpoint by tapping the button on the bottom of the screen.
・Double tap the item button, it will enlarged.
・Use an item by dragging it.
・While one item is displayed, select another item by either tapping or dragging it to combine them.
・There is a hint button from MENU which is the upper left corner of the screen.
【Jammsworks】

Designer：Naruma Saito

Our goal is to produce a game that would be fun for the users.

bluejetty:00066449:ios.description:
Voetbal.nl is hét platform voor amateurvoetballend Nederland. Dus voor spelers, scheidsrechters, trainers en coaches, maar natuurlijk ook voor ouders en andere supporters van het amateurvoetbal.
Op een leuke manier je voetbalactiviteiten bijhouden:
• Programma, standen en uitslagen van jouw teams
• Persoonlijke- en teamstatistieken
• Volg de teams en clubs van je vrienden en familie
• Volg andere spelers en blijf op de hoogte van hun resultaten 
• Direct op de hoogte van afgelastingen
• Video’s en foto's van jouw teams toevoegen en bekijken
• Laat vooraf weten of je aanwezig bent bij de wedstrijd
• Geef aan of je een auto voor de uitwedstrijd beschikbaar stelt
Ook zijn doelpunten, kaarten en wissels nu zichtbaar binnen de Voetbal.nl app. Deze kunnen binnen de KNVB Wedstrijdzaken app toegevoegd worden aan een wedstrijd.
Iedereen kan gebruik maken van de Voetbal.nl app, maak hiervoor een nieuw account aan binnen de app. Ben je lid van een voetbalvereniging, zorg dan dat je inlogt met het e-mailadres dat bekend is bij je club.

bluejetty:00041655:ios.description:
By chance, you accidentally traveled to 1987, and learned that you were a rural child who was adopted by the wrong adoptive parents and wanted to marry an old man in the mountains for your biological daughter. After returning home and learning that her adoptive parents were so heartless and unjust, she taught them and their biological daughter a lesson, and then embarked on a journey to her fiancé Zhou's home.
After arriving at Zhou's house, she discovered that there were two children at home. She actually wanted to be a stepmother? But the man is not an old man as he said, but a handsome guy, and you even have a love rival!
You will play Lin Xingchen in the game and advance the development of the game plot through puzzle solving and dialogue. From just entering the Zhou family to becoming the hostess of the Zhou family, you will face the ruthless adoptive parents and the mean Mrs. Wang at home. , a man’s childhood sweetheart, the difficulties you encounter need to be solved one by one through your wisdom. It’s up to you what the future will be like after time travel!

bluejetty:00077682:ios.description:
Rebtel helps more than 2 million users to stay connected to their loved ones. With high-quality international calls and instant top-ups, we are the bridge between you and those who matter the most. Rebtel app makes your life easier by:
- Finding the best deals for you.
- Giving you the best available rates.
- Offering instant recharges and calling abroad services.
- Valuing your money.
We are there for a quick “hello” and for that special day. We make you feel closer to them, no matter the distance.
Since 2006, we have been proud to be part of so many memorable moments. And we want to be there for you, too.
Rebtel app helps you to:
Send top-ups in a matter of seconds
Cuba, Mexico, Nigeria, Ethiopia, Afghanistan… Select any destination, we send your top-up! You can recharge loved ones in more than 150 countries. Send the gift of connection!
Crystal-clear international calls
International calls to landlines and mobile phones in more than 190 countries across the globe. Excellent calling quality at amazing rates, because we know it’s never just a call.
How does it work? By allowing our application to detect when you are making calls, Rebtel can offer you different and cheaper alternatives for international calling! We use intermediary numbers so that you can place international calls at local rates!
Flexibility
We offer flexible options for every need. Credits, bundles or subscription plans for calling abroad and mobile recharge? We got you covered! Choose the option that best suits you. You can also automate the payment, so your loved one never runs out of minutes and data.
Payment method
Pay with a debit or credit card (Visa, Mastercard, Maestro, American Express, among others), Paypal or Apple Pay. And don’t worry! Your personal details are protected by Trustwave 128-bit SSL encryption and the online transactions are processed by our internal fraud team.
Support around the clock
Our team is available 24/7 to assist you in English, Spanish and other 10 languages via email or live chat with real people.
Best mobile networks
We are delighted to say we work with over 600 carriers around the world to deliver the best international calling and mobile top-up experiences. Among them, you will find Cubacel, Claro, MTN, Telcel, Orange, Airtel, Tigo, Virgin Mobile, Etisalat, Roshan, and many others.
Rebtel app is available in 9 languages, including English, Spanish, French, Italian and German.
Recharge your loved ones with Rebtel!
How to send top-up?
1. Download the Rebtel app.
2. Create your account.
3. Tap “Send your first top-up”.
4. Enter the number you want to recharge.
5. Select the amount and add your personal information.
6. Confirm the payment.
Simple like that! In a matter of seconds, your loved one will be recharged!
You are always there for them. We are always here for you.
Download Rebtel app today.
Have any questions? Get in touch with us! https://www.rebtel.com/en/help/contact/
Physical Address
Jakobsbergsgatan 16, 111 44 Stockholm Sweden
Contact info
support@rebtel.com

bluejetty:00099924:ios.summary:
Unwind your mind with Snake Escape, a calm yet clever puzzle journey that turns simple mazes into beautifully designed escape games of logic and satisfaction.
Snake Escape is a fresh twist on animal escape puzzles, built for users who enjo
bluejetty:00099924:ios.description:
Unwind your mind with Snake Escape, a calm yet clever puzzle journey that turns simple mazes into beautifully designed escape games of logic and satisfaction.
Snake Escape is a fresh twist on animal escape puzzles, built for users who enjoy smart and satisfying challenges. Your goal is to guide snakes out of tangled grids — tapping in the right order, finding safe paths, and unlocking that perfect “aha!” moment when everything lines up. Each maze feels handcrafted, combining the charm of snake games and smooth snake slide mechanics with clever animal escape logic. Watch the snakes wiggle and slither as your plan unfolds — it’s calm, clever, and addictively rewarding.
HOW TO PLAY:
- Tap to Move: Choose a snake, tap, and watch it move step by step through the grid.
- Think Smart: Each snake moves in order — plan ahead or they’ll get stuck in a jam!
- Escape All: Find the perfect sequence to help every snake escape safely and master the maze logic in this fun snake slide challenge.
UNIQUE FEATURES:
- Unique puzzle concept combining the charm of snakes with tap-to-move mechanics, creating a fresh escape game experience full of logic and strategy.
- Hundreds of handcrafted levels with different maze layouts, obstacles, and difficulty curves to challenge every type of users.
- Smart boosters to help you escape tricky moments: reveal grid paths with Grid Vision, highlight the right snake with Hint, or gain extra seconds using Add Time.
- Polished design and animation, smooth snake movement, and relaxing sound effects that make every puzzle feel satisfying and alive as they wiggle and slither their way out of the maze jam.
Snake Escape isn’t just about freeing snakes — it’s about freeing your mind.
Each puzzle trains your logic, rewards smart thinking, and delivers that satisfying moment when everything finally clicks. If you enjoy clever escape games that balance calm and challenge, this is a snake games adventure you won’t want to miss. Step into the maze and see how far your logic can take you.

bluejetty:00037632:ios.description:
幕布是一款结合 AI 能力的极简大纲笔记与思维导图工具。
用更高效的方式和清晰的结构来记录笔记、管理任务、制定工作计划、激发头脑风暴。帮助你在记录内容的同时，掌握结构化的思维方式，快速梳理内容脉络，构建专属知识库。 
【从记录到思考】
从一个个简单的圆点开始，通过层级和缩进建立信息之间的关系，让你在记录的同时整理，在整理的过程中思考。不仅记录想法，也帮助你把事情一点点想清楚。
极简输入：干净的界面、轻量的输入方式、丰富的快捷操作与 Markdown 语法支持，尽可能减少工具本身带来的干扰，让你专注于内容。
今日速记：无需纠结存放在哪个文档/文件夹，打开幕布即可在「今日速记」中零压力捕捉当下的闪念灵感、临时待办与日常碎片，不错过每一个思考瞬间。
让思考变得简单，也让更多人享受思考。
【一份内容，两种思考视角】
大纲擅长快速输入，思维导图擅长看见全局。改变的只是呈现方式，不变的是背后的思考结构。
结构化大纲笔记：幕布通过树形大纲结构组织内容，无限层级缩进，不断拆分细化每一个主题，让笔记更有条理性。写好笔记并学会整理，内容将更加清晰深刻，放大笔记的价值。
一键转换思维导图：告别繁琐的拖拽排版，在极简大纲模式下专注文字记录，一键即可秒转思维导图（脑图），轻松应对演示与头脑风暴。
【AI，让思考从更高的起点开始】
我们不希望 AI 代替你的思考，但 AI 可以帮你更快地开始。
智能创建：你可以导入文档、图片、录音等资料，或直接描述自己的需求，让 AI 帮助提取信息、梳理重点，并一键生成结构清晰的大纲笔记与思维导图。
原生支持 MCP 协议：打通外部 AI 工作流！通过 MCP（Model Context Protocol）能力，将幕布与你的常用 AI 客户端无缝连接，实现个人知识库的智能检索、自动归档与跨工具协同，打造真正的“第二大脑”。
---
【可以用幕布来做什么？】
记录学习笔记（考研考公 / 课堂读书 / 无纸化学习）
幕布是记录和整理学习笔记的理想工具： 
- 结构化记录：将课程内容、书籍章节按层级整理，或通过 AI 导入文档快速形成清晰的知识框架。
- 重点标记与公式：使用不同字体颜色、高亮和样式突出核心考点，原生支持 LaTeX 数学与学科公式，理工科笔记同样轻松拿捏。
- 知识关联：通过 @ 建立双向主题链接，配合 #标签 打通知识点之间的联系，织成个人知识网络。
- 复习回顾：利用「多级折叠」和「文字挖空」功能进行主动回忆与记忆自测，或转换为思维导图进行整体复习。
- 附件在线预览：支持在笔记中上传常见文档附件、音频、视频并直接预览，无需频繁切换应用，参考资料与核心大纲便捷对照。
梳理思路（内容创作 / 方案策划 / 会议纪要）
当需要理清复杂问题或构思创意时，幕布能够： 
- 头脑风暴：快速记录闪现的灵感，搭配 AI 助手不受限制地发散思维。
- 逻辑梳理：无论是写小说大纲、文章框架、视频脚本还是周报汇报，通过拖拽调整层级和顺序，轻松优化思路结构。
- 深入分析：利用逐层展开层级细节，进行深度思考和逻辑推演。
- 全局视角：切换到思维导图视图，从宏观角度审视整体框架。
- 在线协作：和同学整理资料、和同事拆解项目，在同一套结构中共同思考和推进事情。
事项待办（项目管理 / 工作计划 / 日常清单）
让想法继续向前，在同一套结构中完成从梳理到执行：
- 项目规划：将复杂的大项目层层分解为可执行的子任务（To-Do）。
- 完成度跟踪：使用待办标记功能直观标示任务完成状态。
- 优先级与时间管理：通过颜色、顺序区分任务优先级，结合通知提醒进行日程安排与进度追踪。
- 多端实时同步：手机、平板、电脑、网页多端云同步，无论在桌前规划还是出门在外，随时随地查看与推进任务。

Newport’s Cliff Walk:
bluejetty:00172805:ios.description:
Welcome to the narrated walking tour of the scenic Cliff Walk in Newport, Rhode Island!
Featuring riveting stories, a phenomenal narrator, and easy automatic audio, this app puts exploration in the palm of your hand!
Newport’s Cliff Walk:
Get ready for America’s Gilded Age to come alive! Stroll along this beautiful oceanside trail and marvel at the impossibly extravagant mansions which line the coast. Hear all about the lavish lifestyles of the Vanderbilts, the Astors, and other famous families who built these so-called “summer cottages.”
Ever wondered what it was like to be invited to one of Mrs. Astor’s ultra-exclusive balls? Wonder no longer! We’ll give you the inside scoop and place you right in the middle of America’s most decadent parties. Oh, and of course, there’s plenty of drama to be found among these bickering business tycoons.
Don’t just admire these mansions from afar—really get to know them!
See all these historic sights along the picturesque Cliff Walk:
■ Welcome to the Cliff Walk in Newport, RI
■ Easton’s Beach
■ The Chanler
■ The Gilded Age
■ Forty Steps
■ The Overlook
■ Ochre Court
■ Vinland Estate (McAuley Hall)
■ The Breakers
■ Beneath the Breakers
■ Anglesea
■ Rosecliff
■ Beechwood
■ The 400 List
■ Marble House
■ Chinese Tea House
■ Rough Point
■ Doris and Her Pets
■ Land’s End
■ Edith Wharton
■ The Waves
■ Bailey’s Beach
HOW IT WORKS:
As you travel, audio stories play automatically based on your location. Simply go to the starting point of the tour and begin following the given route. Each story begins playing on its own, usually just before you reach a point of interest.
TOUR FEATURES:
▶ Freedom of travel
No scheduled tour times, no crowded buses, and no rush to keep moving past stops that interest you. You have total freedom to skip ahead, linger, and take as many photos as you’d like.
▶ Automatic play
No muss, no fuss. Just follow the app’s built-in route to all the must-visit spots—the audio stories about everything you see will play automatically!
▶ Works offline
Download the tour in advance and then use it seamlessly, even in areas with no service!
▶ Lifetime purchase

bluejetty:00176317:ios.description:
Car crash games are now a popular hobby that simulates the experience of crashing cars in various scenarios. These scenes are also known as car crash simulators or accident games and offer players a chance to experience the thrill of destroying cars obstacles, and barriers without any real-world consequences.
In car crash simulator games, players can choose from a variety of vehicles and environments, such as real city driving, highways, and even new off road games. Some feature a realistic car crashing simulator mode, where players can customize the speed and angle of their collisions to create realistic crash scenarios.
Mega ramp jumping and stunt car games are also popular sub-genres of car crash games. These beamg modes offer players the chance to perform spectacular mega ramp stunts, car jumping games, and flips while doing a realistic driving simulator. The objective is to complete challenging levels or missions and earn points for successfully completing car stunt games or crash car games.
One of the most exciting aspects of car crash compilation games is the ability to unlock new vehicles and beamg upgrades as you progress through the story. This allows players to experience new types of crashing cars and experiment with different mega ramp games.
Overall, new car crash simulator games offer an adrenaline-fueled experience that is both thrilling and entertaining. Whether you're a fan of new racing games or just looking for a fun way to blow off steam, car crash games are a great choice.

bluejetty:00042125:ios.description:
** THIS APP WILL NOT FUNCTION WITHOUT HARDWARE. This is the companion app for Beautyrest® Sleeptracker® Monitors and Tomorrow® Sleeptracker® Monitors. ONE OF THESE DEVICES IS REQUIRED TO USE THIS APP. **
POWERED BY SLEEPTRACKER®-AI: BETTER SLEEP
Learn about your sleep - and improve your sleep - with nothing to wear or charge!
This is the companion app for the Beautyrest® Sleeptracker® Monitor and the Tomorrow® Sleeptracker® Monitor which make your bed a smart bed. The Sleeptracker®-AI system is the first cloud-based, non-invasive IoT sleep optimization solution powered by artificial intelligence (AI) and integrated into the smart home.
The app provides detailed daily sleep graphs and sleep metrics derived from accurately and continuously monitoring the sleeper’s respiration rate, heart rate, and movements throughout the night. Easy-to-understand sleep graphs visually distinguish between periods when you were in REM sleep, light sleep, deep sleep, or awake. The AI Sleep Coach delivers personalized tips and insights to help you improve your sleep every night.
AI SLEEP COACH
The AI Sleep Coach, powered by the Sleeptracker®-AI Artificial Intelligence Engine, provides effective, easy-to-implement, personal sleep tips based on a comprehensive analysis of individual sleep patterns.
RESPIRATION AND HEART RATE MONITORING
The Sleeptracker®-AI system monitors both respiration and heart rate accurately through the night for deeper sleep analysis, with your data displayed as easy to read charts in the app.
SLEEP CYCLE ALARM
Optionally select white noise that gently fades away after you've fallen asleep, then set a sleep cycle alarm that will help you Wake Up at the Optimal Time™ in your sleep cycle so you wake up refreshed and more energized.
AUTOMATIC SLEEP MONITORING
If you choose to record your sleep automatically, there’s nothing to do and nothing to wear. Optionally receive a notification in the morning when your sleep results are available and a daily email with your sleep summary and AI Coach insights.
APPLE HEALTH
Share your Sleeptracker®-AI sleep data to the Apple Health app.
The Sleeptracker®-AI system reports the following sleep-related statistics each night:
- REM sleep, light sleep, deep sleep, awake time
- Time at which you fell asleep and woke up
- Number of times awoken during the night
- Continuous respiration rate
- Continuous heart rate
- Sleep quality metric (scale of 0-100)
- Sleep efficiency (time spent in bed vs. total time asleep)
- Time it took you to fall asleep
This is also the companion app for Sleeptracker® smart beds by Simmons® and Serta® including Beautyrest® SmartMotion™ and Serta® SleepGPS™ adjustable bases.
Sleeptracker® Premium Advanced Subscription Available:
1-year subscription - $29.99 (automatically renewed until canceled)
1-month Free Trial
A subscription to Sleeptracker® Premium Advanced gives you unlimited cloud-based sleep data storage, personalized sleep coaching, and advanced sleep analysis reports.
Subscription automatic-renewal feature:
Your subscription will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase and will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of your current period. Your iTunes account will be automatically charged $29.99 for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage your subscription or turn off auto-renewal by visiting your iTunes Account Settings after purchase. Current subscriptions may not be canceled during the active subscription period. Any unused portion of the 1-month free trial period will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription. Prices shown are in U.S. dollars.

https://www.fullpower.com/home/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy:

bluejetty:00160805:ios.description:
Crave the thrill of adrenaline-pumping, zombie-shooting 3D games? Love to indulge in fast-paced, casual shooting zombies action? Play Tower Gunner: Zombie Shooter, a blend of riveting action gameplay and simple, intuitive controls that's perfect for gamers of all stripes!
DEFEND THE LAST STAND
In this walking zombie game, your main objective is to survive against the never-ending onslaught of the undead. You'll need to use all your skills to predict their movements, as they'll be coming at you from all directions. As you progress through the game, you'll encounter stronger and more fearsome zombie types, each with their own unique abilities and weaknesses. So, it's important to stay on your toes and adapt your strategy as needed.
UPGRADE WEAPONS
You'll have a variety of weapons at your disposal to strike them down, from M16 rifle to the powerful mini gun. With each wave you survive, you'll earn points which can be used to buy new weapons. In this dead target zombie game, you should gear up well and prepare for a battle where your survival is at stake.
MEET NEW CHALLENGES
Journey through an array of challenging levels, each with it a unique and immersive environment. Whether you're into the dead, you should fight off hordes of zombies in deserted streets, covert labs, urban rooftops, rural areas, abandoned factories. With dozens of locations to explore, you'll never get bored in this first person shooter.
PLAY OFFLINE
Unlike other zombie shooting games, you don't need to worry about an internet connection. It's one of the best offline zombie games out there, allowing you to dive headfirst into the exhilarating world of zombie shooter games whenever and wherever you want. Immerse yourself in the captivating gameplay, hone your shooting abilities as you take down wave after wave of undead foes.
So, are you ready to take on the walking zombie horde and become the ultimate zombie shooter? It’s time to show off your expertise in zombie killing games and unleash your marksmanship skills in this gripping zombie shooting game. Download the free offline zombie game right now and embark on the ultimate zombie war. Let the zombie shooting fun begin!

bluejetty:00041548:ios.description:
Make healthier food choices with FoodSwitch. Simply scan a barcode to get its nutrition facts and healthier alternatives! 
# Accredited by ORCHA with a review Score of 74% in 2020 making FoodSwitch app the most trusted source for health app advice
Whether you're looking to shop for healthier food, diet, determine calories, avoid gluten, or looking for products low in calories, fat, saturated fat, sugars, salt or sodium, FoodSwitch will help you develop healthy habits when grocery shopping.
See for yourself why FoodSwitch is the world’s most popular health and fitness app.
MAKING HEALTHIER FOOD CHOICES IS FAST AND EASY
• Barcode Scanner --- Simply scan barcodes to view the nutritional information of packaged food products. Over a million barcodes are recognized in our huge database.
• Nutritional Tracker --- Information on the nutritional quality of packaged foods.
• Nutrient Details --- View Energy, Fat, Sugar, Salt content, and more.
• Healthy Food Choice --- Make healthier food choices based on what you scan.
• Health Star rating mode --- View how key components in food rate using stars in Health Star Rating mode. The higher the star rating, the healthier the food is overall.
• Traffic Light Labels mode --- View how key components in food rate using colors in Traffic Light Labels mode. Red is less healthy, Green is a healthier choice and Amber is in between red and green.
MORE FEATURES
• Help the community by sharing photos of any items that you are not able to scan and help expand our product database. 
• Identify products containing Gluten easily.
Check out this video. Professor Bruce Neal - Executive Director at The George Institute for Global Health talks about the FoodSwitch program and its vision to improve health 
https://www.georgeinstitute.org/videos/launch-food-the-foodswitch-program
FoodSwitch data is used by governments and health organizations around the world. Download the app today for credible and impartial information.
FoodSwitch is owned and operated by The George Institute for Global Health.
For more information about FoodSwitch and FAQs, please visit 
http://www.georgeinstitute.org/projects/foodswitch.
For our Terms of use, please visit 
http://www.georgeinstitute.org.au/sites/default/files/foodswitch-terms-of-use.pdf

bluejetty:00086853:ios.description:
Drinking water is a good habit! And adorable Watercat will help you build this healthy habit easily!
70% of the human body is made up of water.
It would be hard to overestimate the importance of water: water transports nutrients and flushes out toxins, increases metabolism and helps lose weight, boosts energy and performance, has positive impact on skin health and makes you look younger, makes you feel good and cheerful - the list can go on and on.
However sometimes in the bustle of everyday life we do not pay attention to thirst or even confuse thirst and hunger. How to maintain water balance?
Here comes Watercat: drink reminder, water tracker & balance.
Watercat is a cute, beautiful and easy-to-use app which includes all the features you need to build a healthy habit of drinking enough water. 
Watercat will become your perfect assistant that will send you notifications to make sure you didn’t forget to drink water and will compliment you on each glass! You will effortlessly drink more water and in no time you will be amazed of beneficial effects over your body, health and appearance. 
Watercat: drink reminder & water tracker, water balance, hydration is a great app for a number of reasons:
- Personalized goals
The app will automatically calculate how much water you in particular need to drink with consideration to your gender and weight, moreover it will make adjustments based on the weather conditions and your physical activities.
You will not have to spend precious time on research, we’ve done all the hard work for you!
- Smart reminders
You are the one to set a suitable time interval for notifications and its frequency, so you can be 100% sure that the app won’t wake you in the middle of the night or intrude.
- With a single tap
Watercat saves your time: one short tap - and your water intake is saved, long press - and you can change the volume of liquid you drank. 
- Motivation
Watercat will share the joy, celebrate your success and compliment you, and what is more it will add your records to a simple table and chart your progress!
- Various measurement units
Your convenience is our priority, so various measurement units are supported.
- Cuteness
Watercat is simply adorable and it will definitely cheer you up!
Drink water and in no time you will realize that you become even more energetic, healthy, happy and beautiful!
And Watercat is here to help!

bluejetty:00073113:ios.summary:

Are you unable to attend Mass, either because of health,
bluejetty:00073113:ios.description:
iMass removes boundaries for the spread of the Traditional Catholic Mass. It brings the Latin Mass to the ends of the earth.
iMass provides access to the Mass - anywhere, anytime. 
Are you unable to attend Mass, either because of health, distance or unavailability of a Latin Mass? iMass streams the Mass live from different locations around the world, or you can view the Mass of the day or the Mass of last Sunday on demand, anywhere, anytime. 
The broadcast Masses are celebrated in the Extraordinary Form by the Priestly Fraternity of St. Peter. 
Are you traveling and would like to find your closest Latin Mass? The iMass Map is continuously updated by users of the app and will eventually show every Latin Mass location approved by the Catholic Church. Complete with Mass times and driving directions. 
Suppose you don’t want to carry around your missal or you have forgotten it - no problem, with iMass you can follow the Mass with our easy to follow missal. The app also includes the Breviary (Divine Office) and the Rituale - the book of official blessings for priests of 1962. 
Just to be clear: you cannot fulfill you Sunday obligation by viewing the Mass on iMass. However, in a similar way to other televised Masses, it is a way to unite yourself to the Mass when you are unable to attend. When sickness or another valid reason excuses you of your obligation to attend the Mass, this is the best way you can unite yourself to the Mass that you are unable to attend. 
iMass. Mass, Anywhere, Anytime.

bluejetty:00014108:ios.summary: iboChron offers you the perfect ability to track your working hours easy and fast. Login / Logout via the login slider or record your working hours with breaks included. Get an overview of your earnings, overtime, target time, working hours
bluejetty:00014108:ios.description:
iboChron offers you the perfect ability to track your working hours easy and fast. Login / Logout via the login slider or record your working hours with breaks included. Get an overview of your earnings, overtime, target time, working hours, holidays or leave days. Share your working hours via email as CSV or use the share option of your iOS device. iboChron is the perfect tool for freelancers, self employed workers or employees. 
All your data are stored locally on your device!
Features
- Track your working hours via login / logout slider
- Overview / calculation of your daily login / logout time
- Easy and fast login via Siri Shortcuts support (Login / Logout / Logout Time)
- Automatic calculation of breaks, working hours, overtime, target time and earnings
- Overview of your leave days, holidays, overtime, working hours (daily, weekly, monthly or yearly)
- Export your work time as CSV / PDF via email, share your work time in Excel, Numbers, ... (daily, weekly, monthly or yearly)
- Never forget to login / logout - iboChron learns from your behaviour and reminds you to login / logout every single day (Notifications)
- Show working hours in decimals
- Option to calculate earnings variable (0 - 100 %)
- Management of several projects
- Add notes to each work time entry
- Add additional earnings to each work time entry
- Manage working time account 
- Protect your data via Face ID / Touch ID
- Login / Logout via NFC Tags (NFC Tags are required - only iPhone 7 or newer supports third party NFC, this is a limitation by Apple)
- Login / Logout & overview via the today widget
- Create backups / restore backups
- Overview of annual leave days / yearly income
- Notifications for login / logout / breaks
- Use Themes to personalize iboChron (including dark mode)
- Support for Lock Screen Widgets
- Calendar for better overview
For feedback or feature requests please use the feedback section in the app or send an email to support@ibochron.de.
If you like the app, please rate it in the App Store to support future development.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Meet MapGame, a fun and challenging geography game with three exciting modes:

• Track your position against players globally
Comprehensive Stats: Keep track of your progress with detailed statistics:
• Average completion time

• Max streak
• Global ranking
• Personal best scores
100% Free to Play: MapGame is completely free, with all game modes available to everyone!
Get ready to sharpen your geography skills with MapGame. Challenge yourself daily, compete globally, and become a geography master!
Join millions of players exploring the world on their screens, one country at a time. Download today and let the adventure begin!

bluejetty:00155312:ios.description:
Pre-requisite: Designed to work with a Textellent account which is required before downloading this app.
Textellent adds texting to your business phone number so you have another powerful channel where customers can engage with your business through their customer experience 
Don’t have a Textellent Account Yet? 
With a Textellent subscription, you have the ability to add texting to your business phone line and to use a rich texting channel to allow your customers to text you and for you communicate with your customers from any device, website, web application or CRM system. You can send personalized and relevant customer service and marketing campaigns with one-to one messages or one-to-many to expand your customer experience. 70% of customers would like to text with their businesses, make sure you give them that option.
In addition, Textellent gives you have access to your business contacts, customizable message templates and a media library so you can send engaging messages. You can immediately see previous texting conversations and send a new text message to keep the conversation going leading to higher customer retention and satisfaction. The personalized texts will automatically be sent and received via your business number and can be automatically triggered by events in your back-end or CRM systems to make sure they are timely. Textellent makes it easy to add texting to your existing business number (toll-free, landline or VOIP) or get you a new dedicated number for this texting channel. 
 • Send text invite for appointments, confirmations, estimates, shipping details order confirmations
 • Provide text thank-yous, customer satisfaction surveys, 
 • Generate more reviews and referrals with texting requests that get noticed
 • Send holiday greetings, sales notices, VIP specials 
 • Includes more than just SMS – include logos and pictures, send links for setting appointments, attach product images, etc.
Already have Textellent?
Now with this phone app now you have access to those key features from your cell phone as well and all text communications will be sent using your business number so you never reveal your personal cell phone number again. You have access to your business contacts on the go so you can quickly and easily text your customers while seeing previous text conversations too and you can filter customers using tags making it even more convenient. 
• You will automatically be notified when you receive a new message
• Immediately respond to customer inquiries or any text responses
• Your contacts and messages will be automatically synced 
• Text responses from customers can be forwarded to other team members
• Text any mobile phone number (no need to be in your contact list)

bluejetty:00159786:ios.name: Vmod - Multiplayer Sandbox Fun
bluejetty:00159786:ios.summary: Get ready to unleash your creativity and dive into the exciting world of Vmod, a multiplayer sandbox game where imagination has no limits! Whether you’re a fan of Gmod style Garry’s Mod alternatives or looking for a new sandbox game with en
bluejetty:00159786:ios.description:
Get ready to unleash your creativity and dive into the exciting world of Vmod, a multiplayer sandbox game where imagination has no limits! Whether you’re a fan of Gmod style Garry’s Mod alternatives or looking for a new sandbox game with endless fun, Vmod offers an innovative and dynamic platform to create, build, explore, and play with friends or alone.
Key Features:
Multiplayer Sandbox Game with Creative Building Vmod is all about creativity and freedom! With over 800 items and 28 tools, including Weld, Thruster, Nextbot, Dupe, Balloon, Bouncy, and more, you can build anything you imagine. Whether you're constructing vehicles, complex buildings, or entire cities, the sky’s the limit!
Explore Over 11 Maps Vmod comes with a variety of unique maps, including a military base map and more! Each map offers distinct environments for you to explore, build, and play in, whether you're looking to engage in epic battles or just create your own world. Save and load your creations at any time, share your maps, and download maps from the community!
Vehicle Simulation and Combat Experience the thrill of driving and piloting various vehicles, from cars and buses to war aircrafts equipped with missiles and even UFOs with laser attacks! Take control of tanks and anti-aircraft vehicles for intense, action-packed gameplay, or soar the skies with powerful aircraft and helicopters!
Robot Piloting and Nextbot Interaction Control giant robots armed with missiles, and pilot them into epic battles or crazy adventures! Vmod allows you to interact with NPCs and Nextbots, creating unique challenges and gameplay experiences. Create your own Nextbots and have them roam your world for even more fun.
Building, Crafting, and Circuit Design Utilize 28 powerful tools and over 800 building items to craft fortresses, new vehicles, or intricate circuits. The Oscillator tool enables objects to move back and forth in a loop, adding dynamic motion to your creations. Tools like Weld, Thruster, and Damage Player allow for extensive modification of objects and structures.
Create, Share, and Play With the Dupe feature, you can create and replicate your own items, share your custom creations with friends, or upload them to the map store. Download new maps made by other players, and experience the endless variety of worlds Vmod has to offer. Create a sandbox with friends where you can build, battle, or simply explore the vast environments together!
Open-World Sandbox with Endless Possibilities The game is set in an open-world sandbox where there are no boundaries to what you can create. Fly planes, drive vehicles, control mechs, and much more—all while interacting with the vast open environment. With customizable features like dancing characters and interactive props, you can create the perfect world to share with your friends.
Unique Items Discover special items like the Skibidi Toilet, adding a humorous and distinctive element to your creations.
Join the Fun Today! Whether you’re a builder, explorer, combat enthusiast, or roleplayer, Vmod has something for everyone. With its multiplayer sandbox mode, you can play with your friends online and offline, share your creations, and engage in endless hours of fun.
Why Play Vmod?
•Free crafting and building with over 800 items
•Design circuits and interact with the world
•Vehicles, aircrafts, and robot piloting
•Tanks, helicopters, war aircrafts for epic battles
•Create and share your custom maps with the community
•Play in the backrooms
•Interact with NPCs and Nextbots
•Play online and offline with friends
•Customize graphics quality and shadows
Get started today and create your own world in Vmod! Download the game now and experience the ultimate sandbox game that offers the freedom to create, build, and explore like never before.

bluejetty:00027067:ios.name: Squeezy
bluejetty:00027067:ios.summary: Squeezy has helped thousands of women regain confidence in their pelvic floor. Pelvic health specialists around the world recommend Squeezy to their patients every day because it works! If you are thinking about downloading Squeezy for your
bluejetty:00027067:ios.description:
Squeezy has helped thousands of women regain confidence in their pelvic floor. Pelvic health specialists around the world recommend Squeezy to their patients every day because it works! If you are thinking about downloading Squeezy for your pelvic floor, you are not alone. 
All women should be doing these exercises and some will be doing them as part of a physiotherapy programme.
Squeezy is simple to use, informative and designed to help women to remember to do their pelvic floor muscle exercises (also known as Kegel exercises).
Features includes:
• A pre-set exercise plan that follows public health guidelines
• A record of the number of exercises you have completed, compared to your target
• Visual and audio prompts for exercises
• Exercise reminders with customisable settings
• Educational information about the pelvic floor
• “Professional mode” – if working with a pelvic health specialist, you can tailor the exercise plan to fit your needs
• A bladder diary to keep track of your symptoms, if required
• Simple and clear interface
Squeezy was designed by chartered physiotherapists specialising in pelvic health working in the NHS. It has been clinically reviewed and approved by the NHS for its clinical safety, and is compliant with NHS Information Governance requirements.
Squeezy won several industry awards including ehi Awards 2016, Health Innovation Network 2016, National Continence Care Awards 2015/16 and was a finalist for awards including Advancing Healthcare Awards 2014 and 2017, Abbvie Sustainable Healthcare Awards 2016.
The app is UKCA marked as Class I medical device in the United Kingdom and developed in compliance with Medical Devices Regulations 2002 (SI 2002 No 618, as amended).
For more about Squeezy and additional pelvic health information visit squeezyapp.com.

Follow Topics:

Just as easily “Unfollow”
