bluejetty:00035038:ios.description:
This heartwarming management simulation game all starts with a stray cat in the forest.
You're the owner of Animal Restaurant. Will you take in this clumsy, dirty kitty and let him work at your restaurant?
You can learn all kinds of recipes,
like taiyaki, strawberry pancakes, shaved ice, and spaghetti!
There's even pizza and avocado sandwich!
Mix and match all styles of furniture.
We've got European-style dessert tables, Japanese-style fences, and Mediterranean-style ovens!
You can also have an Alice in Wonderland-style garden tea party!
Hire cute feline staff,
including a ragdoll cat, a tabby cat, and a big orange cat!
You've also got to get on good terms with an eccentric chef!
As long as you work hard, you'll always have a steady stream of customers.
Will you chat with this diverse crowd of customers?
Will you listen to their thoughts, or argue with them?
Learn about the customers' stories through chats and letters. You can even participate and change their lives.
Hear about secrets, gossip and tear-jerking experiences.
All of this and more can be found at Animal Restaurant—a simple yet cozy and cute restaurant that's all yours!
Come open a restaurant and start your story!
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/animalrestaurantEN
Twitter: https://twitter.com/AML_Restaurant
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/animal_restaurant

bluejetty:00180381:ios.summary:
O aplicativo para bater ponto “BatePonto” da Pontotel é a solução perfeita para colaboradores que buscam gerenciar sua jornada de trabalho com praticidade, segurança e autonomia.
Registre seus pontos rapidamente e acompanhe suas horas trab
bluejetty:00180381:ios.description:
O aplicativo para bater ponto “BatePonto” da Pontotel é a solução perfeita para colaboradores que buscam gerenciar sua jornada de trabalho com praticidade, segurança e autonomia.
Registre seus pontos rapidamente e acompanhe suas horas trabalhadas, extras e banco de horas em tempo real, tudo na palma da sua mão e de onde estiver.
Funcionalidades do BatePonto Pontotel:
Controle pessoal de horário de trabalho
- Registre seus horários de entrada, pausas e saídas com apenas um toque
- Marcação em 3 segundos
- Consulte e ajuste seus registros diretamente no aplicativo
Segurança Avançada:
- Autenticação por PIN
- Autenticação por imagem
- Autenticação por biometria facial
- Autenticação por geolocalização
- Autenticação multifator (MFA)
Modo Offline:
- Registro de ponto mesmo sem internet
- Sincronização automática ao se reconectar.
Solicitações de horas extras
- Solicite horas extras para o gestor diretamente do app
- Informe detalhes como a data, o motivo e a quantidade de horas extras desejadas
Notificações em tempo real:
- Habilite ou desabilite as notificações do aplicativo
- Notificação de entrada
- Notificações de pausas
- Notificações de retorno de pausa
- Notificação saída
- Notificação de horas extras
- Notificação de limite de horas extras
- Notificação de atrasos
Perfil coletor personalizado:
- Defina o nome do seu perfil coletor
- Configure permissões de acesso para o perfil
- Escolha métodos de autenticação específicos
- Personalize notificações para o perfil coletor
Permissionamento:
- Habilite ou desabilite o acesso à câmera
- Habilite ou desabilite o acesso à localização
- Habilite ou desabilite o acesso ao microfone
- Habilite ou desabilite o acesso ao armazenamento
Extrato em PDF:
- Acesso a todas as folhas de ponto
- Envio simples das folhas de ponto por e-mail;
Suporte Técnico Integrado:
- Envio de diagnósticos detalhados diretamente pelo app
- Acesso facilitado à central de ajuda
E muito mais
-----
Baixe o BatePonto agora e bata seu ponto agora mesmo!
-----
O sistema da Pontotel está em total conformidade com a Portaria 671 e a LGPD (Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados), garantindo que suas informações sejam tratadas com segurança e privacidade. Além disso, a empresa conta com a certificação ISO 27001, que atesta seu compromisso com as melhores práticas globais em gestão de segurança da informação.
Saiba mais em www.pontotel.com.br.

bluejetty:00017255:ios.description:
The Ultimate Professional Tarot App.
Immerse yourself in Tarot, Numerology and Astrology with this professional‑grade app built on 16 years of R&D. A complete Tarot toolkit for serious practice and self development.
Now with optional AI to assist reading spreads. Get a FREE AI assisted reading to sample just how amazing our AI is at reading your Tarot spreads. No need to commit to a subscription to try it out.
Learn and Explore
• Comprehensive, and Free, Tarot and Lenormand tutorials with reference guides.
• Multiple cartomancy systems (Tarot, Lenormand, Oracle, Kipper, Runes) supported natively.
• Pythagorean numerology calculators for names, life path, destinies and more.
• Easy to use and accessible Astrology forecasting using current Sun & Moon positions.
Read and Journal
• Intuitive card selection with over 100 spread layouts, including Celtic Cross and themed spreads for love, career, health and spirituality.
• Save readings with notes, search your journal and track trends over lunar cycles or calendar years.
• Optional AI assistance provides guided interpretations when you want a second opinion.
• NEW: Relationship Compatibility — compare two profiles using Tarot + Numerology + Astrology (friends, family, work, romance).
Forecast and Plan
• Daily and weekly forecasts that blend Tarot cards with your personal daily numerology rhythm.
• Astrology guides using current sun and moon zodiac positions blended with Numerology to provide rich daily insights. 
Collect and Customize
• Default Rider Waite Smith Tarot deck included with four more free decks to download.
• Build your library with over 35 additional Tarot, Lenormand, Oracle, Kipper and Rune decks available in‑app.
• Export and import individual or all spreads using our open‑source format.

bluejetty:00175315:ios.description:
No more digging for coins. This is how parking should be.
Pay, extend, and manage your parking session with just a few taps. It’s easy!
PAY ON THE GO 
Pay quickly and securely with your smartphone.
- Time's precious, stop wasting it feeding a meter.
- Forget refilling the meter in the rain or braving the cold.
NO PRICE SURPRISES
See when parking rates will change in the future – even when there’s free parking!
- Receive email receipts at the end of your parking session.
- Expenses made easy, manage your parking history through the mobile app.
STRESS-FREE PARKING
Get alerts when your parking session is about to end.
- Stop worrying about how much time is left on the meter, we have you covered.
NO NEED TO RUSH
Add time to your parking session directly from your phone.*
- Your plans change, your parking spot shouldn't. Simply extend your parking session via our app.
--------
GET STARTED TODAY
1. Download the Passport Parking app.
2. Park where you see Passport Parking app signs.
3. Pay for your parking session from your phone.
4. Relax, welcome to parking as it should be.
--------
COMING SOON
The Passport Parking app is not done yet! We're constantly updating the app based on your feedback.
--------
APP PERMISSIONS
- Location Services (optional): Used to quickly provide nearby parking zones.
* where applicable

bluejetty:00137664:ios.description:
Join on a Puzzle Adventure with Card Match Solitaire!
Experience the captivating blend of classic solitaire and innovative tile-matching in "Card Match Solitaire." This game seamlessly merges the excitement of match-3 mechanics with the strategic depth of solitaire, offering countless levels of enthralling challenges. bluejetty:00078929:ios.description:
The best app for SERIOUS Spanish learners
Welcome to Fluency, the ultimate destination for those eager and serious about mastering the Spanish language. Our app, designed by avid language learners just like you, offers a revolutionary approach to language acquisition, making the journey to fluency not just a dream, but an achievable goal.
Why Fluency stands out:
All-Inclusive Language Learning Platform: Fluency brings together all essential elements of language learning - vocabulary enhancement, grammar understanding, pronunciation perfection, and conversational practice, encapsulated within one innovative app.
AI-Powered Learning Experience: Dive into the future of language learning with our advanced AI technology. It provides a unique, stress-free environment for you to practice speaking and comprehension, ensuring your learning process is as efficient as it is enjoyable.
Optimized Learning Techniques: Our methods aren't just innovative; they're scientifically proven. With strategies inspired by extensive academic research, Fluency guarantees a faster and more effective learning curve.
Fluency is the language learning app made for serious language learners. No more child's play and games that seem like they were made for kids. If you are serious about learning Spanish this is the app for you.
Core Features:
Vocabulary Mastery: Embrace the power of the popular Anki style spaced repetition with our flashcards, designed for long-term word retention. Experience the benefits of contextual learning, a method celebrated for its effectiveness in language acquisition. Our vocabulary words are sourced from millions of hours of Spanish television. They are then sorted and shown to you in order of how frequently they are seen in real life. This means that you learn the words you need in the order you need them.
Practical Conversations: Test your skills with engaging mock conversations, simulating real-life interactions to prepare you for the world beyond the classroom.
Daily Lessons: Our daily lessons focus on grammar and pronunciation, laying down the foundation for a robust understanding of Spanish as recommended by experts.
Immersive Stories: Dive into daily stories that not only bolster your comprehension but also enrich your vocabulary. Through these narratives, you'll refine your expressive abilities, a crucial aspect of language mastery.
A Research-Driven Journey:
Fluency's foundation is built upon solid academic research. Every aspect of our app is meticulously crafted to ensure you're learning Spanish in the most efficient manner possible.
A Stress-Free Learning Environment:
Forget the fear of speaking a new language. Fluency offers a comforting, AI-enhanced space where you can learn at your own pace, free from anxiety.
Join a Community of Learners:
By choosing Fluency, you join a vibrant community of Spanish learners. Regardless of your starting point or objective, our app is designed to meet your language learning needs, offering a path to fluency that is both engaging and effective.
Begin Your Journey Today:
Elevate your Spanish with Fluency. Download now and embark on a transformative journey toward achieving language fluency.
Embark on your language learning adventure with Fluency, where each lesson brings you closer to mastery. Our app is not just about learning Spanish; it's about transforming the way you connect with the world. With Fluency, you don't just learn Spanish; you live it. Welcome to a new era of language learning. Welcome to Fluency.

Each subscription will be automatically renewed unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current payment period. Should you cancel a subscription, you will have access to the features until the end of the current payment period.

bluejetty:00043167:ios.description:
Etisalat is a leading telecommunication company recognized globally for the high-quality cellular services it offers. Our goal is to keep you connected with those you care about at all times and locations. We are currently operating in 15 countries, including Afghanistan. Etisalat Afghanistan, a subsidiary of Etisalat UAE, started operating in 2007. Within a short period, we managed to leave a transforming impact on the telecommunication industry and to be present in every Afghan home.
Etisalat Afghanistan ensures your needs are always met with more than 12,000 retail outlets spreading over 34 provinces and more than 200 districts and offering a diverse selection of postpaid and prepaid voice and data services. We also offer 3G coverage in 21 provinces.
But offering our prepaid and postpaid services in-store wasn’t enough; we live in a digital world distinguished by the convenience of remote communications. We had to live up to the Afghans’ high expectations of the region’s prime telecommunication company. We elevated Afghans experience by introducing “My Etisalat AFG” mobile application and welcoming them to the world of digital services. Our revolutionary app offers them access to a variety of SIM card management options from the comfort of their homes.
Through the “My Etisalat AFG” self-provisioning mobile application, our customers can shop SIM cards online, buy internet services in Afghanistan, activate SMS & voice packages, and more whenever and wherever with one click.
What Can You Do with My Etisalat AFG Mobile Application?
With “My Etisalat AFG” app, you can enjoy the following exceptional features:
• Check your credit and data balance.
• Recharge any registered accounts online.
• Activate and deactivate services.
• Transfer data benefits to friends and family: share your data benefits locally and internationally.
• Upgrade your cellular plan: no need to visit our branches to switch your mobile plan. You can do so online in a few seconds.
• Manage multiple accounts: add your family’s and friends’ Etisalat Afghanistan accounts and switch between your accounts easily to activate prepaid and postpaid packages.
• Track data usage: keep an eye on your balance and your active services. Track your calls, SMS, and data usage to stay on budget.
• Purchase data and talk time bundles: access the “Etisalat Shop” to buy hourly, daily, weekly, and monthly SMS & voice calling bundles, international call minutes, and internet roaming bundles, in addition to Etisalat AFG Mukammal bundles.
• Purchase value-added services: the “Etisalat Shop” features a range of value-added services that you can buy online. Your options include call-back ringtones, infotainments, IVR, and sports news (football and cricket).
• Build your bundle: customize your bundles and choose from daily and monthly data bundles, OnNet voice bundles, OffNet call bundles, SMS bundles, and international bundles.
• Explore local, international, and roaming calling rates: get information about our prepaid and postpaid call packages, including Mubarak, Mumtaz, Elite, and others.
• Enjoy many voice, SMS, and Internet package offers.
• Reach out to our team any time: for any inquiries and complaints, you can call or live chat with our customer service team and report any network issues regarding 3G & 4G connection, weak service signal, and call drops.
• Tap into the convenience of Etisalat services and get things done online with My Etisalat App. Download our app today and buy SIM cards online (prepaid and postpaid SIM cards), access premium internet deals, purchase minutes bundles & data bundles, activate SMS packages, build your bundles, check available balance, track data usage, and manage friends’ and family’s accounts, and much more.

bluejetty:00016683:ios.description:
Solve endless logic puzzles and get a bit smarter every day while having fun!
Sharpen your mind anywhere, anytime with easy to learn, hard to master nonogram puzzles (a.k.a. Picross, Griddler, Picture Cross), all while discovering awesome pixel art illustrations!
Have your wits always one step ahead!
HOW TO PLAY
If you’re already familiar with grid puzzles, you’ll quickly get the hang of nonograms.
You only need to follow two steps to get started:
1-Look at the numbers at the ends the rows and columns;
2-Use logic to fill the blocks and discover the hidden picture!
Our quick in-game tutorial will have you solving picture cross puzzles like a genius in no time!
FEATURES
•SOLVE countless brain-teasing, easy-to-expert nonogram puzzles!
•BEAT a challenge every day with the Daily Levels feature!
•USE logic to color the blocks on the grids and reveal the pictures hidden underneath them. The simple and fun picross gameplay you know and love! 
•ENJOY hours upon hours of picross picture logic puzzles with varying difficulty: lots of fun for all ages and skill levels!
•NO WI-FI NEEDED: play the game offline at any time!
•DISCOVER beautiful pixel art pictures from different thematic sets in the biggest selection of picture cross puzzle categories yet! Puzzle Packs include famous landmarks, animals, everyday objects and movies
•SHOW OFF how smart you are by solving nonograms with record speed in front of your friends or that special someone you wish to impress!
•AUTO-SAVE feature lets you resume your picross puzzle solving from where you left!
Complete fun thematic puzzle sets and power-up your problem solving skills without even noticing it! 
Download now and start boosting the power of your brain!

bluejetty:00022535:ios.description:
Montana Solitaire is also known as Gaps or Spaces.
Object:
To order all of the cards in 4 rows of increasing order from 2 to K, one single suit per row.
Layout:
All 52 cards are dealt face up into 4 rows, 13 cards each, where the cards are not overlapped.
After the dealing the Aces are removed to create 4 blank spaces.
Play:
Any card can be moved to a blank spot, if it is one rank higher than the card to the left of the blank and it is from the same suit.\nClick a blank to fill it, or click on the card you want to move to a space (if the card can be moved).
A space in the first column can only be filled with a Two from any suit.
A King blocks any spaces to the right of the King. You can continue arranging the cards until all moves are blocked by a King.
If all spaces are blocked by a King, press Shuffle Remaining button. All cards, which are not in ascending value within the same suit (starting with a Two in the first column), will be gathered, shuffled with Aces, and redealt.
Only three shuffles of the remaining cards are allowed in Montana Relax, and only one shuffle of the remaining cards are allowed in Montana Classic.
Tips:
We have few really good tips. Just avoid leaving gaps to the right of Kings, and be careful in choosing which deuce you play to an empty space in the first column. Try to think ahead! 
One reader suggested to us that’s it’s not good to finish a row too soon. If you finish a 2-through-King row by placing a King in the 12th column and then deal, you get a gap in the 13th column that is useless to you for the rest of the game. 
Another reader suggests that you should not place too many cards before the final redeal. If the game is mostly finished before the final redeal, you will have few choices after the redeal and a high chance of being stuck. By leaving more cards unplayed, you will get more freedom of choice for your last moves. 
When played as a puzzle game, with unlimited use of the Redo command, Montana is nearly always winnable.
Chance of Winning:
1 in 20 games.
Scoring:
∙ You get one point for each card that is in sequence. The highest possible score is 48 points. 
∙ If you have any shuffle moves remaining, you get an extra 10 points for each one.
∙ If you use the undo button, you lose 2 points. So if you use it three times, you lose a total of 6 points.
∙ When you finish the game, we will calculate your score and rank your performance.

listings.name: Montana (Gaps) Solitaire
listings.description:
Montana Solitaire is also known as Gaps or Spaces.

Object:
To order all of the cards in 4 rows of increasing order from 2 to K, one single suit per row.

Layout:
All 52 cards are dealt face up into 4 rows, 13 cards each, where the cards are not overlapped.
After the dealing the Aces are removed to create 4 blank spaces.

Play:
Any card can be moved to a blank spot, if it is one rank higher than the card to the left of the blank and it is from the same suit.\nClick a blank to fill it, or click on the card you want to move to a space (if the card can be moved).
A space in the first column can only be filled with a Two from any suit.
A King blocks any spaces to the right of the King. You can continue arranging the cards until all moves are blocked by a King.
If all spaces are blocked by a King, press Shuffle Remaining button. All cards, which are not in ascending value within the same suit (starting with a Two in the first column), will be gathered, shuffled with Aces, and redealt.
Only three shuffles of the remaining cards are allowed in Montana Relax, and only one shuffle of the remaining cards are allowed in Montana Classic.

Tips:
We have few really good tips. Just avoid leaving gaps to the right of Kings, and be careful in choosing which deuce you play to an empty space in the first column. Try to think ahead! 
One reader suggested to us that’s it’s not good to finish a row too soon. If you finish a 2-through-King row by placing a King in the 12th column and then deal, you get a gap in the 13th column that is useless to you for the rest of the game. 
Another reader suggests that you should not place too many cards before the final redeal. If the game is mostly finished before the final redeal, you will have few choices after the redeal and a high chance of being stuck. By leaving more cards unplayed, you will get more freedom of choice for your last moves. 
When played as a puzzle game, with unlimited use of the Redo command, Montana is nearly always winnable.

Chance of Winning:
1 in 20 games.

Scoring:
∙ You get one point for each card that is in sequence. The highest possible score is 48 points. 
∙ If you have any shuffle moves remaining, you get an extra 10 points for each one.
∙ If you use the undo button, you lose 2 points. So if you use it three times, you lose a total of 6 points.
∙ When you finish the game, we will calculate your score and rank your performance.

Any feedback, please contact 7saiwen@gmail.com

bluejetty:00119654:ios.description:
Met de app van TCA kun je makkelijk in heel Amsterdam je taxi bestellen. Onze taxi’s staan 24 uur per dag 7 dagen per week voor je klaar. En bijna altijd binnen 5 minuten voor je deur.
Na het downloaden van de app kun je meteen je taxi bestellen. Wanneer je vaker gebruik maakt van de app, kun je gemakkelijk een account aanmaken, zodat je rithistorie bewaard blijft en je favoriete bestemmingen in kunt voeren.
Je kunt gemakkelijk de taxi die je nodig hebt bestellen. Wil je zo snel mogelijk opgehaald worden? Kies voor ‘elk type voertuig’, de snelste optie. Ben je met een groep van 5 tot 8 personen? Kies voor een optie met 6-7 of 8 personen. 
In het scherm zie je hoe lang het duurt voordat de taxi bij je is. Daarbij zie je een indicatie van de ritprijs, de afstand en hoe lang je onderweg bent. Je kunt je taxi uiteraard ook reserveren voor een later tijdstip. Daarnaast kun je aangeven of je veel bagage bij je hebt, een huisdier mee wilt nemen en met hoeveel personen je bent.
Als je je rit hebt besteld, zie je de taxi naar je toe rijden. Daarbij staan jouw chauffeur en auto met kenteken. Na de rit kun je je chauffeur beoordelen.
In een TCA-taxi betaal je zoals je wilt. Met pin, creditcard of cash in de taxi, maar ook met de TCA-app. Voeg je creditcard of Apple pay toe aan je account en betaal je taxi met de app.

bluejetty:00059439:android.description:
Dear passengers!
Sale of tickets for suburban trains. Tickets are sold without commissions. Payment by bank card.
Attention passengers:
1. PASSPORT! Dear passengers, in order to issue a ticket, you REQUIRE AN IDENTITY DETAILS (most often a passport), and during the control en route, you REQUIRE PRESENTATION of the specified DOCUMENT.
Please treat with patience and understanding, since THIS IS A REQUIREMENT OF THE GOVERNING BODIES FOR ISSUING AND CONTROL OF THE ELECTRONIC TICKET (paragraphs 3.1-3.5 of the Order of the Ministry of Transport of Russia dated August 21, 2012 N 322 and paragraphs 78, 82 of the Rules for the carriage of passengers, baggage, cargo luggage by rail).
2. PLEASE BE AUTHORIZED in the application to guarantee the receipt of the ticket.
If the Internet connection is unstable, the ticket may not be downloaded to the device. If you log in, the ticket will be loaded exactly when you enter the "Order History" menu. A copy is always sent to the e-mail specified at the time of purchase.
3. IF THE TICKET ISSUANCE HAS NOT BEEN COMPLETED, and the SMS about the withdrawal of funds has already arrived, BE CALM! The refund will happen automatically within a few minutes.
Please note that banks do not send SMS messages about refunds. To verify the return, please contact tech. support from your bank.
4. For devices with ANDROID version 4.3.0 and below! For reasons beyond our control, it is not possible to purchase tickets on your devices. We apologize for the inconvenience.
5. NO MOSCOW and MOSCOW REGION, Novosibirsk, Rio de Janeiro, Warsaw, Bishkek and Astana in the selection of stations! Stations of those carrier companies that have connected to the application are available in the application.
For a list of available regions and carriers, see the "Regions" section. We really want other companies to also connect to our application for your convenience and we will definitely do this if they show a desire.
6. ISSUANCE OF REDUCED ELECTRONIC TICKETS IS NOT PERFORMED in accordance with clause 77 of the Rules for the carriage of passengers, baggage, cargo luggage by rail.
Application features:
1. Purchase of tickets for suburban trains in 50 regions of Russia.
2. Choice of seats on the luxury trains.
3. Registration of receipts for the transport of bicycles, living creatures and additional. hand luggage.
4. Up-to-date information on the schedule of commuter trains, taking into account all changes.
5. Up-to-date information on fares.
6. Personal account of the passenger with the history of orders.
7. Quick purchase on selected routes.
8. Simplified registration for selected passengers.
9. Linking a bank card.
10. Saving tickets on the device and additional sending to the e-mail specified during the purchase.
11. Electronic Book of Calls with instant sending of photos and text messages on any issues directly to the responsible carrier company.
IT IS NOT NEEDED TO PRINT AN ELECTRONIC TICKET!
At the same time, IT IS REQUIRED TO SAVE THE ELECTRONIC TICKET DIRECTLY ON YOUR DEVICE immediately after purchase, so as not to get into a situation where there is no Internet connection and the ticket cannot be downloaded for control.
Present an electronic ticket and an identity document to the controller on the screen of your device when boarding and on the way of the train.
To pass through the turnstile, bring the barcode on the device screen to the scanner.
Suggestions for improving the work, please send through the section "Book of applications". Please report any bugs through the "Report a bug" section. Each request will be considered.

bluejetty:00089301:ios.description:
Barakat is an excellent grocery delivery app that provides fresh fruits, vegetables, healthy juices, salads, ice creams, juice pops, and more. It is a convenient, user-friendly online grocery store that brings the widest variety of fresh produce from the best sources worldwide. We ensure our products' freshness and premium quality with same-day or next-day delivery via hygienic and food-grade refrigerated vehicles.
Barakat is the one-stop online platform to shop for a vast range of products, including daily groceries, fish, chicken, meat, and organic products, at the best prices. So, get ready to enjoy hassle-free grocery shopping and contactless home delivery with just a click of a button.
Key Features Of the Barakat App:
1. Wide Range Of Products: Barakat products include fresh vegetables, regular & organic vegetables, cut & sanitized vegetables, fresh fruits, cut fruits & fruit platters and fruit baskets, fresh juices, single fruit juices, fresh blends, keto juices, immunity-boosting juice shots, ice-creams, fresh juice popsicles, salads & crudités, dairy & eggs, ready to eat foods, marinated meat, bakery and more.
2. Affordable Prices & Great Offers: You can buy them at low prices with great offers and rewards. Moreover, Barakat Rewards is a program launched to reward loyal Barakat customers, which offers flexibility to earn and spend FreshCoins and access to exclusive deals and freebies when you shop online or refer a friend to shop at Barakat.
3. Assured Quality: We source most of our fruits, vegetables, and other organic products directly from farmers. Furthermore, we ensure that fruits and vegetables are carefully picked, sorted, packed, and home-delivered to ensure they are fresh from the farm to your home daily. 
4. Industry-Level Packaging: You can easily explore our range of fresh milk, cream, yogurt, lassi, paneer, and more. When you buy milk online, there could get spoilt in transit. However, with our industry-level packaging and storing process, your dairy products taste and feel fresh when you open them.
5. Excellent Refund Policy: Barakat is committed to 100% customer satisfaction. If you are unsatisfied with the quality or freshness of the product, return the product at the time of delivery. As our products are perishable so at the time of delivery you can check the goods and if you are not satisfied with our goods you can return them at the same time.
6. Safe Payment Options: Do grocery shopping online on Barakat and pay safely using your VISA or MasterCard credit or debit card in AED.
7. Delivery Locations & Time: Items offered on our website & app are only available for delivery to addresses in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Al Ain & Ajman U.A.E. An estimated delivery time will be provided to you once your order is placed. Delivery times are estimates and commence from the date of shipping rather than the date of order.
About Barakat App:
Barakat started its journey in 1976 with the most humble beginnings in the trade of fresh vegetables and fruits. We strive to be the most trusted source of healthy food in the UAE, with decades of experience sustaining the vibrant international sourcing network for fruits and vegetables of the highest quality standards from the best farms worldwide.
Barakat is the trusted supplier of fresh produce to leading supermarket chains, major airline catering companies, prominent families and other premium entities. Moreover, we value our longstanding and excellent relations with most hospitality and retail sector partners in the UAE. Barakat has ensured that the varied needs of each customer are consistently met with an extensive network of suppliers from around the world.
Reach Out To Us:
Our customer support team is always ready to help you out. So, feel free to contact us anytime at our mail id info@barakatfresh.ae or call us at +800 2272 528.
Download the Barakat app for a seamless and delightful online grocery shopping experience.

bluejetty:00037106:ios.description:
Experience effortless PDF reading, intelligent scanning, and AI-powered editing with PDF Reader, a simple and intuitive app. It offers a centralized hub for scanning, reading, annotating, converting, and managing your documents. Instantly digitize paper files, receipts, notes, and business cards with advanced AI scanning, then edit, convert, and organize them all in one place. Add comments, insert signatures, fill out forms, and complete tasks effortlessly. You can also upload files to the app’s secure cloud, access PDFs from Google Drive and OneDrive, and convert between PDFs and other formats like Word, Excel, images, and more—all in one app available on iPhone and iPad. 
PDF Viewing and Management
-Auto-Discovery: Instantly locates all PDF files on your device.
-Seamless Reading: Open and view PDFs smoothly with adjustable modes.
-Page Navigation: Jump to specific pages instantly.
-Search Functionality: Find files or text in seconds.
-AI Summary: Summarize key points quickly.
-File to PDF: Convert documents, images, and web pages into PDFs.
-PDF to File: Export PDFs to Word, Excel, and images.
-Cloud Backup & Access: Upload, view, and edit files in Google Drive or OneDrive.
-File Management: Rename, delete, organize, and share PDFs effortlessly.
Smart Scanning and Recognition
-AI Scan: Capture paper documents, receipts, notes, and books instantly with your camera.
-Auto Edge Detection: Automatically detects document borders and adjusts angles precisely.
-Image Enhancement: Brightens, sharpens, and removes shadows for perfect scans.
-Batch Scan: Scan multiple pages continuously and combine them into one PDF.
-OCR Recognition: Extract and copy text from scanned pages with one tap.
-AI Classification: Organize scanned files intelligently by type or content.
-Scan to PDF: Instantly convert scans into high-quality PDFs ready for sharing or editing.
Practical Editing Features
-Annotate PDFs: Highlight, underline, and strikethrough key content.

bluejetty:00173207:ios.description:
Available exclusively for Netflix members.
Become an unsung hero. Solve puzzles, fly above chaos and heal the wounded in this follow-up to the beloved adventure game inspired by World War I.
As World War I rages on, two brothers fight to survive the trenches and find each other again. Their paths will cross with new heroes who will share in the joy of reuniting and surviving the horrors of the Western Front.
Valiant Hearts: Coming Home is the second installment of the BAFTA Award-winning game Valiant Hearts: The Great War. This sequel will follow in the footsteps of the original game and continue to tell stories of ordinary people thrust into the extraordinary circumstances of World War I.
Features: 
• An animated graphic novel-style adventure: From the depths of the sea and the raging skies to the trenches of the Western Front, immerse yourself in an artistically unique and touching emotional experience.
• Play four unsung heroes: As their destinies cross, help each of these characters survive the horrors of the trenches alongside their faithful canine companion.
• A mix of exploration, action and puzzles: Experience different types of gameplay as you progress through the story — solve puzzles, sneak through enemy lines, fly above the chaos, heal the wounded and even play music.
• Survive the Great War: In this fictional story, you will revisit historical locations and battles of World War I. Emerge from the sea into the middle of the Jutland naval battle, relive the Meuse-Argonne offensive and experience the long-awaited relief of the Armistice.
• Learn more about World War I: Historical facts and authentic pictures provide detailed information about key events during these tumultuous times, with a special focus on the Harlem Hellfighters. More than just a game, this interactive history comes alive.
- From Ubisoft and Old Skull Games.

bluejetty:00122484:ios.description:
WHERE YOUR MONEY WORKS IN YOUR FAVOUR
Your money should do more than sit in your account.
Kroo Bank helps it work harder with variable interest on your current account balance, while giving you simple tools to spend, save and stay in control.
No monthly fees. No minimum balance. Just banking designed to help your money go further.
INTEREST FOR YOU
With a Kroo Bank current account, you'll earn variable interest on balances up to £500,000, paid monthly.
You don't need to move your money into separate savings accounts because we pay interest on your current account balance
When you're ready to save even more, you can open a Flexible Cash ISA in the same app.
AER (Annual Equivalent Rate) shows what you'd earn over a year if interest was paid on top of interest. Gross is the contractual rate of interest.
INTUITIVE BANKING
Everything you need to stay on top of your money.
• Real-time spending insights
• Automatic transaction categories
• Instant notifications
• Track, split and settle shared expenses
• Freeze and unfreeze your card in seconds
Simple banking that helps you feel more in control.
ZERO FEES ABROAD
Spend with your Kroo debit card anywhere Visa is accepted without foreign spending fees.
Keep more of your money where it belongs - with you.
We won't charge you for overseas ATM withdrawals either, although some ATM providers may charge their own fee.
NO MONTHLY ACCOUNT FEES
Open and manage your current account with no monthly account fee.
Manage your everyday banking, earn interest on your balance and access products including:
• Current Account
• Flexible Cash ISA
• Personal Loans (subject to eligibility)
Simple products. Clearly explained.
BANK WITH CONFIDENCE
Eligible deposits are protected by the Financial Services Compensation Scheme (FSCS) up to £120,000 per customer.
Protect your account with:
• Face ID and Touch ID
• Multi-factor authentication
• Instant card controls
• UK-based customer support
KROO & APPLE PAY
Add your Kroo card to Apple Pay for an easy, secure and private way to pay.
OUR PURPOSE
Who you bank with matters.
We're building a bank that helps people grow their money with confidence through simple products, fair value and banking that's designed to work in your favour.
Our customer privacy policy can be viewed here: https://www.kroo.com/customer-privacy-notice
Kroo Bank Ltd is authorised by the Prudential Regulation Authority and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority and the Prudential Regulation Authority (FRN 953772).
Current account applications and account management are available through the app only.
* The current AER / gross variable rate is shown in our app and on our website

bluejetty:00065192:ios.description:
The Park State Bank App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact Park State Bank customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the Park State Bank App, you must be enrolled as a Park State Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00115301:ios.description:
【Serene Seek & Spot: The Calming Visual Puzzle Game】
Say goodbye to cluttered, noisy screens! This is a hidden object game unlike any other, featuring a minimalist, artistic style and clean, therapeutic visuals that will transport you to a world of peaceful puzzling. It's not just a way to train your observation skills; it’s your best escape for relaxation and stress relief.
【Simple Design, Ultimate Visual Delight】
The game features a unique hand-drawn illustration style with soft colors and clear outlines. You won't have to strain your eyes to pick out complex details—just immerse yourself in the clean, visually pleasing scenes. Every successful find feels like completing a beautiful piece of art, offering pure visual satisfaction.
【Focus Your Mind, Achieve "Flow" State】
Hundreds of meticulously designed levels offer a gentle test of your concentration and detail-spotting ability. With no timer in a relaxed atmosphere, you can take your time to explore and gradually sharpen your observation skills. This is more than just finding objects; it’s a mindfulness exercise designed to calm your brain.
【Key Features for a Seamless Experience】
Stress-Free Mode: No timer and unlimited hints mean you can completely relax and enjoy the process of seeking, rather than worrying about the clock.
Crystal Clear Visuals: Thanks to the flat, minimalist design, the hidden object outlines are crisp. Easily zoom in and out to focus on the fun of finding, while avoiding visual fatigue.
Regular Updates: New themed scenes and levels are added consistently to keep the game fresh and exciting for long-term play.
【Let's 'Find Fast'!】
Download now and begin your serene seek-and-spot journey! Let this therapeutic puzzle game become your go-to "digital palette" for daily relaxation.

bluejetty:00135506:ios.description:
The workout tracker featured by Apple and trusted by 15M+ lifters. Rated 4.9 on the App Store. 112M+ workouts logged in 2025 alone.
Log every set, follow any program or split, and track your lifts and volume. Learn how to do any exercise with high-quality videos and step-by-step instructions. Free, with no ads.
Train alongside millions of lifters, follow friends and family, compare your stats, and share your progress in their feed.
No program? No problem. Whether you're new and overwhelmed or a gym veteran, browse Hevy's large, free library for a full split or individual workouts.
And now, Hevy Trainer gives you the coaching you need, available with Hevy Pro. It builds a program tailored to your experience, goal, available equipment, and preferences. Trainer tracks your progress and consistency, and guides you through each workout with tips and progressive overload. (Even if you only have dumbbells and a workout mat.)
WHY HEVY?
• Log weights, reps, duration, and RPE in seconds without breaking the flow of your sets.
• See last session's weights and reps for every exercise, right where you need them. No guessing, no scrolling back through history.
• Log supersets, drop sets, warm-ups, and failure sets alongside your regular sets.
• Stay on track with automatic rest timers between sets.
• Monitor your strength progression and PRs with graphs for every exercise.
• Add progress photos, body weight, and measurements to see how your training is paying off.
• Follow friends and athletes from around the world, see their workouts in your feed, and compare your lifts.
• Stay consistent with monthly, yearly, and multi-year calendars and streak tracking.
• Work out offline. Your data syncs across all your devices.
• Automatically sync your workouts to Strava for hybrid training.
APPLE WATCH
• Log sets, start rest timers, and finish your workout without touching your phone.
• Monitor your heart rate during your workout.
• Add Hevy complications to your watch face.
• Workouts save automatically when your watch reconnects to your phone.
Hevy uses HealthKit and CareKit to export your workouts to the Health app. You can turn this on in Settings.
WHAT OTHERS ARE SAYING
"Hevy blends workout tracking with social motivation, making it a top pick if you thrive on accountability and community support." Men's Journal
"By far my favorite workout tracking app." The Morning Show Podcast
"I've experimented with enough strength training apps that I know which ones are out there, and I definitely have a favorite: It's Hevy." Beth Skwarecki, senior health editor, Lifehacker
Whether you work out at home or at the gym, want to build muscle or lose fat, train twice a week or every day, Hevy is the last workout tracker you'll ever need. Give it a try.
HEVY PRO
• Hevy Trainer: a program and ongoing guidance based on your experience, goal, available equipment, and preferences.
• Unlimited routines and custom exercises.
• Your complete training history.
If you choose to purchase Hevy Pro, payment will be charged to your Apple account, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage your subscription and turn off automatic renewal at any time in your Apple account settings. You have the right to withdraw from your initial subscription within 14 days of starting it. If you don't purchase Hevy Pro, you can keep using Hevy for free.
Terms & Conditions: https://www.hevyapp.com/app-terms-conditions/
Privacy Policy: https://www.hevyapp.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00022639:ios.description:
Prospect Equities® Mobile Real Estate brings the most accurate and up-to-date real estate information right to your phone! With Prospect Equities® Mobile Real Estate, you have access to all homes for sale and rent, including MLS listings and our Private Inventory throughout Northern Illinois, New York City, South Florida, West & Central Florida, and the Phoenix Metro, including some International Properties.
Use Prospect Equities Mobile Real Estate anytime, anywhere to pull up homes for sale or rent around you using your current location, or find homes based on address, city or zip code using our smart search. Prospect Equities Mobile Real Estate will show you all the details you want to know about a property, including price, square footage, estimated mortgage, taxes, features, descriptions, pictures, maps and more! Save your favorite homes to view later. You can also text or email homes to your family and friends.
Some exciting app features include:
- A high-end search engine
- Gorgeous, high-resolution photographs
- Access to our Private Inventory
- For Sale or For Rent Search Options
- Geo Location to search properties nearest you
- Photo Slideshow of Listings
- Clear and easy to read listing details
- Pinpoint listings on map
- Mortgage Calculator
- Instant Directions to Listings
- Ability to share listings
- View Open Houses in your area
- Recommend Listings Pushed to your phone
- Data Driven Listing Matches
- New to Market Properties
- Price Reduction Listings
- Direct access to your Prospect Equities Agent
Prospect Equities Real Estate specializes in the following cities and neighborhoods:
Chicago, Lincoln Park, Lakeview, Gold Coast, Streeterville, South Loop, West Loop, River North, Oak Brook, Hinsdale, Barrington, Glenview, Naperville, Orland Park, New York City, Brooklyn, Bronx, Queens, Long Island, Westchester, Scottsdale, Phoenix, Paradise Valley, Glendale, Chandler, San Tan, Mesa, Biltmore, Miami, Coral Gables, Miami Beach, Edgewater, Fort Lauderdale, Bal Harbour, Brickell, Fisher Island, Tampa, St Petersburg, Clearwater, Harbor Island, Orlando.
If you have questions or want a tour of the home for sale, press the “Contact” feature to call or email a Prospect Equities Mobile Real Estate representative who can assist you.

bluejetty:00133674:ios.summary: This game will allow you to easily create paradigm models & new faces of people. You can explore your creativity with this pottery game. You might create a multitude of sculptures for business purposes & sell them out. Pottery making, paint
bluejetty:00133674:ios.description:
This game will allow you to easily create paradigm models & new faces of people. You can explore your creativity with this pottery game. You might create a multitude of sculptures for business purposes & sell them out. Pottery making, painting & character creation have never been easy.
Still, you can mold the face of people with this face game. The model will be presented in front of you. All you have to do is just use blender skills & make a new cute character with this clay game. You can test your abilities as a digital sculpt maker. 
How to Play: 
A pottery graphic will be presented in front of you.
The dough of clay/slime will be used to shape the heads of people.
Draw a face using set points.
Make sure to draw the character exactly or similar to the graphic shown & create a piece of squishy magic.
Features: 
- Amazing 3D graphic illustration.
- One of the most satisfying & relaxing games with the ASMR slime simulator.
- Express your creativity with this pottery game.
- You can release your stress with this soothing game which has ASMR effects.
Check whether you have ceramic character builder art in you or not. Download & play this game & be the masterpiece of your generated art.

bluejetty:00162625:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00162625:ios.description:
Ricardo – buy and sell on Switzerland’s online marketplace
Ricardo is one of Switzerland’s most trusted online marketplace platforms to buy and sell second-hand items. Discover over 3 million items, connect with millions of members, and find special offers starting at CHF 1.-.
Whether you want to buy second-hand, sell items, or browse for inspiration, Ricardo brings everything together in one simple, secure, and sustainable experience.
Discover over 3 million items
Explore one of the largest Swiss second-hand marketplaces with listings across every category:
Home accessories and balcony ideas on a budget
Clothing, from women’s spring jackets to men’s linen shirts
Second-hand summer dresses and affordable festival outfits
Baby items and used spring children’s clothing
Electronics, smartphones, and electric coolers
Vintage accessories for summer outfits, including vintage sunglasses
Used garden furniture, terrace lounge furniture, and garden lounge sets
Cars, including your next pre-owned car
Toys, collectibles, and more
From Swiss second-hand fashion to furniture for moving, Ricardo is your marketplace for everyday finds and occasional purchases.
Buy the way you like:
Auction: Join auctions and bid to get the best price
Buy now: Secure your item instantly at a fixed price
Make an offer: Send a price suggestion and get a response within 48 hours
From lightweight spring shoes and second-hand sandals to a complete pre-owned summer wardrobe, BBQ accessories or a gas barbecue with accessories – you’ll find it here.
Sell items easily:
Want to sell second-hand items? With Ricardo, you can:
Sell clothing or refresh your wardrobe
Sell baby clothes and baby items
Sell household items during a move
Sell furniture or a pre-owned car
Create a listing in minutes, upload photos, and start selling. Reach millions of potential buyers across Switzerland and sell items quickly and easily.
A safe Swiss marketplace:
Ricardo has been a trusted online marketplace for over 25 years. Safety and reliability come first.
With Buyer Protection+, your payment is secure until you confirm you’ve received your item.
Pay the way you prefer: TWINT, Apple Pay, Google Pay, debit or credit card.
Smart shopping with Ricardo AI:
Take a photo of an item
Upload an image
Discover similar listings in seconds
Ricardo AI helps you find items faster with smart, intuitive search.
Save money and earn money:
Find special offers and auctions starting at CHF 1.-. Save money when you buy second-hand, and earn money when you sell items you no longer use.
Sustainable and local:
Buying and selling second-hand extends the life of items and reduces waste. Every purchase and sale supports a more sustainable way to shop in Switzerland.
Never miss a deal:
Save items, sellers, or searches and get notified when new listings go live. With the Ricardo app, your online marketplace is always with you.
Why Ricardo?
Millions of members
Over 3 million listings
Auction and buy now options
Trusted Swiss online marketplace
Buy and sell across Switzerland
Second-hand and new items in one place
Deals starting at CHF 1.-
Customer support
Customer support in Switzerland:
Tel. 0842 950 950 (Mon–Fri: 9:00–11:30 / 13:00–16:30, closed on public holidays in the Canton of Zug)
Support form: https://help.ricardo.ch/hc/en/requests/new
More information:
Terms and conditions: https://help.ricardo.ch/hc/de/articles/115002934305-AGB-und-Reglemente 
Privacy policy: https://help.ricardo.ch/hc/de/articles/4417494500498-Datenschutzerkl%C3%A4rung-SMG-Swiss-Marketplace-Group-AG

bluejetty:00068085:ios.name: GetWardrobe Outfit Planner
bluejetty:00068085:ios.summary:
Your AI-powered wardrobe app — closet organizer and outfit planner trusted by 3 million users since 2013.
Plan what to wear, create stunning outfit collages, organize your closet digitally, and get AI-generated outfit ideas from your own c
bluejetty:00068085:ios.description:
Your AI-powered wardrobe app — closet organizer and outfit planner trusted by 3 million users since 2013.
Plan what to wear, create stunning outfit collages, organize your closet digitally, and get AI-generated outfit ideas from your own clothes. Synced across iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Web.
GetWardrobe turns your phone into a smart digital closet. Add your clothes, and AI automatically detects the category, color, and suggests a name — so cataloguing takes seconds, not minutes. Whether you're building a capsule wardrobe, packing for a trip, or deciding what to wear tomorrow, GetWardrobe has you covered.
FREE FOREVER — NO TIME LIMITS
Your free closet includes everything you need:
– Up to 100 items (clothes and outfits) with no expiration
– AI BACKGROUND REMOVAL: Photograph any item and the AI removes the background automatically (advanced precision available with Premium)
– AI STUDIO: Generate outfits one by one from your wardrobe — free and unlimited
– AI OUTFIT GENERATOR (Starter): Get 10 AI-curated outfits per run, filtered by weather, occasion, and mood — unlimited free runs
– STORE IMPORT: Add items from online stores with brand, price, and product link saved automatically
– OUTFIT EDITOR: Drag, layer, and resize clothes on a canvas to create magazine-style collages
– WARDROBE ORGANIZER: Sort by category, brand, color, season, weather, tags, and more
– OUTFIT CALENDAR with local weather — plan what to wear for the week ahead
– STYLE STATISTICS: See what you wear most, what's sitting unused, and your wardrobe's estimated value
– EXPLORE COMBINATIONS: Swipe through item pairings and save the ones you love
– CLOUD SYNC across all your devices
– SIZES NOTEBOOK: Record how each brand fits you for smarter shopping
– CAPSULE WARDROBES: Build focused capsules for work, travel, seasons, or any goal
– ADVANCED SEARCH: AND/OR filters to find exactly the right piece
– WEATHER FORECAST: Daily forecasts with outfit & clothing suggestions based on conditions
– DARK MODE: Full dark theme across the entire app
– SHARE: Publish your OOTD lookbook to social media or the GetWardrobe community
AI CREDITS
Pay-as-you-go AI features — no subscription needed:
– AI OUTFIT GENERATOR (Standard & Pro): Generate 20–30 outfits per run with the most advanced AI models
– VIRTUAL TRY-ON: See how outfits look on you before getting dressed — powered by AI
– AI IMAGE ENHANCER: Turn phone photos into professional wardrobe shots automatically
GETWARDROBE PREMIUM
Unlock your full closet potential:
– UNLIMITED WARDROBE: Add every item you own with no limits
– FAMILY WARDROBE: Organize and create outfits for family members from a single account
– PACKING LISTS: Build smart packing lists sorted by trip purpose, destination weather, and weight
– STYLIST ACCESS: Give a professional stylist read or edit access to your closet
– ADVANCED STATS: Cost-per-wear, most-used combinations, wardrobe value, and utilization insights
– BULK EDITING: Update multiple items or outfits at once
– ARCHIVE: Store off-season or retired items without deleting them
WHY GETWARDROBE?
– On the App Store since 2013 — continuously updated
– 3M+ users across 39 countries
– Works offline and syncs when you're back online
– Your data stays private — your wardrobe belongs to you
– Cross-platform: iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Web
FOR STYLISTS: Manage multiple clients with a professional dashboard — create accounts, send branded invitations, and share recommendations. Your subscription unlocks Premium for all your clients.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION:
GetWardrobe Premium is available as a monthly or annual subscription. Subscription renews automatically unless turned off at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel anytime in Account Settings.
Privacy Policy: https://getwardrobe.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://getwardrobe.com/terms-of-service
Need help? support@getwardrobe.com

bluejetty:00182729:ios.description:
[Feature]
SPIRITS WITH COLORFUL PERSONALITIES
Travel back to the capital in the Heian Period and soak in the quirky and touching stories of spirits. 
NEW CHARACTER UNLOCKS NEW GAMEPLAY
New gameplay upgrades follow each new shikigami. Experience the myriad gameplay and get rich rewards!
DIVERSE TROOPS TACTICS
Some damages both the enemy and the friendly. Some dutifully guard their teammates. Bring on a different Shikigami, you’ll have a whole different battle.
CUSTOMIZE SOUL CONFIGURATION
Crit, ATK, DEF, immunity, SPD, controlling, HP...... Equipping different souls, a shikigami will have very different performances. 
ALL-STAR VOICE CAST AND SOUNDTRACK
Top Japanese voice actors delivered stunningly convincing performance for the spirits. On top of that, master composers Shigeru Umebayashi has created dozens of soundtracks to recreate the classic Japanese ambience.
TOP-OF-THE-LINE EXQUISITE GRAPHICS
With exquisite graphics of the Japanese Ukiyo-e art genre, each interface is scenery straight out of paintings. 
[Background]
In a time when demons and humans coexisted… Evil spirits from the underworld have begun a quest for power, strength, and dominance. The balance between the two worlds is now in jeopardy. 
Fortunately, there's a group of gifted humans who can read the stars and draw amulets. They have the power to connect the two worlds, and even tame the spirits. They are willing to lay everything on the line to maintain peace and order between the two worlds. They are known as Onmyoji. 
The gate to this magical world of spirits and beauty will now open for you…
[Awards]
App Store 10 Best Apps/Games of the Year
Facebook's 2016 Game of the Year: Best Mobile Game
200+ million downloads smash hit now available worldwide!
[Follow us]
Twitter:https://twitter.com/Onmyojigame
For customer support, you can submit your questions in-game or contact:
gameonmyoji@global.netease.com
[Apple Subscription Service]
Onmyoji allows you to subscribe in Fortune Hut, the subscription will automatically renew after the specified period unless otherwise canceled.
The following subscription is available: 
*Soul bond - $2.99 (it lasts 7 days will automatically renew each week for $2.99) 
*Growth Fund – $14.99 (it lasts 30 days and will automatically renew every 30 days for $14.99)
- After you successfully subscribed, 24 hours before each expiration time, a subscription fee will be deducted from your iTunes account automatically to renew your subscription to the next expiration date.
- To make this possible, you have to enable your iTunes account and link your game account with the account, and allow the game to deduct the aforementioned fee from your account. 
- One iTunes account can only subscribe to each subscription pack once per each subscription period for one game account.
[About Unsubscribe, Resubscribe]
1. Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to Account Settings after purchase. If you do not unsubscribe at least 24 hours before the billing period expires, it will automatically renew and debit.
2.If you unsubscribe before the subscription expires and you want to resubscribe it again, please manually open the Settings on your iOS device --> Tap on your Apple ID--> Go to the iTunes& App Store --> Tap on your Apple ID, and select View Apple ID, go to the Account settings page, tap Subscriptions, select Onmyoji to resubscribe.
Please check for the Privacy Policy and User Agreement of Onmyoji.
Privacy Policy: https://en.onmyojigame.com/regulation/2019/09/03/31459_830860.html
User Agreement: https://en.onmyojigame.com/regulation/2019/09/03/31459_830863.html

bluejetty:00162635:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00162635:ios.description:
Delimobil — your car rental for urban freedom.
Renting cars with Delimobil is modern carsharing that combines the convenience of car rental with the flexibility of urban mobility. Take a car for a minute, an hour, a day, or even several days—without worrying about fuel, insurance, washing, or parking. Delimobil is your car when you need it, with no extra costs. Car rental has become simpler and more accessible.
・50% off your first ride.
Activate the promo code «ЕДЕМ» during registration and start your car rental cheaper!
・Why Delimobil is the best choice?
Short-term rental: from minutes to days—pay only for the time you use. 
Wide selection of cars: economy, comfort, premium, and electric vehicles. 
Urban mobility: an alternative to taxis and public transport—drive yourself. 
No hidden fees: fuel, insurance, parking, and maintenance are included in the price. 
Intercity and travel: pick up a car in one city, end your rental in another.
Personalization: tariffs adapt to your driving style—drive carefully, pay less.
・How to start renting with Delimobil? 
Download the app.
Register: provide your phone number and email.
Upload photos of your passport and driver’s license.
Wait for quick verification.
Open the map, find the nearest car, and book it. 
Unlock the car via the app and hit the road.
End your rental with one click: park in a permitted zone and close the rental in the app.
Payment is automatically charged from your linked card.
・Where does Delimobil operate?
Car rental is available in 18 cities in Russia:
Moscow
Saint Petersburg
Kazan
Yekaterinburg 
Novosibirsk
Sochi
Ufa
Rostov-on-Don
Samara
Togliatti
Tula
Nizhny Novgorod
Perm
Krasnodar
Yaroslavl
and others
・Advantages of Delimobil carsharing
For all ages: rental is available for drivers from 18 years old.
Freedom of choice: from short trips to long journeys.
GPS tracker and locator: an interactive map helps you find a car within walking distance.
Savings: pay only for rental time, with no surcharges like in taxis.
Premium cars: luxurious BMW, Audi, Mercedes for special occasions.
Hassle-free: forget about washing, insurance, parking, or repairs.
Mobility without ownership: carsharing replaces a personal car.
Convenience: with the rent option, you can book a car in advance for a chosen date, and we’ll deliver it straight to your address.
・Flexible tariffs for any task
Minutes: for quick city trips.
Hours: for business meetings or shopping.
Days: perfect for out-of-town trips or travel.
Fixed: a set price for a pre-planned route.
Intercity: rent a car between cities—pick up in Moscow, end in Kazan.
Rent: order car delivery to your address.
Corporate: a dedicated fleet for your business with a buyout option.
Subscription: join Deliclub and get 20% cashback on every ride.
・Safety and reliability
User data is protected with modern encryption.
All cars undergo regular maintenance.
Strict compliance with personal data protection laws.
・Navigation and convenience
The app offers a photo search feature, allowing you to see the previous booking’s photo to orient yourself and find the right car on the street.
With geolocation and GPS tracking, you can easily find the nearest car. The interactive map shows available vehicles and rental end zones.
・Delimobil — more than carsharing.
If you love a specific car, you can buy it.
With Delimobil, you can retain ownership of the car with the "Forever" tariff, making payments over time.
・Corporate carsharing — save on employee trips by connecting your company for corporate rides: 
Your personal fleet.
Buyout option for you.
Placement of your advertising on our cars.
・Download Delimobil now.
Renting with Delimobil is more than just a car rental—it’s your key to urban mobility, letting you feel the real thrill. Your perfect carsharing awaits you.

bluejetty:00167213:ios.description:
Join the adventure in Pony Tales: Magic Horse World! Whispering Willow… a land where adventure and friendship await at every corner! But things are not as they used to be… this once beautiful world is in trouble, and covered in a dark magic known as The Darkness. The animals have left the forest, hope is fading… But you, young pony, may be the last hope for the land…
Explore a Magical World
Discover the vibrant landscapes of Whispering Willow Forest, the charming Fairy Village, and the mystical Fairy Dust Glitterfalls. Each area is filled with little secrets, puzzles, and treasures waiting to be discovered. Bounce on oversized mushrooms, explore hidden coves, and navigate through treetop pathways. Every corner of the forest offers a new adventure.
Engage in Epic Quests
Build your friendship with the Guardian Fairies - they will help you uncover the mysteries of the forest. Use your unique abilities like Earth’s Ground Shake, Wind’s Double Jump, Fire’s Fireball, and Water’s Aqua Bubble to collect crystals, solve puzzles, rescue animals, and restore the Prism of Harmony.
The Cutest Ponies!
Your dream pony awaits! Collect special skins, unicorns and flying horses as you progress through the game! Dress up your pony in different outfits and accessories to stand out in the magical world.
Exciting Mini-Games
Enjoy fun and challenging mini-games that test your skills and earn stars to unlock new levels and items. Collecting Crystalline Essences help you upgrade your abilities and battle The Darkness!
Multiplayer Fun
Team up with friends or make new ones as you explore the world together and compete in exciting events in this MMO. Experience the wonder of a rainbow bridge that adds a touch of magic to your journey.
Not Just a Fairy Tale
Follow four unique quest lines, each focusing on a different element: Earth, Wind, Fire, and Water. Unlock new abilities and complete quests to restore the Prism of Harmony.
Beautiful Graphics
Enjoy stunning 3D graphics that bring the magical world to life. From the lush forests to the sparkling waterfalls, every scene is designed to captivate. Experience the wonder of a rainbow bridge that adds a touch of magic to your journey.
Skill Tree Progression
Enhance your pony's abilities through a detailed skill tree. Choose from Earth, Wind, Fire, and Water skills, each offering unique powers and quests. Level up your skills by completing specific quests and unlock new abilities to aid in your adventure.
Rainbow Pony and the other ponies are here to guide you through the challenges, ensuring that your journey is as magical as it is exciting.
Download for free today and start your magical journey as a princess pony in this 3D MMO adventure!

Our privacy policy can be found at:

bluejetty:00186879:ios.description:
Did you know you can start helping to build your baby’s brain as soon as he or she is born? Did you know that the more parents talk to their babies the better they can learn? Did you know hearing more language helps babies learn to read when they get older? Beginning with Babble is a free app for parents with a child between the age of 0-5 that sends you fun TIPS about interacting with your child to help him/her learn more about the world around them. Beginning with Babble will show you how interacting and talking with your baby everyday sets your child up for success! The TIPS share ideas about how you can help your child hear language that is just right for his/her age while you play with your baby. 
Beginning with Babble was created with busy parents in mind!
- TIPS written by nationwide experts in language
- TIPS are age appropriate and the app grows with your child from 0-5 years old
- Fun TIPS fit your busy schedule- you choose when you get TIPS and how many you get
- You can try TIPS using things around your house
- TIPS are fun for you and your baby!
- Watch your baby Learn – Laugh – and Smile with you as you use your tips!
- TIPS are easy to access! You can read listen to or watch videos of TIPS
- Vote for your favorite TIPS!

bluejetty:00128269:ios.description:
The ONLY dinosaur game starring your child! Perfect for dino loving toddlers - play and learn as you race, chase, and fly with your favorite dinosaurs. Hunt for T-rex eggs, fly Pteranodons, race Velociraptors and sort dino bones. Match shapes in dino puzzles and play dinosaur memory games. Just add your toddler's face - they love being the star of their very own Dino Park! "Lovely for personalization and engaging children." Literacy Trust Best Apps
Build your favorite dinosaurs in drag and drop puzzles, with hundreds of named dino puzzle pieces. You’ll have the best dinosaur vocabulary in town! After every puzzle, play exciting dinosaur games. Drive your monster truck to rescue T-Rex eggs, then hop into the saddle and fly Pteranodons! Sort dino bones and race with Velociraptors. Learn about dinosaurs and develop early years skills - speech, sorting, counting, concentration - in brilliant imaginative role play games. Great for all dino-loving preschoolers aged 2 to 6 years old.
Fun stuff - and sshhh, educational too :)
• Drag and drop dino shape puzzles to build your dinosaurs and prehistoric world
• Starring your child at the heart of all the action - or you can use photos of Grandma, Daddy, or your favorite pet or teddy! You get to choose the star of the show :)
• Play with favorite dinosaurs - Pteranodon, Tyrannosaurus rex, Velociraptor, Triceratops, Gallimimus, Parasaurolophus, Ankylosaurus, Mosasaurus, Alamosaurus, Spinosaurus and Oviraptor.
• Develop preschool skills in the dino bone sorting game
• Play dinosaur memory games, a fun way to improve concentration
• Imaginative role play - be a Dino Park Ranger and a paleontologist
• Add photo faces from your camera roll and then have fun choosing from over 30 hairstyles, 15 hair colours and 4 skin tones
• Great for toddlers and preschoolers, ages 2-6 years old
Play today in this free version, which comes with the Pteranodon flying puzzle and game, plus the character-creator so you can add your child’s face. Unlock access to the whole Dinosaur Park with a single in-app purchase, which is behind a parent lock.
We're parents too, so we take children’s privacy and wellness very seriously. Our app has no ads, and a single in-app purchase behind a parent lock.
• Explore at your own pace, no rules or time pressures
• No internet needed - perfect to play on road trips and flights
• Easy enough to play alone, perfect to play together for super-charged fun learning :)
OkiPlay is a family games studio, devoted to learning and play. Our preschool apps are loved & trusted by parents, grandparents, teachers and children all over the world. Here's what they say about OkiPlay:
* “I love this app because it works on fine motor skills with puzzle building.”
* "I am a Speech-Language Pathologist working with 3-5 year olds. They are very engaged and love being a part of the game."
* "All excellent apps... they are very interactive and it's brilliant how you can choose different family members to feature in them."
* "Absolutely gorgeous - both our children were totally captivated by this app ...the personalization feature is fantastic, and the graphics are charming."
* "My daughter squeals with delight at the sound of the app opening. She has a blast while developing her fine motor skills."
* "Thank you so much for creating something so adorable and educational for little ones."

bluejetty:00023418:ios.summary: Together with Kid-E-Cats and other characters of the famous animated series we’ll build a real house for a family of cats. All your building skills will definitely come in handy for us. A great range of building vehicles and fantastic ideas
bluejetty:00023418:ios.description:
Together with Kid-E-Cats and other characters of the famous animated series we’ll build a real house for a family of cats. All your building skills will definitely come in handy for us. A great range of building vehicles and fantastic ideas!:)
Educational games with kittens and vehicles for toddlers train memory, fine motor skills and communication skills.
Let's help your favorite heroes build their own home! In the game we will go through all the stages of construction with both adult cats and kitty cats. Everyone will get a task that fits the skills!
To build the House for Kid-E-Cats we need construction vehicles: bulldozer, crane, truck and others!
Let's dive into the process of building a house! Miu-miu-miu!
Together with Kid-E-Cats we’ll assemble cars out of puzzles, refuel the vehicles and rush to the race!
Each level of the game has its own puzzles and its own car, its own races and tasks for getting more and more resources.
The house will grow from the foundation to the roof really fast provided we:
-clear a site to build a house
-drive the piles
-pour the concrete foundation
-lay pipes
-install a fireplace, a chimney and a brick house foundation
-put the roof on
-install and paint the windows
-plant trees and bushes
-and also…build a large playground for Kid-E-Cats!
Assembling puzzles, swiping while washing and tapping while playing perfectly develop fine motor skills and kids’ attention.
Kid-E-Cats are now known not only for casting in the animated series but also for featuring as nice helpers in the educational children's game!
Cool construction equipment which helps to recreate almost realistic building construction and action-packed mini-games make everyone get involved into carefree playing!
Boys and girls, humans and cats - we’ll build a House for Kid-E-Cats!

KREAM은 지금 가장 트렌디한 상품을 사고파는 트렌드 커머스 플랫폼이에요.
스니커즈, 패션, 명품, 트레이딩카드, 레고, 피규어 등 
오늘 발매된 신상품부터 피드에 자주 보이는 화제의 아이템까지.
지금 KREAM 앱을 다운로드하고, 주목받는 트렌드 아이템을 만나보세요.
• 가입만 해도, 살 때도 혜택
첫 구매 시 쿠폰팩을 증정해 드려요. 정가보다 저렴한 상품을 한눈에 확인하고, 가장 합리적인 가격으로 구매하세요.
• 패션을 뛰어넘어 트레이딩카드, 명품까지 쉽게 거래하기
나이키, 크롬하츠, 산산기어 등 인기 브랜드 상품부터 포켓몬 카드, 롤렉스, 금/은까지 다양한 상품을 한눈에 살펴보세요.
• 최신 트렌드와 팬덤 놀이터
요즘 핫한 디저트, 최신 발매 콜라보, 애니메이션 굿즈까지. KREAM에서만 구할 수 있는 한정판 아이템을 만나보세요.
• 안심할 수 있는 정품 거래
거래가 체결된 모든 상품은 KREAM 검수센터에서 전문 검수팀이 철저하게 검수해요. 정품이 아닐 경우 구매가의 3배를 보상해 드려요.
• 똑똑한 판매와 구매
실시간 시세를 확인하고 원하는 가격을 직접 제안하세요. 구매도 판매도, 내가 원하는 가격으로 설정할 수 있어요.
• 오늘 결제하면 내일 도착
'빠른배송'이 표시된 상품은 바로 내일 도착해요. 필요한 순간 가장 빠르게 받아보세요.
KREAM에서는 아래와 같은 이유로 접근 권한을 요청하고 있어요.
[선택 접근 권한]
카메라 : 프로필 사진 촬영, 이미지 검색 사진 촬영
마이크 : 동영상 소리 녹음
사진 : 스타일 피드 작성
앱이 활동을 추적하도록 허용 : 개인화(맞춤형) 광고 제공
선택 접근 권한을 허용하지 않더라도 서비스의 이용은 가능해요.
단, 해당 접근 권한이 필요한 기능은 허용 전까지 사용할 수 없어요.

bluejetty:00073252:ios.description:
Protect your online accounts with the Authenticator App, a fast, secure, and privacy-focused two-factor authentication (2FA) app for iPhone and iPad. This app generates one-time verification codes (TOTP) for all your favorite services, helping safeguard your accounts against unauthorized access.
Whether you are switching from Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, or another authenticator app, importing and managing your accounts is quick and effortless.
Setting up your accounts takes only seconds. Simply scan a QR code, import from a photo, or enter your account details manually. No account creation or sign-up is required.
Built with privacy in mind, your authentication codes remain under your control. With optional iCloud Keychain backup and sync, you can securely restore your accounts when upgrading to a new iPhone or replacing a lost device.
Why choose the Authenticator App?
- Fast QR code scanning
- Import codes from photos or add them manually
- Compatible with all standard TOTP and HOTP authentication services
- Face ID protection for secure access
- App passcode lock for additional security
- Secure iCloud Keychain backup and sync across your Apple devices
- Works offline after setup
- No intrusive advertisements
- We do not collect or sell your personal data
- Clean, modern, and easy-to-use interface
Compatible with thousands of services
The Authenticator App works with virtually every service that supports two-factor authentication (2FA), including email providers, social media platforms, cloud storage, financial services, developer platforms, cryptocurrency exchanges, gaming accounts, and more.
As long as a service supports standard QR-code based authentication, it will work with the Authenticator App.
Download the app today and protect your digital life with secure two-factor authentication.
Subscription Information
The Authenticator App is free to download, with optional premium features available through auto-renewing subscriptions.
- Monthly: $9.99/month
- Yearly: $39.99/year
Payment will be charged to your Apple Account upon confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your Apple Account Settings. Any unused portion of a free trial, if offered, will be forfeited upon purchasing a subscription.
Privacy Policy & Terms
Privacy Policy: https://benabid.me/privacy
Terms of Service: https://benabid.me/terms
Support
Do you have questions or feedback? 
Email us at: contact@benabid.me
Thank you for choosing the Authenticator App!

bluejetty:00070034:ios.summary: Seeing AI is a free app that narrates the world around you. Designed with and for the blind and low vision community, this ongoing research project harnesses the power of AI to open up the visual world by describing nearby people, text and
bluejetty:00070034:ios.description:
Seeing AI is a free app that narrates the world around you. Designed with and for the blind and low vision community, this ongoing research project harnesses the power of AI to open up the visual world by describing nearby people, text and objects. 
Seeing AI provides tools to assist with a variety of daily tasks: 
• Read - Hear text as soon as it appears in front of the camera. Document alignment provides audio cues to capture a printed page and recognize the text along with its original formatting. Ask Seeing AI about the contents to easily find the information you need.
• Describe - Take photos to hear a rich description. Ask questions to focus on the information you care about. Explore photos by moving your finger over the screen to hear the location of different objects.
• Products - Scan barcodes and Accessible QR codes using audio beeps to guide you; hear the product name and package information when available.
• People - Save photos of friends and coworkers so you can recognize them later. Get an estimate of their age, gender, and expression.
• Currency - Recognize currency notes. 
• Find My Things - Teach Seeing AI to recognize your personal objects and follow the audio cues to find them later. 
• World - An Audio Augmented Reality experience to explore an unfamiliar environment, including hearing objects announced around you with Spatial Audio (requires a device with a LiDAR, and iOS 14+). 
• Colors - Identify colors.
• Light - Hear an audible tone corresponding to the brightness of your surroundings.
• Photos and Videos in other apps - Just tap “Share” and “Recognize with Seeing AI” to describe media from Mail, Photos, WhatsApp, and more. 
• Browse Photos - Hear descriptions of photos and videos saved on your device.
Seeing AI continues to evolve as we hear from the community, and AI research advances.
Visit http://SeeingAI.com for more details.
Questions, feedback or feature requests? Email us at SeeingAI@Microsoft.com.
