Quotes Creator makes it easy to turn your words into shareable designs. Start with a built-in background, use a photo from your library, or choose a solid color. Then customize your text and export a polished image or PDF.

CREATE QUOTE IMAGES

- Write your own quote, poem, caption, or message
- Browse inspirational, motivational, life, and love quotes
- Discover quotes by author or topic
- Quickly choose a random quote
- Reuse recent quotes when creating new designs

CUSTOMIZE YOUR DESIGN

- Choose from a wide range of creative fonts
- Adjust text size, color, alignment, spacing, and shadow
- Use built-in backgrounds or your own photos
- Fine-tune images with blur, brightness, saturation, contrast, and color controls
- Save reusable templates and organize your favorites

ADD YOUR BRAND

- Add text watermarks, logos, and transparent PNG images
- Create and add QR codes

- Save watermark templates for future designs

SAVE AND SHARE

Export your creation as a high-quality image or PDF, then share it using your favorite social and messaging apps.

Whether you are creating a daily quote, social post, photo caption, or branded image, Quotes Creator gives you the essential tools in one convenient editor.

Need help or want to share feedback? Contact feedback@quotescreator.com.

With thousands of daily active users and the highest engagement in the community, AutoLNK has become the most popular automotive app on the market. By integrating social networking, event discovery, and professional ticketing into one experience, it is the essential "all-in-one" tool for every car enthusiast. AutoLNK is the only place where you can find every automotive event in the world.
Download AutoLNK today and see why we are the fastest growing automotive community in the world.

bluejetty:00064110:ios.name: Solar Walk Ads+：Planets System
bluejetty:00064110:ios.summary:
Solar Walk Ads+ is an amazing 3D model of our Solar system bringing the universe to the palm of your hand and allowing you to interact with planets, satellites, moons, comets and other space objects anytime and anywhere.
Start your fascina
bluejetty:00064110:ios.description:
Solar Walk Ads+ is an amazing 3D model of our Solar system bringing the universe to the palm of your hand and allowing you to interact with planets, satellites, moons, comets and other space objects anytime and anywhere.
Start your fascinating journey through the realms of space and learn more about the universe we live in.
*** Over 6 million users!***
*** National Parenting Publications Awards (NAPPA) - GOLD winner in the Educational Tools for Parents and Children category! *** 
*** A Parents’ Choice Gold Award Winner *** 
“Simply amazing.” - Macworld
“Solar Walk serves up a visually impressive 3D model of our solar system. Set against a haunting, atmospheric soundscape, the app shows planets and satellites in their correct positions, and offers mini movies, facts and other related tidbits.” - TNW
“This jaw-dropping app provides a wholly interactive 3D model of our solar system, one that’s had me hooked for days. It’s the kind of thing you can imagine a science teacher using in the classroom of the future — except that we don’t have to wait.” - CNet
“Zoom from Mercury to Pluto (which makes the cut in this app), passing each planet’s moons along the way. Because Solar Walk knows what time it is, the planets are in proper orientation to the Sun: Earth is dark where it is currently night and gradually lightens to daytime on the other side.” - NY Times
"It's great for showing my students the relative positions of the planets in the solar system, the satellites orbiting the Earth and our place in the galaxy. Awesome with a smartboard as well." - by jbrown61
Solar Walk Ads+ enables you to:
► Observe the 3D model of our Solar system with all its objects in real time and in a proper orientation. Turn into an astronomer and explore planets, moons, satellites, asteroids, dwarf planets, comets, stars and other celestial bodies. Enjoy gorgeous graphics and visuals while navigating through the solar system.
► Make virtual flights from one space object to another.
► Travel in time and see what the universe and our Solar system looked like at a certain period.
► Find an exciting view of the Milky Way Galaxy.
► Watch a collection of educational solar system movies to learn about space-related topics including Earth's moon phases, Earth's cycles, tidal phenomena, and zodiacal constellations.
► Enjoy 3D planetarium with the help of special glasses and activating the anaglyph mode.
► Share interesting screenshots of the app with your friends.
► Choose the view mode comfortable for you (orrery/true-to-scale).
The app contains In-App Purchases. In-App Purchases won't remove ads from the application.
Solar Walk Ads+ is a great educational tool appropriate for both adults and children. The amount of information users can learn about the planets, moons, satellites and other celestial bodies is impressive. All information is age-appropriate and detailed. Animated video clips will make learning about our Solar system even more engaging.
Start exploring the universe with Solar Walk Ads+!

Have you taken an L recently? You don't have to answer that because the app will use your facial expressions to determine if you took an L.
"L" stands for Loss. Originally used to describe one's disposition of engaging in an activity that he/she does not particularly like.
This is a game where you play with friends to see who can take the least amount of Ls.
A statement is read, then the app uses facial expressions to determine if the user has done it before.
So, next time you take a massive L, breathe in a deep breath, let that s*** wash over you and learn to laugh about it. Recognize the humor.
Inspired by popular youtubers doing You Laugh You Lose Challenge, Would you rather, truth or dare, smash or pass, try not to laugh, 1000 Degree Knife, or Bottle Flip challenge. All these party apps were similar and fun, but rather than ask the user to pick yes or no, we add a twist and use facial expressions to answer for you.
You have options to generate your own statements, or play with statements submitted by users. 1 or 2 players available.
Do us a favor and Take this L.
*Works with different phone language settings*

Access statements and tax documents: Easily access, view, and download important financial documents.

Subscribe to alerts: Receive notifications for important banking activities, including account and transaction monitoring and business banking activities.
Manage business banking activity: Initiate and approve ACH and wires payments conveniently and securely.
Stop payments: Initiate a stop payment for check(s) debiting your account.
Update contact information: Ensure that we have up-to-date contact information so that we may reach you if needed.
View financial portfolio: View your financial portfolio across your accounts at all financial institutions, providing a comprehensive overview of your assets and investments.
Access credit score: Securely monitor your credit score and get actionable insights on how to improve your financial wellbeing and creditworthiness.

bluejetty:00021449:ios.description:
Jain Panchang is a complete Panchang and calendar app for the Jain community, covering Tithi, Choghadiya, Nakshatra, and Muhurat timings alongside the full Jain festival calendar - with accurate Panchang 2026 and Panchang 2027 dates as each year begins.
Check today's Tithi, Choghadiya, Rahu Kalam, and Abhijit Muhurat for your city, track Paryushan Parv and Samvatsari Mahaparv, and follow Tithi as observed by your Sampraday.
KEY FEATURES
- Daily Panchang: Tithi, Nakshatra, Yoga, Sunrise and Sunset
- Choghadiya: Day and night, with the current period highlighted
- Muhurat timings: Abhijit Muhuratam, Dur Muhuratam, Rahu Kalam
- Jain festival calendar: Paryushan Parv, Samvatsari Mahaparv, Kalyanak days and more
- Daily Niyam: a new Niyam each day from the categories you choose, plus the classical Chaudah Niyam with your own mrayada
- Niyam progress: streaks, 30-day history, and achievements
- Today's Quote: a daily Jain quote to read and share
- My Events: personal dates with Tithi-based yearly reminders
- Calendar Sync: add Panchang reminders to your device calendar
- Home screen widgets for Panchang, timings, and Choghadiya
- Apple Watch app for Panchang and Choghadiya at a glance (Premium)
- 100 Years of Panchang: browse any month or year, not just the current one
- English, Hindi, and Gujarati support
Free to use, with a one-time Premium upgrade available for widgets, calendar sync, My Events, extra notifications, Apple Watch support, and an ad-free experience.

bluejetty:00037428:android.description:
The Authentication application is one way to authenticate so that retirees have the convenience of taking pension money, if retirees have problems related to using smartphone devices for authentication, retirees can still come directly to the Bank or Pos Pay Partners.
In this authentication, you will be asked to imitate 3 movements to be shuffled. If it fails, it will be asked to repeat 2 times.
The purpose of building this application is as an alternative to the authentication process for retirees so that retirees can authenticate anywhere and anytime via a smartphone.
This application is intended for all retirees and will be more optimally used by retirees who have just entered retirement.

bluejetty:00187566:ios.summary:
Descarga la app, hazte cliente de ING ¡y empieza a disfrutar de tu banco móvil!

Control total de tus finanzas, Bizum, pago
bluejetty:00187566:ios.description:
Descarga la app, hazte cliente de ING ¡y empieza a disfrutar de tu banco móvil!
Gestiona tus finanzas y gastos diarios, paga con tu móvil y envía o recibe dinero por Bizum de forma fácil y segura.
Control total de tus finanzas, Bizum, pago móvil y gestión de tus tarjetas de banco.
Seguro que cada día tienes muchas cosas que hacer (y que disfrutar). Y consultar la app de tu banco no debería ser una de ellas, o por lo menos, que hacerlo te lleve el tiempo justo.
¡Ahorra tiempo en tus finanzas con tu banco móvil!
- Gestiona tus finanzas personales y ahorro en tu cuenta digital.
- Consulta movimientos y dinero en tus cuentas bancarias.
- Invierte y compra acciones y ETFs
- Pago móvil sin necesidad de llevar tus tarjetas.
- Realiza pagos mediantes transferencias y domicilia tus recibos.
- Gestiona el envío o ingresos a través de Bizum
- Añade tus tarjetas a Apple Pay
- Saca dinero desde cualquier cajero del banco ING
… Además, con el banco ING, si necesitas dinero en efectivo, podrás sacar dinero desde los cajeros ING sin comisiones desde tu banco.
INVERSIÓN Y BRÓKER NARANJA: 
Descubre nuestro Broker NARANJA, invirtiendo en acciones y ETFs de manera fácil y segura. Opera en sectores como tecnología o IA, así como en temáticas, índices, divisas y materias primas. Con tu Broker NARANJA, tienes todo bajo control.
PAGO MÓVIL, BIZUM, GESTIONA TU DINERO Y TARJETAS:
- Pago móvil: Pago a través de tu móvil en cualquier establecimiento y olvídate de la tarjeta de crédito o débito física. 
- Bizum y Transferencias: Realiza pagos con bizum y transferencias entre bancos con tu cuenta de banco.
- Apple Pay: Vincula tu tarjeta a Apple Pay y paga de manera rápida y segura en cualquier establecimiento y compras online.
- Money Up!: Incluye herramientas como el Agregador para consultar tu cuenta digital o cuentas de otros bancos, Redondeo de dinero y Mis Huchas para ahorrar y ayudar a tus finanzas personales.
- Buscador de Cajeros: Encuentra el cajero ING más cercano para retirar dinero sin necesidad de tus tarjetas físicas.
- Descubierto Gratis: Disfruta de 2 días de descubierto gratis por si te llega un recibo.
- Categorización y Presupuestos: Controla tus gastos y establece presupuestos para no gastar más dinero de la cuenta.
Únete a la banca móvil de ING, y gestiona tus finanzas estés donde estés.
Pago móvil, envía y recibe dinero con Bizum y gestiona tus tarjetas desde tu app del banco
GESTIONA TU CUENTA, TARJETAS Y DINERO
- Pago de Impuestos y Recibos: Paga cómodamente desde tu móvil, ya sea con transferencias de dinero o domiciliación bancaria.
- Amortización de Hipoteca: Amortiza tu hipoteca con un solo clic.
- Dinero en moneda extranjera: Solicita dinero en moneda extranjera y recíbelo en casa.
- Aplazamiento de Compras: Aplaza tus compras y consulta los datos de tus tarjetas.
- Simulación y Contratación de Productos: Simula productos de finanzas, consulta y contrata desde la propia app de ING sin desplazarte a tu banco.
- Activa tu plan de viaje: Pago móvil o con tu tarjeta en la moneda local sin preocuparte por la comisión de cambio de divisa. También podrás sacar dinero a débito en cualquier cajero sin preocuparte por las comisiones. 
La app de ING, está diseñada para qué gestionar tus finanzas personales, dinero y tu ahorro, sea lo más cómodo y eficiente posible.
Compra con total seguridad con el pago móvil y gestiona tus tarjetas de banco 
ACCEDE A LA CUENTA DEL BANCO ING RÁPIDO Y SEGURO
- Accesos Directos: Mantén pulsado el icono y accede rápidamente a las funciones más utilizadas como Bizum, pagos, transferencias, tarjetas de crédito o débito.
- Validación Móvil: Confirma tus pagos con tarjeta y operaciones bancarias de manera segura desde la app del banco ING.

bluejetty:00200155:ios.name: Rupteur Sensor
bluejetty:00200155:ios.summary:
Rupteur Sensor turns your phone into the acceleration sensor for Rupteur, the engine sound simulator for Tesla.
In a Tesla, the browser can't see the pedal or the car's accelerometer: Rupteur works out how hard the engine is pulling from t
bluejetty:00200155:ios.description:
Rupteur Sensor turns your phone into the acceleration sensor for Rupteur, the engine sound simulator for Tesla.
In a Tesla, the browser can't see the pedal or the car's accelerometer: Rupteur works out how hard the engine is pulling from the GPS, which means only once the car has already picked up speed. With Rupteur Sensor, your phone feels the push as it happens and sends it to your car almost instantly. You press, the engine roars. At the same time.
And it keeps going with the screen locked: put your phone down and forget it.
How it works:
1. In your Tesla, open Rupteur and tap "GPS + phone" under Source: a QR code appears.
2. In Rupteur Sensor, tap "Scan the car's QR code" and scan it.
3. Put the phone in a holder or the tray, any way round. Accelerate firmly once or twice: it calibrates itself.
Nothing is recorded: the readings go from your phone to your car, that's all. No account, no ads.
Rupteur Sensor requires Rupteur (rupteur.app), opened in your Tesla's browser.

bluejetty:00062678:ios.description:
Check out this video:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3xePnu3MsBQ
IMPORTANT NOTICE: 
1. This app emulates G1000 MFD functionalities only. It does not include PFD functionalities. To obtain PFD functionalities, download the PFD app from AppStore which can co-operate with this app(MFD) via wifi connection.
Download address of PFD app: http://itunes.apple.com/us/app/id501990787?mt=8
2. This app is for practice only. The navigation database included in this app may be outdated and very possible to be different from what it is in real life.
3. Due to huge memory consumption, it's highly recommended that you install this app on an iPad which has at least 1G memory on board. Thus, install this app on iPad 1, iPad 2 or iPad mini is not recommended. Running this app on iPad Air or newer devices will get you a much better performance.
Disclaimer: 
-Simionic and the seller are not affiliated with Garmin, 
-The app is not provided, approved, endorsed, or otherwise supported by Garmin. 
This is an app which simulates the Multi Function Display(MFD) of the Garmin G1000 used on Cessna 182T, 172S, 172R, 206H and Beechcraft Baron G58. It can also be configured to adapt piston, turboprop and jet engines. Most of the functionalities are implemented just as they are in the real life. It can be used by aviation enthusiasts as well as pilots to perform either an IFR training or just to familiarize the operations of G1000 MFD. This app is capable to connect to another app which simulates the G1000 PFD via wifi connection through which you can have a complete set of G1000 and make them work with FSX, Prepar3D , X-Plane or InfiniteFlight to get the best experience.
G1000 is a highly integrated system, it is very powerful and also very complicated. It is recommended that you have a real G1000 user guide from Garmin. 
Details:
1. Global navigation database and topo data
2. Engine status simulation
3. Functional "Map Setup"
4. All pages including AUX pages are implemented
5. Terminal procedures are included
6. User waypoint creating/editing
7. User defined holding patterns
8. Flight plans storing/editing
9. Checklists for Cessna 182T, 172S, 172R and 206H are included
10. PFD connection via wifi

bluejetty:00063537:ios.description:
A bubble shooter game based on Disney and Pixar’s Inside Out 
Disney Interactive brings you this one-of-a-kind bubble-shooter based on Disney and Pixar’s, Inside Out!
Growing up can be a bumpy road, and it’s no exception for Riley. Like all of us, Riley is guided by her Emotions — Joy, Sadness, Anger, Fear and Disgust. And now that Riley is officially a teenager she is navigating new Emotions Anxiety, Embarrassment, Envy and Ennui too! 
Join Riley's Emotions on a journey to match, sort and burst memory bubbles, as you travel through unique locations inspired by Inside Out — Family Island, Dream Productions, Boy Band Island, Imagination Land, Train Yard, and more! 
Play this bubble shooter that twists the puzzle genre inside out! 
● SHOOT & MATCH memories 
● UNLOCK characters and play over 1000 levels 
● HARNESS EMOTIONS – Erase obstacles with Embarrassment, freeze time with Ennui, safeguard your moves with Anxiety, and multiply your chances with Envy! ● UNLEASH POWER-UPS – Create sunbursts with Joy, let the rain pour with Sadness, blaze a fiery path with Anger, repel matching memories with Disgust, and scatter orbs in frantic fun with Fear! 
● OVERCOME obstacles like Brain Freezes and jump ahead using boosters like Brain Storms! 
● IMMERSE yourself in the world of the film through stunning 3D animation and gameplay featuring voice actors from the film! 
Before you download this app, please consider that this app includes advertising, some of which may be targeted to your interests. You may choose to control targeted advertising within our applications by using your mobile device settings (for example, by re-setting your device’s advertising identifier and/or opting out of interest based ads). 
• In-app purchases that cost real money 
• The option to accept push notifications to let you know when we have exciting updates like new content 
• Location-based services 
• Advertising for some third parties, including the option to watch ads for rewards

Gesta Condomínios e Contabilidade
Tranquilidade, Eficiência e Eficácia é o que todos procuram, mas poucas empresas conseguem entregar com qualidade os serviços a que se propõem, conheça nossos serviços e entenda porque somos a melhor soluçã
bluejetty:00093138:ios.description:
Gesta Condomínios e Contabilidade
Tranquilidade, Eficiência e Eficácia é o que todos procuram, mas poucas empresas conseguem entregar com qualidade os serviços a que se propõem, conheça nossos serviços e entenda porque somos a melhor solução para atender às suas necessidades e expectativas.
Tanto pelo site da Gesta quanto pelo aplicativo, os moradores, síndicos, conselheiros, funcionários e prestadores de serviço do condomínio podem realizar suas tarefas e organizar suas rotinas de forma simples, rápida, eficiente e acima de tudo de qualquer lugar e a qualquer hora.
Os recursos disponíveis vão desde a simples gestão dos boletos em aberto quanto à abertura de portas do prédio usando as integrações disponíveis no aplicativo. Tudo com o mesmo login e senha, recebendo pushs para questões mais importantes, acesso online e em tempo real.
Funcionalidades (variam conforme o plano habilitado):
- cadastro completo de condôminos, seus veículos, animais de estimação e outros moradores da unidade
- comunicação entre síndico e moradores com controle de pendências, grupos de discussão, achados e perdidos, avisos, manutenção, etc (com moderação).
- reservas no salão de festas, mudanças e outras agendas,
- acesso ao regimento e demais documentos do condomínio,
- boletos das taxas mensais - prestação de contas interativa mês a mês com anexos dos comprovantes e aprovação online da pasta
- visão da evolução dos gastos por conta e grupo de conta (Gastos com água, energia, contratos, manutenções, etc)
- comparativo de orçado versus realizado (gráficos e detalhamento)
- visão da inadimplência (relatórios e gráficos)
- gestão de contratos com terceiros
- gestão de manutenções preventivas e periódicas
- gestão e comunicação de multas e advertências com direito a defesa,
- visão da relação de funcionários e corpo diretivo do condomínio,
- cadastro de fornecedores e prestadores de serviço,
- acesso aos dados de departamento pessoal (folha, escala de férias, projeções)
- controle da entrada e saída de visitantes,
- autorização da entrada de visitantes,
- acesso às câmeras de segurança,
- avisos de chegada e retirada de encomendas,
- registro e publicação da leitura de água e gás,
- integração com sistemas de portaria remota, controle de acesso, automação e muito mais.
Qualquer dúvida ou questionamento, nos envie uma mensagem para gesta@winker.com.br.

Whether you’re putting money aside to build towards your goals or seeking a spending account that makes your money go further, Greenwood has an account to support you. Open a savings account today with no minimum or monthly fees and earn 4.15% APY. Our spending account includes a Mastercard-branded debit card with a wealth of benefits including, zero liability, identity theft protection, and global emergency services.
INVEST IN YOURSELF. NOT FEES.
No overdraft - no fees
No ATM surcharge fees at participating locations
No minimum balance fees
No peer-to-peer transfer fees
JOIN US. PAY IT FORWARD.

bluejetty:00185922:ios.description:
Avion Flight Simulator ™ 2015 is a sophisticated flight simulator that includes 12 planes, 4 detailed cities, and over 9 airports. The player can fly anything from single-engine aircraft to jumbo jets, with idealistic to realistic flight simulation experience. The game features an immersive set of 60+ missions, dynamic real-world weather system, trees and interactive clouds.
Avion Flight Simulator ™ 2015 features 12 detailed aircrafts that you can pilot, with cockpit view: 
Cessna 182 - The Cessna 182 Sky lane is an American four-seat, single-engine light airplane, built by Cessna of Wichita, Kansas.
DE Havilland DHC6 Twin Otter - The DE Havilland Canada DHC-6 Twin Otter is a Canadian 19-passenger STOL (Short Takeoff and Landing) utility aircraft developed by de Havilland Canada and produced by Viking Air. 
ATR 42 - The ATR 42 is a twin-turboprop, short-haul regional airliner built in France and Italy by ATR.
Piper PA46 Malibu Meridian - The Piper PA-46 Malibu and Matrix are a family of American light aircraft manufactured by Piper Aircraft of Vero Beach, Florida. The aircraft is powered by a single engine and has the capacity for one pilot and five passengers.
A-10 Thunderbolt II - The Fairchild Republic A-10 Thunderbolt II is an American twin-engine, straight wing jet aircraft developed by Fairchild-Republic. It is the only United States Air Force production aircraft designed solely for close air support, including attacking tanks, armored vehicles, and other ground targets with limited air defenses.
DE Havilland Beaver - The de Havilland Canada DHC-2 Beaver is a single-engined, high-wing, propeller-driven, STOL aircraft developed by de Havilland Canada. It is used for cargo and passenger hauling, aerial application (crop dusting and aerial topdressing), and has been widely adopted by armed forces as a utility aircraft.
Canadair CL415 - The Bombardier 415 Superscooper is a Canadian amphibious aircraft purpose-built as a water bomber. It is an aircraft designed for aerial firefighting and is based on the company's CL-215 flying boat. It is marketed in the United States as the "Superscooper."
Beechcraft King Air - The Beechcraft King Air is a twin-turboprop aircraft produced by Beechcraft. They were originally marketed as Super King Airs, with "Super" being dropped by Beechcraft in 1996
F-16 Fighting Falcon - The General Dynamics (now Lockheed Martin) F-16 Fighting Falcon is a single-engine multirole fighter aircraft originally developed by General Dynamics for the United States Air Force (USAF). Designed as an air day fighter, it evolved into a successful all-weather multirole aircraft. 
Boeing F/A-18E - The Boeing F/A-18E Super Hornet and related twin-seat F/A-18F are twin-engine carrier-capable multirole fighter aircraft variants based on the McDonnell Douglas F/A-18 Hornet. The F/A-18E single-seat and F/A-18F tandem-seat variants are larger and more advanced derivatives of the F/A-18C and D Hornet. 
Boeing 777 - The Boeing 777 is a family of long-range wide-body twin-engine jet airliners developed and manufactured by Boeing Commercial Airplanes. It is the world's largest twinjet. Commonly referred to as the "Triple Seven”, it is also the first entirely computer-aided designed commercial aircraft.
Sukhoi Su-33 - The Sukhoi Su-33 (Russian: Сухой Су-33; NATO reporting name: Flanker-D) is an all-weather carrier-based twin-engine air superiority fighter designed by Sukhoi and manufactured by KnAAPO. Following the break-up of the Soviet Union and the subsequent downsizing of the Russian Navy, only 24 aircraft were produced.
Avion Flight Simulator ™ 2015 features pilot cockpit view for all the aircrafts. It contains 5 distinct commercial airports, 2 seaports and 2 small airports. 
Airbus A380, Boeing 747-8 and a military / war expansion pack is being planned. 
The game is localized in several different languages.

bluejetty:00083867:ios.description:
Connect your camera with your phone and bring your photography skills to a new level. This app is the reason why gps & wifi suddenly makes sense on your camera.

- View all pictures on the camera in a nice grid.

- Remote capture
- Connect your camera to the hotspot of your phone if no wifi is available
- see protected files
- Bulb capture
- Focus bracketing
- Use liveview to control all settings of your camera
- Use usb or wifi connection

Lite
- show Exif data (including gps data)
- download of singles files (also Raw)
- bulk download, bulk delete, bulk share
- filter current view (raw, jpeg, videos, protected files)

- Liveview with camera control
- Change settings of the camera (shutter speed, aperture, exposure compensation, iso, whitebalance, picture style, drivemode, metering, image format)

bluejetty:00152932:ios.description:
Discover the thrill of survival and embark on a heart-pounding adventure in Arcane Hunter: The Ultimate Idle RPG Survival Adventure! In this adrenaline-pumping game, danger awaits at every corner, challenging you to showcase your strategic prowess and engage in action-packed gameplay. Immerse yourself in an unmatched fusion of idle survival and backpack battles that is guaranteed to keep you on the edge of your seat.
Survive the Swamp Attack
Gear up to face relentless waves of enemies and unleash your quick reflexes and sharp strategy to outlast the chaos. The intense battles will put your survival skills to the test as you fight for your life.
Innovative Idle Survival Mechanics
With Arcane Hunter's unique idle survival mechanics, you can continue to earn rewards and fortify your arsenal even when offline. Never before has survival been this effortless, allowing you to progress and thrive even when you're not actively playing.
Engrossing Backpack Battles
Strategically organize your gear to confront increasingly challenging enemies. Your backpack is your lifeline in this treacherous world, and choosing the right items can mean the difference between survival and defeat.
Expansive and Dangerous Worlds to Explore!
Embark on a journey like no other as you navigate through deadly swamps, mysterious ruins, and other perilous environments. Traverse diverse landscapes and face formidable foes, offering an unparalleled experience in the world of exploration games.
Unparalleled Quality and Immersive Experience
Arcane Hunter boasts dream-game quality with stunning visuals, buttery-smooth gameplay, and thrilling challenges that are meticulously designed to keep you hooked for hours on end. The attention to detail and immersive gameplay create a truly captivating experience that sets it apart from other survival games.
Bask in the thrill of becoming the ultimate survivor in Arcane Hunter. Whether you're defending against a relentless swamp attack, mastering the art of idle survival, or gearing up for backpack battles, this adventure promises an experience like no other.
Download Arcane Hunter today and prepare to embark on an unparalleled journey of survival and exploration!
Terms of use: http://itcgamestudio.com/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00173629:ios.name: Light Pollution Map - Dark Sky
bluejetty:00173629:ios.summary: Light Pollution Map allows you to easily locate dark sky locations where the sky will not be affected by light pollution, allowing the best observance, star gazing, and photography of the night sky! But it's not just a light pollution map.
bluejetty:00173629:ios.description:
Light Pollution Map allows you to easily locate dark sky locations where the sky will not be affected by light pollution, allowing the best observance, star gazing, and photography of the night sky! But it's not just a light pollution map. There's so much more, such as aurora borealis live viewing map, meteor shower alerts, super moon alerts, lunar eclipse alerts, moon phases and info, aurora and magnetic field information, international space station tracker, and a lot more! Light Pollution Map will help you master the night sky..
List of all features:
• Highly accurate, customizable and interactive light pollution map to find dark sky viewing locations near you.
• See live aurora borealis information such as KP value, magnetic field information, and more for the hardcore aurora chaser.
• Live aurora borealis visibility map for northern and southern hemisphere, with additional timelapse options.
• Aurora information widgets (today widget).
• ISS Tracker with live updates about the international space station including the location, visibility, velocity, altitude, and more.
• Night sky event calendar allows you to find dates for lunar eclipses, super moons, and meteor showers.
• Live images of the Sun via NASA's Solar and Heliospheric Observatory.
• Darkness countdown timer until the darkest period of night so you know when the night sky will be the darkest. Also let you know when it starts getting light outside.
• Astronomy photo of the day directly from NASA! A new one every day to look at!
• Local temperature indicator to know if you need to bring a sweater before you even step outside.
• Local cloud coverage indicator to know if you will be able to see anything before you step outside.
• Cloud cover overlay on the main map to find clear sky locations at night.
• Settings to customize the app.
• Moon information such as moon phase, moon rise, and moon set times, days of next full moon and new moon, etc.
• Moon direction tool which allows you to find where the moon will be, at any time, any date, for any location.
• Enable a horizon safe radius circle to avoid light pollution from nearby cities on the map.
• Local Aurora Borealis (Northern/Southern Lights) alerts and push notifications.
• Global Aurora Borealis Activity alerts and push notifications.
• Meteor shower alerts and push notifications.
• Super moon alerts and push notifications.
• Lunar eclipse alerts and push notifications.
• Save and load your favorite dark sky locations.
• Navigate to your saved locations using the Apple Maps app.
Some features above require an optional in-app purchase to upgrade to the pro version. Every purchase helps us to continue running and developing the app and is much appreciated.
Note: Light Pollution Map loads data online. Internet connection or wifi is required, and we are not responsible for any data usage chargers from your provider.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00121563:ios.summary: Connect to Philips Hue Entertainment, LIFX, and Nanoleaf Light Panels and take command of your music & entertainment lighting needs. Customize one of over 100+ professionally-designed lighting effects using the app's 3 unique lighting contr
bluejetty:00121563:ios.description:
Connect to Philips Hue Entertainment, LIFX, and Nanoleaf Light Panels and take command of your music & entertainment lighting needs. Customize one of over 100+ professionally-designed lighting effects using the app's 3 unique lighting controllers. Light DJ Pro has been used in many creative applications, including special effects for home DJs, house parties, stage & video productions, holiday decorations, mood lighting for bars & restaurants, haunted houses, or just to create the ultimate music listening experience in your living room. Light DJ Pro is the #1 app for configurable entertainment effects for smart lighting.
*** THIS IS THE FULLY-UNLOCKED VERSION. You'll get all the benefits of a subscriber and only have to pay once. To sign up for a Light DJ subscription search for LIGHT DJ ENTERTAINMENT EFFECTS in the App Store! ***
MUSIC VISUALIZER: Create the ultimate music listening experience. The app listens to your music and changes the effects based on the mood of the song. Lights get active during intense parts of a song and flowy with softer melodies and magically change colors at just the right moment. Special controls for Nanoleaf allow you to control rotation and fill angle to match your Nanoleaf panel orientation.
STROBE MAKER: Strobe your lights with 5 different types of effects with the Matrix Strobe Maker. Tap and swipe using multitouch and 3D Touch (on supported models).
BEAT-SYNCED EFFECTS: Use the Super SceneMaker controller for looping effects that sync to the beat of your music. Each of the 100+ effects can be customized with your favorite colors. Just turn on your lights and let the SceneMaker run all night long. Control the speed of your lights with precision manual tempo controls or auto beat detection using your device's built-in microphone. Mix local audio tracks into your playlists and sheets or select one from Apple Music.
HUE ENTERTAINMENT: Using a Hue Entertainment area you'll enjoy higher quality effects; all of Light DJ's effects respond faster and with better sync. Send waves of color across your room with the updated Groove Wave effect, or strobe faster with the Matrix controller.
EFFECT MAKER: Create your own looping special effects with our powerful Effects Maker. Share your custom-made effects and effect sheets with your friends using AirDrop.
IPAD VERSION: The iPad app offers a DJ Controller-inspired design for ultimate live-performance lighting control. Configurable sheets allow you to setup your effects and colors in advance, and big push-buttons make rapid changes easy.
MULTI-BRIDGE SUPPORT: Combine lights from two or more bridges using the legacy effects or control multiple simultaneous entertainment areas.
ABLETON LINK & MIDI SUPPORT: Seamlessly sync tempo with other apps & devices using Ableton Link or MIDI Clock Sync. Control effects by sending Program Change codes over MIDI.
--- Light DJ vs Light DJ Pro ---
Want the full experience without having to worry about renewing your subscription? This version will include all benefits of the subscription service without the recurring payments. You'll get the same benefits as a Light DJ Pro Subscription user without having to keep paying:
-Full use of all of the app's controllers and effects
-Universal access & cloud sync
-Continual updates to support new hardware and features
-Direct email technical support (I respond to every email!)
-For more details see lightdjapp.com/blog
Visit lightdjapp.com for support or check out video previews at instagram.com/LightDJ
This app requires hardware from one of these vendors:
- Philips Hue: meethue.com - All lights
- LIFX: lifx.com - All lights
- Nanoleaf: nanoleaf.me - All WiFi-based lights & panels
----
Hi, I'm Kevin, creator of Light DJ Pro. I want to make sure that everyone gets a great light show, so if you're having issues getting the app to connect send me an email at kevin@nrthrnlights.com. I'm dedicated to making a quality app to show off your lights!

Special controls for Nanoleaf allow you to control rotation and fill angle to match your Nanoleaf panel orientation.

STROBE MAKER: Strobe your lights with 5 different types of effects with the Matrix Strobe Maker. Tap and swipe using multitouch and 3D Touch (on supported models).

BEAT-SYNCED EFFECTS: Use the Super SceneMaker controller for looping effects that sync to the beat of your music. Each of the 100+ effects can be customized with your favorite colors. Just turn on your lights and let the SceneMaker run all night long. Control the speed of your lights with precision manual tempo controls or auto beat detection using your device's built-in microphone. Mix local audio tracks into your playlists and sheets or select one from Apple Music.

HUE ENTERTAINMENT: Using a Hue Entertainment area you'll enjoy higher quality effects; all of Light DJ's effects respond faster and with better sync. Send waves of color across your room with the updated Groove Wave effect, or strobe faster with the Matrix controller.

EFFECT MAKER: Create your own looping special effects with our powerful Effects Maker. Share your custom-made effects and effect sheets with your friends using AirDrop.

IPAD VERSION: The iPad app offers a DJ Controller-inspired design for ultimate live-performance lighting control. Configurable sheets allow you to setup your effects and colors in advance, and big push-buttons make rapid changes easy.

MULTI-BRIDGE SUPPORT: Combine lights from two or more bridges using the legacy effects or control multiple simultaneous entertainment areas.

ABLETON LINK & MIDI SUPPORT: Seamlessly sync tempo with other apps & devices using Ableton Link or MIDI Clock Sync. Control effects by sending Program Change codes over MIDI.

bluejetty:00014693:ios.summary:

This app allows users to manage their Lightspeed product catalog, sell to customers, and handle product inventory from the conv
bluejetty:00014693:ios.description:
Lightspeed Scanner is the mobile companion app for the Lightspeed Retail (X-Series) Point-of-Sale (POS) system.
This app allows users to manage their Lightspeed product catalog, sell to customers, and handle product inventory from the convenience of a mobile phone. Lightspeed Scanner turns your device's camera into a powerful barcode reader, making it fast and easy to identify and count products from your Retail catalog.
Key features of Lightspeed Scanner:
• Add or edit products: Record Name, Description, Price, SKU Codes, Locations, and Product Images directly to your Lightspeed Retail catalog.
• Sell from anywhere: Turn your phone into a mobile register. Accept payment via Tap to Pay for iPhone (Lightspeed Payments users only), sell On Account, or Park sales to complete them on any in-store register.
• View product information: Search your product catalog and view details like price, stock levels, descriptions, and images.
• Inventory management: Perform or schedule full and partial inventory counts. Create or add to supplier purchase orders and outlet transfer orders. You can also receive stock, fulfill transfers, and record inventory adjustments. For additional accuracy, inventory and orders counted on the app must be completed on the Lightspeed Retail POS system, giving managers ultimate control of inventory movements.
Key use cases for Lightspeed Scanner:
• Mobile clienteling: Quick access to the catalog makes this a great tool for sales associates assisting customers on the shop floor. Staff can check pricing and availability without leaving the customer's side.
• Mobile selling: Enable stores to sell from anywhere, such as pop-up events or on the shop floor. Lightspeed Scanner allows you to offer dynamic, personalized shopping experiences.
• Mobile catalog management: Edit your Lightspeed product catalog from anywhere to ensure details are always up to date. Changes made in the app sync directly with ecommerce systems connected to Lightspeed Retail.
• Mobile order management: Picking and packing orders is simple on Lightspeed Scanner. With the app installed on your phone, you can pick orders without carrying additional hardware.
• Finding inventory quickly: Check inventory levels across multiple outlets. Product locations are visible and editable within the app, allowing staff to quickly navigate to where products are stored.
• Recording needs: Use the List building function to easily record products that need to be re-stocked, re-labelled, marked as damaged, or transferred to another outlet.
Hardware and Syncing:
• The app syncs directly with your POS system via WiFi or mobile network, ensuring all actions are visible instantly on the Lightspeed Retail system.
• Users of Lightspeed Retail who prefer infrared barcode readers over the built-in camera scanner can connect Socket barcode readers directly to Lightspeed Scanner.
Submit feedback or feature requests:
We’re always improving Lightspeed Scanner to help users perform their daily tasks more efficiently. Submit feedback anytime by navigating to the Account page, then selecting ‘Send us your feedback’.
Visit the Lightspeed Retail (X-Series) help centre for guided assistance on using Lightspeed Scanner.

bluejetty:00120329:ios.summary: Math Facts Ninja is a math game for kids (and adults) to improve basic math fact skills including Addition facts, Subtraction facts, Multiplication facts and Division facts. Looking for multiplication games to make learning math facts more
bluejetty:00120329:ios.description:
Math Facts Ninja is a math game for kids (and adults) to improve basic math fact skills including Addition facts, Subtraction facts, Multiplication facts and Division facts. Looking for multiplication games to make learning math facts more fun then simple multiplication flash cards? Not your standard math flash cards game, Math Facts Ninja uses three math games to test your "ninja-like-skills" as you try to earn your black belt in each ninja skill. These skills include Sword, Throwing Stars and Hands. As you progress though the eight belt levels of each skill you are challenged with increasingly difficult math problems designed to improve your mastery of Math Facts in addition, subtraction, multiplication and division (+-x÷). 
Features in Math Games:
• Math Facts, Math Drills and Math Games
• Common Core 3.OA.C.7
• Operations & Algebraic Thinking
• Multiply and divide within 100
• STEM math basics
• More Fun than Math Facts Flash Cards
• Learn & Practice Times Tables Game
• Learn & Practice Addition Game
• Learn & Practice Subtraction Game
• Learn & Practice Division Game
• Math Facts Dojo to practice your math fluency
• Fun ninja math facts games and math drills
• Way more fun then simple math flash cards
Math Facts Dojo:
In the Math Facts Ninja Dojo (practice room), you can practice specific number sets and arithmetic operations. Hone your skills as you focus on the areas you want to improve upon. You get to decide the Math Game and the Number Set as well as the number of math questions you want. Practicing your times tables has never been so much fun!
Math Facts Ninja is the perfect study app for students in grades 3 to 6, or anyone wanting to improve their general math facts skills. Math Facts Ninja offers multiple levels of difficulty, represented as belt levels, in a fun game environment. The more you play the more your math facts fluency will improve. 
Math Facts Ninja helps improve your math fluency in a fun, self—paced, game environment. Three different ninja-like games offer eight stages of difficulty culminating in the ultimate prize, a Black Belt! Earn a black belt for each ninja skill.

bluejetty:00156924:ios.name: Texas DPS Permit Test Practice
bluejetty:00156924:ios.summary: Are you looking for a practice material to prepare for the learner’s license test or driver’s license knowledge test for the Texas state? Use our Texas DMV Permit Practice Test to prepare for the Driver’s License test and get your driver’s
bluejetty:00156924:ios.description:
Are you looking for a practice material to prepare for the learner’s license test or driver’s license knowledge test for the Texas state? Use our Texas DMV Permit Practice Test to prepare for the Driver’s License test and get your driver’s permit with ease.
Our app provides questions based on the official manual from the Department of Motor Vehicle (DMV) of the Texas state. The app includes driver’s permit module for the car, motorcycle and Commercial Driving License CDL. The app is a ready to use study guide material for those who want to prepare for their driver’s license test. Our app can be used to practice for the Car, Motorcycle and CDL Drive’s license.
Followings are the features of Texas DMV Permit Practice Test app.
QUESTIONS FROM OFFICIAL REFERENCE MATERIAL 
The Texas DMV Driver’s Manual served as the inspiration for all of the content and questions that have been included in the app. Prepare yourself for the questions that will be on the test by going over them in advance. 
PRACTICE CATEGORY WISE QUESTIONS
The app includes a practice module that allows to get familiar with questions that fall under different categories like Traffic Rules, Road Signs and Rules of Safe driving. It also keeps track of the progress you have made in each category. It contains questions from following categories:
* Traffic Laws
* Road Signs
* Rules of Safe Driving
* CDL endorsements : Hazardous Materials, Schools Bus, Passenger Vehicle, Combination Vehicle, Tankers, Double/Triples
* Pre-trip Inspections
* Air Brakes
MOCK TEST (TEST SIMULATOR)
The application also includes a module that gives you the opportunity to take a test consisting of questions drawn at random from different categories. This section will give you an idea of what to expect from the actual exam that you will be taking.
TEST RESULT
You will get the test result based on the official criteria to pass the Driver’s License Test. You will also be able to find out what questions you've done wrong after taking the test.
TEST HISTORY
The application keeps history of how you have performed in the previous mock tests so that you get an idea of your progress.
CUSTOM TEST CREATER
You can generate speedy, short quizzes with the help of this application by picking questions from a list of unpracticed questions or by selecting questions that you have previously gotten wrong. You also have the option to choose the total number of questions on the practice test.
QUESTION CHALLENGE
This is a unique feature of our application. It allows you learn while playing a challenge game. Your score will go up by one point each time you correctly answer a question up until the point where you get it wrong. It keeps record of your high score. 
WHY Texas DMV Permit Practice Test app?
- Over thousands questions designed from the official Texas DMV manual.
- Practice questions category wise and keep track of how you are progressing.
- Go through the questions you answered wrong.
- Real time test simulator.
- Bookmark questions that you think you want to refer them later on.
- Question Challenge - Learn by playing game.
*Disclaimer:
We are not associated with any government state agency. This app is not intended to be relied upon in any dispute, claim, action, proceeding or for legal advice. For official law descriptions and administrative centres, please consult the respective state body. It is also highly recommended that new drivers take an approved driver education course to learn the rules and laws of the road, and to develop responsible driving habits. We have developed this app to help you to pass the DMV permit test with ease. The questions are designed based on the latest official Driver's handbook. But we do not claim the accuracy of information and this information can not be used in any legal case.

bluejetty:00156414:ios.summary: Are you applying for the Kentucky KSP permit driver’s license test certification? Use this application to study for, improve your score on, and ultimately pass both the CDL driver's license test and the DMV driver's license test for the sta
bluejetty:00156414:ios.description:
Are you applying for the Kentucky KSP permit driver’s license test certification? Use this application to study for, improve your score on, and ultimately pass both the CDL driver's license test and the DMV driver's license test for the state of Kentucky in order to obtain your permit on the very first attempt. 
This app contains quizzes that are derived from the official Kentucky State Police manual. This application will help you in preparing for and practicing for the Car, Motorcycle, and Commercial Driver's License (CDL) tests required by the state of Kentucky. All of the practice tests included in this application are based on the most recent editions of the applicable manuals. Therefore, if you are looking for preparation for the DMV driver's license test 2025, this is the ideal DMV driver's license test practice app for you. This application is a handbook manual that may be used to practise and prepare for the Commercial Driver's License (CDL) as well as the KSP Knowledge Test Permit. 
It is developed with the learning requirements of a user who is applying for a driving license and the requirements of the driver's license test, as well as the most effective learning strategies discovered by researchers. The process of studying for the permit test is made to be more engaging and enjoyable as a result. When utilizing this application, users report that it is quite simple to provide accurate responses to the questions that appear on the actual KSP permit driver's license test. 
Following is a brief overview of the features provided by the app.
- Practice tests designed especially for you.
- Bookmark questions you want to look at a later stage.
- You can keep track of your progress and check the history of each practice test. 
- Scope of improvements suggested based on your performance. 
- Sample tests for obtaining a driver's license for a motorcycle, a car, and a commercial driver's license (CDL). 
- A very extensive bank of sample questions that covers all areas of the written examination for the driver's license. 
- Very intuitive and clutter free User Interface.
Following test categories are covered in this app : 
- General Knowledge Test
- Hazardous Materials Test
- School Bus Test
- Passenger Vehicle Test
- Air Brakes Test
- Comb. Vehicles Test
- D/T Trailers test
- Tanker Vehicles Test
- Pre-trip Insp. Test

bluejetty:00135109:ios.description:
Resizer and compressor for one or several media files (up to 50 files at a time). Helps free up disk space.
If your storage space is almost full and you are struggling with deciding what to delete, you need this app in your life! No need to delete photos, videos, apps, or music you like anymore, this application will compress your files and free up disk space without unnecessary losses. This also helps with upload speed if your internet connection is not the best at the moment, since smaller files are faster to upload and send via WhatsApp, Messenger, Facebook, Instagram, Telegram, Viber or any other messaging application.
The algorithm of this application allows you to reduce file sizes and save up disk space without compromising the quality of the images or videos. Download the app and test this modern way of handling data! You can delete the original files or keep them in case you need them for something else. If you delete a file by mistake and want to restore it, you can later find it in the “Recently deleted” folder. 
Video formats supported by the app:
mov, mp4, m4v, sdv, 3gp, 3gpp, 3g2, 3gp2
Image formats supported by the app:
jpeg, png, heic, heif, svg, gif, tiff, webp
Here are some reasons to use our Media files compressor regularly:
- Your private files stay secured
- Helpful and very easy to use
- Supports a lot of different formats, more than your average file compressor
- Faster uploads and sending via messaging apps or in case of slow internet connection
- Minimize the sizes of you files and send them to your friends and family faster
- Add multiple files at a time for a faster compression
- Keep both resized and original files if you wish
- No need to delete files, apps, games, songs you like to free up space
- No need to use suspicious online compressors with pop-up ads
- Offline compression
- Restore deleted files if needed
At this point, there is really no reason not to use this app! But let’s talk about safety. It is important to note that this application operates in the offline mode only, that means that no data is being sent to any server, cloud, or any third-party application. This is our way of making sure that your data stays protected and that only you have access to your private files.
You do not need to worry about deleting your favorite videos or images to free up space anymore. Download this app to try out this modern approach to data storage and enjoy all the benefits!
We’re planning to develop our application together with you.
For any questions, contact support - hello@lanars.com

bluejetty:00153045:ios.description:
Welcome to Color Block Run, a captivating puzzle game that challenges your logic, planning, and spatial thinking!
Whether you are a strategic mastermind or a creative puzzle lover, Color Block Run delivers endless brain teasing fun! Your goal is simple: tap and slide to outsmart tricky obstacles and free up space.
- Why You'll Love Color Block Run
• Strategic Logic Puzzles
Plan your moves wisely. Moving blocks requires planning and focus. Solve puzzles and match your wits against obstacles. It is the perfect brain puzzle to keep your mind sharp!
• Endless Levels to Explore
Enjoy endless hours of gameplay with levels ranging from relaxing to challenging. Explore new block puzzles every day and experience the thrill of this fun game.
• Satisfying Color Block Gameplay
Just a quick tap on your phone screen lets you navigate the blocks. The fresh visual style makes this 3D block jam puzzle a true feast for the eyes, and every move feel like magic.
- Features of Color Block Run
• Pure Logic: Plan your moves carefully! Every slide counts as you untangle complex jams and clear the board.
• Relaxing Puzzle: Feel the satisfying inertia and realistic physics as the color block slides perfectly across the board.
• Powerful Items: Stuck on a hard level? Use special items to clear blocks, support your journey.
• Global Leaderboards: Connect to the internet and compare with players around the world. Aim for the stars and climb the ranks!
• Free Puzzle Game: A 100% free block game for all fans of puzzle games.
- How to Play
• Tap & Slide: Tap and slide the color blocks along the arrows to solve the puzzle.
• Free Up Space: Move strategically to clear the path and solve the color block jam.
• Beat the Clock: Race against time and escape the wood jam in thrilling puzzle games.
• Level Up: Complete the logic puzzles to advance through levels in this color block puzzle.
- Who Will Love Color Block Run?
• Brain training fans: If you like strategy, minesweeper, parking jams, or block blast, you will absolutely love this game.
• Puzzle lovers: If you enjoy color matching or sorting games, this puzzle game is a pure delight!
• Stress relief seekers: The soothing gameplay offers a great escape from daily pressure. Enjoy ASMR, focus on the block and unwind your mind.
- Download Color Block Run Today!
Whether you are waiting for parking, relaxing at home, or commuting, this mobile puzzle game is perfect for a quick session.
Dive in and discover why players are hooked on this addictive block puzzle game! Color Block Run is ready for you.

bluejetty:00069794:ios.name: ImmoScout24 - Real Estate
bluejetty:00069794:ios.summary:
Find your new home with Germany's No. 1 real estate app.
Whether you're renting your first apartment, looking for a shared flat (WG), buying a family home or investing in real estate, ImmoScout24 helps you find the right home in Germany.
bluejetty:00069794:ios.description:
Find your new home with Germany's No. 1 real estate app.
Whether you're renting your first apartment, looking for a shared flat (WG), buying a family home or investing in real estate, ImmoScout24 helps you find the right home in Germany.
Why ImmoScout24?
• Germany's largest selection of property listings
• Germany's largest community of home seekers
• Highest customer satisfaction*
• Official SCHUFA Credit Check in the app
• AI-powered home search & smart filters
• Discover apartments before everyone else
Download the app now to rent, buy, sell or list apartments, houses and commercial property.
_______
Search
Find apartments, houses, shared flats (WG), commercial property and land using powerful filters for location, price, size, rooms, balcony, terrace, fitted kitchen, energy efficiency and year of construction.
Draw your preferred search area directly on the map and discover homes exactly where you want to live.
Smart AI filters with image recognition
Go beyond traditional filters. AI analyses listing photos, property details and location to find homes that match your lifestyle. Looking for a lake-view apartment? A house with an open-plan kitchen or floor-to-ceiling windows? A shared flat with parquet flooring? We'll help you find it.
AI real estate expert – "HeyImmo"
HeyImmo answers your questions about renting, buying and finding property in Germany—24/7. Is the asking price fair? Are there daycare centres nearby? What renovations might be needed? HeyImmo helps you make informed decisions before viewing or applying.
Explore neighbourhoods with "Scout the Streets"
Open your camera and discover apartments, houses, shared flats and other properties around you. Explore streets and neighbourhoods in an interactive 3D view before you move.
Discover apartments earlier with the "Tenant Network"
Get ahead of other home seekers. Discover apartments before they're officially listed and access homes that are about to become available before they're publicly advertised.
Get more with SuchenPlus
Increase your visibility, unlock early access to selected listings and enjoy additional benefits while searching for your next home (paid feature).
Push notifications
Receive instant alerts for new apartments, houses, real estate and WG listings and apply in just a few taps.
Watchlist
Save your favourite apartments, houses and properties and compare them anytime.
Messages
Chat directly with landlords, real estate agents and property owners and stay informed with instant push notifications.
Official SCHUFA Credit Check
Request your official SCHUFA Credit Check directly in the app and add it to your application profile. 
_______
List, Rent Out & Sell
With ImmoScout24 you can easily list, rent out or sell your property.
List your property for free
Create a listing in just a few clicks and advertise your property free of charge for 14 days as a private advertiser.
Free property valuation
Receive a free property valuation and find the right price for your apartment, house, land or commercial property. Our Price Atlas compares local property prices and real estate values in your area.
Germany's largest real estate agent network
Get expert advice from experienced real estate professionals and sell or rent out your property at the best possible price.
_______
With more than 6.5 million listings, ImmoScout24 is Germany's largest real estate marketplace—ahead of immowelt, immonet, Kleinanzeigen and WG-Gesucht. For more than 25 years, millions of people have trusted ImmoScout24 every month to rent an apartment, buy a house, find real estate and successfully list their property in Germany.
Whether you're moving to Germany, looking for a WG, renting your first apartment or buying a house, ImmoScout24 helps you find your next home faster.
We'd love your feedback!
Email us at app-support@immobilienscout24.de or leave us a review here.
*Goldberger Marktanalytik, “Brand Study”, quantitative online survey, n=1,033, April 2026.

bluejetty:00187105:ios.name: UN & NGO Jobs: Global Careers
bluejetty:00187105:ios.summary:
Looking for a career with impact? UN & NGO Jobs brings openings from the United Nations, NGOs, International Financial Institutions and Multilateral Organizations into one clean, fast app, and helps you find the roles that fit you.
JOBS PI
bluejetty:00187105:ios.description:
Looking for a career with impact? UN & NGO Jobs brings openings from the United Nations, NGOs, International Financial Institutions and Multilateral Organizations into one clean, fast app, and helps you find the roles that fit you.
JOBS PICKED FOR YOU
The For you feed finds openings similar to the jobs you save, across agencies and duty stations.
SEARCH IN PLAIN WORDS
Describe what you want, for example "Communications jobs in Africa, P3 or P4, French a plus", and the search fields fill themselves in. You can still search by organization, duty station, job level, job family or keywords in the job title.
EVERY JOB AT A GLANCE
A short summary tops each vacancy: contract type, experience, languages and who can apply. Spot local-recruitment or internal-only roles before you read the full post.
YOUR FILTERS, ONE TAP AWAY
Switch between All, For you and your saved filters from the top of the job list.
DAILY OR WEEKLY JOB ALERTS
Set alerts by organization, job family, level, recruitment type and location, and choose how often you hear about new matches. Tap an alert to edit it, swipe to delete.
NEVER MISS A DEADLINE
Add any job's closing date to your calendar in one tap. Saved jobs also get a reminder one day before they close.
TRACK EVERY APPLICATION
Mark a saved job as Applied, then move it to Interview, Offer or Rejected. Record the date you applied and add a short note. Filter your saved jobs by status to see where each application stands.
BACK UP AND RESTORE
Keep your saved jobs, alerts and filters safe in iCloud and restore them on a new iPhone or iPad.
SHARE OPPORTUNITIES
Found a great opening? Share it with friends and colleagues through social media or messaging apps.
SAY HELLO
Found a bug, have a suggestion, or want to share your job-hunting story? We'd love to hear from you. If the app helps you, please rate it and share it with others looking for UN or NGO jobs.
Email: unjobsapp@gmail.com
Facebook: facebook.com/unjobsapp
Website: unjobsapp.org
Terms of Use: https://www.unjobsapp.org/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://www.unjobsapp.org/privacy.html
Disclaimer: This app is not affiliated with or endorsed by the United Nations. All UN job listings are sourced directly from careers.un.org.

bluejetty:00016381:ios.description:
Adventure awaits!
In the magical world of Fantasy Island Sim live many tribes, each with their own quests, skills and secrets. The pirates for example like to explore the secrets of the world and collect treasures found in chests. Need to boost your economy? Trade goods and resources with the gnomes. One day the Dwarfs will build their castle, until then they will harvest ore and forge gold for you. The elves are legendary in solving daily quests by using their magic. The villagers love to farm and produce crops.
Explore the magical world of Fantasy Island Sim.
Expand your kingdom into an empire and discover cute tribes like the gnomes, pirates, elves, polars, dwarfs and villagers. Each tribe has unique buildings you can build, most of them are epic, some are even legendary. 
Gather resources and construct buildings.
Start with a medieval town and build up your economy by constructing production buildings and produce resources. You can harvest their goods and use these resources to construct new homes and shops. Slowly you will grow your town into a city.
What is your strategy?
In this city building simulation game you need to keep morale high in order to keep production up. But be aware, push your tribes too hard and they will leave your city.
Trade with your friends.
Use your skills to produce goods and trade resources with your friends! Play together and discover new tribes, unlock secret skills and find hidden treasures.
Enjoy this new city building simulation game together!
Features
Fantasy city building game
Unlock different tribes and grow your kingdom into an empire
Solve daily quests
Explore the world and expand your kingdom
Harvest ore and forge gold
Choose your own path: strategy or simulation?
Playable both offline and online
Fantasy Island Sim is free to download and free to play. However, you can purchase in-app items with real money. If you wish to disable this feature, please turn off the in-app purchases in your phone or tablet’s settings.
Check out other cool games from Sparkling Society, the creators of Fantasy Island Sim!

bluejetty:00186463:ios.description:
Now kids can enjoy competing with your friends in class or with siblings at home with our brand new Monster Math Duels! Have fun and improve in math at the same time. Download an intelligent multiplayer game in which you can compete with kids of your own grade as well as with kids from completely different grades; on a single or across multiple devices!
Choose between Grades K - 5 and over 60 skills to help your kids do some good old arithmetic practice in a refreshingly new way. Our algorithm allows pairing of kids across different grades while keeping the difficulty level of the problems aligned to each kids’ grade level.
Monster Math Duels gives kids 3 modes to engage in math duels with friends at school or at home, to practice math and do homework in an effective and a refreshingly new way!
The 3 modes in Monster Math Duels are:
Nearby Mode - Use this mode to let your kid play against other kids over a wi-fi or bluetooth connection.
Split Screen Mode- This is one of the most loved features of the first Monster Math. And, it just got better! Use this mode to let your kids challenge each other or yourself in a game of math. Get to know your kids some more and have some quality family time together. (note: this mode is available only in iPads)
vs. Computer Mode - Use this mode to hone your kids’ skills against self-adjusting difficulty levels at anytime of the day, even when there are no human opponents.
Monster Math Duels helps your child practice and learn over 60 skills. It is suited for Grades K–5, with all skills aligned to the Common Core Math standards. These skills are also fully customisable, thanks to standard skill presets, to suit your kids’ aptitude.A simple and intuitive toggle switch allows you to select advanced or basic skills which are presented as a neat progression within the parents section of the game.You can also receive weekly emails.
Monster Math is designed to test multiple skills in one go, unlike flash cards or simple quiz based apps, which only ask one question at a time. It is a great way to practice mental math and doing math drills, in a fun game environment. Regular play will lead to faster recall and use of Math facts. 
See the skills your child could be learning with Monster Math Duels -
Basic Geometry
• Identify shapes on various attributes
• Symmetry
Addition & Subtraction
• Addition up to 20
• Subtraction up to 20
• Two-digit addition without carry over
• Two-digit subtraction without borrowing
Multiplication & Division
• Times Tables of 1 to 12
• Divide by numbers 1 to 12
• Multiply single-digit numbers by multiples of 10
Primes, Factors and Multiples
Fractions
• Visual representations (1/b, a/b)
• Equivalence
• Whole numbers as Fractions
• Comparing fractions
• Basic fraction addition
Decimals
• Decimal equivalents to given fractions and vice-versa
Common Core Standards: 
K.G.2, K.G.3, K.G.4, K.OA.5, 1.G.1, 1.G.3, 1.NBT.4, 1.OA.3, 2.G.1, 2.G.3, 2.NBT.5, 2.OA.2, 3.G.1, 3.OA.7, 3.NBT.2, 3.NBT.3, 3.NF.1, 3.NF.3, 4.G.3, 4.OA.1, 4.NF.2, 4.NF.3, 4.NF.6. 
Let your kids practice all of their basic math skills and problem solving while they have fun. Download Monster Math 2 - Multiplayer now!
Subscription info:
- Monster Math can be purchased standalone, or as part of a makkajai subscription. 
- Makkajai subscriptions are auto-renewable and annual. (Expert - $17.99/yr or Genius - $59.99/yr) 
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase
- Cancellation will not go into effect until the end of the monthly billing cycle
For support, questions or comments, write to us at: support@makkajai.com
Privacy policy: http://www.makkajai.com/privacy-policy
Terms: http://www.makkajai.com/terms

bluejetty:00086451:ios.description:
Teledipity is a personal growth platform that uses numerology to help you better understand yourself, your relationships, and the timing of your life.
Our software has an eerie ability to reach you at the right moment with the right message, delivering highly targeted advice, introspections, book recommendations, and wisdom from history's greatest philosophers.
We're here to boost your confidence, remind you of what matters, and help you stay open to life's opportunities. 
A DIFFERENT KIND OF APP
No social media scraping. No AI-generated insights. No cookie spying. Every reading is written by a person — and the only source of our magic is an algorithm that has been around for 2,300 years. Go figure.
You're the captain of your own ship. We're the compass.
ELEVEN YEARS AND COUNTING
Independent since 2014! No ads, no cookies, no data sold, ever. Just content people describe as honest, accurate, and "my go-to place."
Dive into your greatest timeline. Create a FREE account today.
The FREE Teledipity experience includes:
-Character Analysis Report: Seven sections and over 65 pages analyzing your personality traits, talents, life cycles, and areas of improvement.
-Serendipitous Messages in a Personalized FEED: Our 2,300-year-old algorithm knows where you are, what you're going through, and what kind of motivation, inspiration, or perspective you need at any given time.
-Yearly and Monthly Forecasts: The Pythagorean Sequence is not about prediction or fortune-telling. It is about the dominant influence and priorities of any given chapter of your life, and how it fits into the tapestry of your overall journey.
-Book Recommendations: Our software is not the be-all end-all. We find you the books you need the most at each specific chapter of your life.
-Objectives: We help you actively implement the information we deliver with guided objectives for each year.
-Personalized Monthly Podcasts: Every 1st of the month, you will get a 5-15 minute motivational podcast going deeper into the life lessons that await during the next month of your life. These audios include suggestions for further reading or longer explanations about the topic you should focus on to get the most out of your experiences.
Take your experience to the next level by purchasing a membership to Teledipity PREMIUM, where you will get:
-Unlimited Compatibility Reports: compare your personality with that of friends, family members, lovers or co-workers. Create as many as you want!
-Weekly Forecasts and PREMIUM updates: your PREMIUM membership will take Teledipity's presence in your life to the next level. Get a weekly forecast every Monday, and an additional serendipitous email every week (in other words - insights bi-weekly instead of bi-monthly).
-Unlimited Essays (audio reflections): challenges are audio introspections on topics such as building your dreams,, self-care routines, and similar self-improvement topics.
Teledipity PREMIUM is available in three auto-renewing subscription options:
Teledipity Premium Monthly for $11 per month
Teledipity Premium Quarterly for $25.49 every three months
Teledipity Premium Yearly for $69.99 per year
If you can’t get enough of our content, we offer an optional $127 add-on to the Teledipity subscription known as the FLOW Calendar, a week-by-week analysis of the next 12 months in your life with date-specific advice.
* Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase. For more information, please visit our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
Terms of Service: https://www.teledipity.com/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://www.teledipity.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00078174:ios.description:
Falifi: Designed for Relationship Seekers
Falifi is the dating app designed for people who want to connect meaningfully. Whether you’re seeking love, friendship, or a meaningful connection, Falifi helps you find genuine connections in a fun and safe environment.
How We Help You Find Your Connection
Falifi is on a mission to change the way you meet people. With our unique features, we make it easier than ever to meet like-minded individuals for relationships and friendships, no matter what you’re looking for:
Quickly Learn Your Type:
Falifi’s smart matching algorithms connect you with the best people based on your interests, preferences, and values.
See Real Personalities:
Discover potential matches through detailed profiles, including prompts, photos, videos, and personal interests. It’s not just about looks — it’s about who you really are.
Easy Conversations:
Start meaningful conversations by liking or commenting on specific parts of someone’s profile. It’s all about getting the conversation started with ease.
More Than Just Dating:
Whether you're here for love, friendship, or genuine connections, Falifi offers a space for everyone. Find people who share your goals, interests, and values — and let the connection grow.
Video Profiles:
Express yourself better with short video profiles. Let potential matches see and hear you, making your profile more personal and engaging.
Safe & Secure:
Safety is a top priority at Falifi. With secure messaging, profile verification, and robust reporting tools, you can feel confident while meeting new people.
Community Events:
Participate in exclusive events, webinars, and meetups to connect with others in your area or virtually.
Matchmaking Made Easy:
Our advanced matching system ensures that you’re connected with people who meet your relationship preferences, whether you’re looking for friendship or a serious relationship.
Comprehensive Profiles:
Create a profile that reflects who you truly are. Detailed profiles help you make informed decisions when finding a match.
Local and Global Connections:
Whether you're looking for someone nearby or open to long-distance relationships, Falifi allows you to connect locally or globally.
Like, Match, Date, Love, Friendship:
Falifi is all about exploring your connections. Swipe, like, and match with people who interest you. Whether it's love, friendship, or a meaningful relationship, your journey starts here.
Premium Features:
While Falifi is free to use, you can unlock even more features like advanced search filters and unlimited likes with a premium subscription.
Subscription Info
Payment will be charged to your account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off 24 hours before the end of the current period.
You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal through Account Settings after purchase.
Why Falifi?
Find your special someone, a new friend, or even just a fun date. Falifi is where genuine connections are made — for love, friendship, or anything in between. Join the diverse and supportive community today and start your journey towards meaningful relationships.
Find. Match. Chat. Date. Love. Friendship.
Support: support@falifi.com
Terms of Service: https://falifi.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://falifi.com/privacy
