bluejetty:00018672:ios.description:
Healthify is trusted by over 40 million users globally to simplify their health journey. Whether your goal is weight loss, improved nutrition, or enhanced fitness, Healthify provides you with world class technology & services to support you make data driven decisions through every step of the way. With Healthify you can
- Track Calories with photo or voice
- Log Meals
- Get personalized AI Insights & actionables
- Track Water
- Track Sleep
- Track Weight
- Track Workouts & Activity
Healthify uses image based smart AI recognition technology to bring you the convenience of tracking calories and meals with just pictures. Healthify App is also empowered with an AI Nutrition Coach to take personalisation to a next level with insights and analysis.
KEY FEATURES
SNAP: HEALTHIFY’S IMAGE-BASED INSTANT CALORIE TRACKER
- Experience the world's most advanced image-based food recognition system. 
- Track your meals by simply taking a photo. Track not only calories, but also protein, fats, carbs, and even fiber. AI image based nutrition tracking is a lot more accurate than people think.
- Snap automatically analyzes your meal’s nutrition, tracks it for you and also gives you a health score.
- Healthify’s food database is not 1 Million or 10 Million, it's INFINITE. Track any food from any corner of the world.
- Powered by the world’s largest food database, which is continuously updated for accuracy.
AUTO SNAP: HEALTHIFY’S AUTO-DETECT IMAGE FOOD TECHNOLOGY
- Every time you take a picture of your food using your phone’s camera, Healthify logs your meal automatically.
- Healthify is the only app in the world that has this technology. You don’t want to miss it.
- It’s super fast. You don’t have to open the app before, after or while eating. Just connect it to your gallery. The next time you open the app, your meal is already tracked.
- Just click, forget, and Healthify does the work!
RIA: YOUR AI HEALTH COACH
- Ria is your AI Health Coach on the go. It keeps you motivated in your busy schedule, with insights that are tailored to your progress.
- Ria can create meal plans for you, give you recipes, create grocery lists and even suggest what to eat. Ria tells you what’s healthy and what's not. 
- It gives you insights on your logs and keeps you on top of your game. Ria can educate you, give you tips and converse with you like an actual human coach would
- From logging your meals to helping you manage your calorie intake, Ria is your 24/7 health companion..
- Chat with Ria, ask anything. Ria is designed to be highly personalized. Need no equipment work out plan? Or… a Yoga plan? Just ask.
HEALTHIFY’S ONE-ON-ONE COACHING PLANS
- Connect with professional instructors/ nutritionists/ dieticians to enjoy dedicated one-on-one coaching.
- Healthify’s expert coaches give you the most personalised experience for reaching your health goals.
- They are your accountability partners. This is a premium service that blends human empathy with AI-driven insights to deliver the customisation you need. 
- Healthify plans are designed to be sustainable, long lasting and tailored to your needs. Your health, your terms and we find you the way.
- Get support in actioning small, achievable wins to keep you inspired, from weight loss to better energy and sleep.
- Get Holistic Health Transformation- Beyond weight loss—achieve better energy, restful sleep, and a lifestyle that feels amazing.
TECH INTEGRATIONS
- Sync with Apple Health to seamlessly track your steps, workouts, sleep, and more in real-time. Your data remains private and is used only to deliver personalized insights, coaching, and progress tracking.

bluejetty:00026784:ios.description:
My Diary provides a friendly, professional, and personalized diary-journal experience. With its beautiful and thoughtful design, it lets you enjoy every memorable moment.
WHAT IS MY DIARY?
My Diary is a free online diary with lock. You can use it to record daily journals, secret thoughts, journeys, mood trackers, and any private moments. It is a diary that supports adding photos, themes, diary background, mood, font effects, etc., making your private diary more vivid and safe. Committed to providing the most intimate diary-journal writing experience for users who want to keep a diary and care about their mental health.
With the My Diary app, you can:
Write diaries or record journeys anytime, anywhere
Write photo diaries. Add pictures or drawings to make your personal diary more vivid
Customize your journals with themes, moods, font effects, stickers
Use it as a mood-tracker and get mood analysis
Set a password to lock your diary and protect your memories
JOURNALING FOR MENTAL HEALTH
Journaling is a simple way to write down your thoughts and feelings to manage your mental health and control your emotions. Journaling has many benefits, including:
Clear fear and concerns
Manage anxiety and reduce stress
Expressing your emotions. Journaling is really a good mental health tracker and mood tracker
Learn from your experiences and make you happier
Gain control of your emotions etc
REASONS FOR CHOOSING THIS JOURNALING APP
1. Easy-to-use & Beautiful interface 
* It provides beautiful diary themes. Add enjoyment to every moment of daily journaling
* Night dark theme. Makes it more comfortable when you keep a journal at night
* Well-designed pages, let you start a journal or take notes easily
* Providing journaling guides, Follow it step by step to complete the first diary.
* Powerful rich text effect. It gives you the best experience whether you take journeys notes or write diaries.
2. Safe and Private
* My Diary, as a private diary app, protects your memories by setting an app passcode. You can turn on the diary lock to make your diary safe.
* We recommend that you set a security question to avoid forgetting your password and being unable to visit your journal.
3. Photo Diary, More Than Words 
* My Diary is a Photo diary. Add photos to make your private journals more memorable.
* Check all journal photos in the Media View Mode
* Add drawings to reflect your ideas and thoughts
4. Decorate Your Diary 
* Enjoy the Diary illustrated themes. Whether it’s a travel journal, health journal, girl diary, or mood tracker diary, there will always be a theme you like (Some of them are Premium)
* Choose backgrounds when writing journal entries, see how lovely private journals can be (Some of them are Premium)
* Writing about your feelings helps the brain overcome upsets, clear fears and leaves you happier
5. Mood Tracker 
* Some moods cannot be expressed in words, so you can choose mood diary symbols. Add your mood when you start writing diaries or take day notes
* Track mood in the mood calendar
* Check your mood trends in statistics
* Be your free metal health tracker
6. Categorize Your Daily Notes with Tags 
* Adding tags for your daily journals
* The suggested categories include Travel notes, work notes, love diary, baby diary, daily motivations, pregnancy diary, etc
* Easily check your entries by tags
In summary, It is really a good photo journaling app free for you, a lovely secret diary with lock and a great mood tracker & mental health tracker, which deserves to be installed. 
My Diary is a free journaling app, most of the features are FREE. Additional features, including some backgrounds, themes, etc. are available with a My Diary Premium Membership.

bluejetty:00175864:ios.description:
Oyomi is a Japanese "Grammar analyzer" and "Learning" App.
Part of speech: Use machine learning to automatically break sentences and mark the parts of speech and pronunciation of Chinese characters in sentences and paragraphs to improve your reading efficiency.
Semantic analysis: Combining machine learning techniques, the Oyomi can accurately analyze and generate the semantic structure of sentences and paragraphs, sort out the modification relationship between short sentences, and help you understand the grammatical characteristics and meanings of Japanese.
Translation reading: Oyomi also has accurate online translation function, and can perform text-to-speech.
Web content analyzer: Oyomi can parse the content of the web page for analysis.
EPUB reading: Support to import EPUB e-books.
Word parsing: Oyomi can automatically analyze the conjugations of word with build-in dictionary.
Vocabulary notebook: You can bookmark your favorite paragraphs and new words so that you can study them again later.

bluejetty:00044814:ios.name: Sonar - Health & Performance
bluejetty:00044814:ios.summary: Your body is talking. Are you listening? Sonar unifies all of your wearables, lifestyle, and biomarker data to unlock personalized insights and detection once reserved for elite athletes and biohackers. Trusted by 250,000+ users across 170+
bluejetty:00044814:ios.description:
Your body is talking. Are you listening? Sonar unifies all of your wearables, lifestyle, and biomarker data to unlock personalized insights and detection once reserved for elite athletes and biohackers. Trusted by 250,000+ users across 170+ countries, Sonar helps you cut through the noise across sleep, recovery, stress, activity, and nutrition - so you can focus on what actually matters.
Sonar isn't just another health tracker. It merges the latest medical, sports and data science with AI engines that continuously surface subtle shifts and patterns across millions of data points, helping you know when to push, when to pause, and where to focus next.
FEATURES:
Personalized intelligence
Sonar AI is a personal health agent grounded in the data across your wearables, health apps, and connected devices. Ask questions, understand changes in your scores, and get answers that reflect your actual data - not generic advice. Sonar AI also remembers personal context you give it like training goals, travel, or new routines, and factors it into how it interprets your data over time.
Sync everything
Fragmented data means missed signals. Connect Apple Watch, Garmin, Oura, Fitbit, Strava, Withings, MyFitnessPal, Peloton and many more.
Daily scores and guidance
Recovery, Strain, Sleep, Stress, Energy, and Nutrition scores help you understand your day at a glance, with practical guidance to improve.
Correlations & comparisons
See how any two metrics relate over time. Plot exercise against sleep, alcohol against HRV, or stress against recovery to surface the patterns driving how you feel each day. Compare up to six metrics at once, or focus the view on a single category like activity, sleep, or recovery.
24/7 vitals monitoring
Track trends in HRV, resting heart rate, respiratory rate, blood oxygen, body temperature, and more, and get notified when values move outside your typical range.
Training analytics
All workouts in one place, with detailed summaries, heart rate zones, and training load and balance to help you build fitness without burnout.
Widgets, Apple Watch & desktop app
Keep Sonar close with beautiful widgets and an Apple Watch app, and explore your data on the big screen at www.sonarhealth.co
Peer benchmarks
See how you compare to people like you (and the broader community) across key metrics.
Make it yours
Choose the sections, metrics, wallpapers, and views that matter most to you, including a Favorites view for the health data you care about most.
Tailored recommendations
Add your medications, family history, and conditions to receive personalized checkup, vaccine, and screening recommendations based on age, sex, history, and the latest medical guidance.
PUTTING PRIVACY FIRST
Your health data is yours - we do not sell personal data. Our goal is to build an experience our users love, and all product and architecture decisions are built around maximizing user privacy.
SUBSCRIPTION AND TERMS
Sonar offers a meaningful free experience, empowering you to start transforming your health today with no strings attached. Current-day Recovery, Sleep, Strain, and Nutrition scores are free for all users. It's all part of our mission to accelerate longer, healthier, and happier lives globally.
If you're looking to take your health journey to the next level, you can upgrade to Sonar Pro at any time for access to a suite of powerful features we think you'll love.
Always consult with your doctor prior to making any medical decisions.
Privacy Policy: https://www.sonarhealth.co/legal/privacy-policy/
Terms of Service: https://www.sonarhealth.co/legal/terms-of-service/

bluejetty:00024436:ios.description:
Elevate your decision-making process with the Spin Wheel Decisions App, your ultimate tool for turning choices into an entertaining experience. Trusted by over 5 Million users.
Harness the power of AI with our new AI-generated wheels, which adapt and learn from your preferences to create personalized decision wheels, making your experience as intuitive and seamless as possible.

Whether you need help deciding where to eat, what movie to watch, or how to plan your next vacation, our AI tool dynamically generates wheels that evolve with your choices, offering a smarter, more personalized way to make decisions.
- Intuitive Interface: Simply tap and spin the wheel to let fate handle your choices. The user-friendly design ensures a seamless experience for all users.

- Unlimited Wheels: Generate as many wheels as you need, making it easy to manage decisions of any size, from everyday questions to unique event planning.
- Exciting Themes: Enhance your wheels with a selection of vibrant themes and colors, adding a fun twist to your decision-making process.
- Fair Random Selection: Our advanced algorithm ensures each spin is random and unbiased, guaranteeing fair choices every time.
- New Decision Tools: Quickly extract numbers and names from any list. Leave things up to chance with virtual dice rolls and coin flips. Engage multiple users in selecting a random finger. Seek guidance and fun predictions about the future with just a tap.
- Share Your Choices: Easily share results with friends and family via social media or messaging platforms, bringing them into the fun.
- Decision History: Track all your previous choices with our history feature to revisit or analyze past decisions.

bluejetty:00149328:ios.description:
ACCESS HRA Child Support Mobile makes it easy for all people in New York City to fill out an enrollment form for Child Support Services.
Log In
You can use your existing ACCESS HRA account to log in to this app. If you don’t have an account, you can create one in the app.
Submit Enrollment Form
Once you are logged in, you can submit an enrollment form right from your phone. We will ask you some questions about yourself, the Other Party, and the child or children. If you have children with multiple people, please submit an additional enrollment form for each of the Other Parties.
View Enrollment Summary
Once you have submitted your enrollment form for Child Support Services, you will be able to view and download a copy of the form.
Required Documents
Once you have submitted your enrollment form, you will see a list of documents that may be needed for your enrollment. Depending on the type of form you submitted, we will either ask that you return your documents to us directly from this app or we will provide a list of documents that you should bring with you to court. If you are returning documents to us through our mobile app, you can take a photo from your camera roll straight from the list shown to you on the screen. After you submit your enrollment form, someone from the NYC Office of Child Support Services will reach out to you to confirm the information and required documents.
Forms
New forms are available to submit for your Child Support case, including Challenge Forms and forms for programs such as the Arrears Credit Program and the Arrears Cap Program. 
Appointments and Notices
Cash Assistance clients can view NYC Child Support Appointments and Notices in the app.
For custodial parents
The app simplifies the child support enrollment process by asking you questions that more quickly help you complete the appropriate form. Once submitted, the forms and any required documentation is reviewed by an Office of Child Support Services (OCSS) staff member, who will contact you to confirm your submission and talk to you about the next steps. You can also use the app to provide OCSS your updated contact information and receive child support appointment reminders.
For noncustodial parents
As of December 2022, you can make child support payments to the government or the custodial parent directly through the app, without a fee, by using a credit card, debit card, PayPal, or Venmo. The app also provides you access to child support enforcement challenge forms and debt reduction application forms, which can be completed and submitted via the app. Once OCSS receives the submission, you will be contacted to discuss whether you qualify and the next steps. You can also provide your updated contact information via the app.
ACCESS HRA Child Support Mobile is available in English, Spanish, Korean, Arabic, Russian, Traditional Chinese, and French.

You can use your existing ACCESS HRA account to log in to this app. If you don’t have an account, you can create one in the app.


Submit Enrollment Form

Once you are logged in, you can submit an enrollment form right from your phone. We will ask you some questions about yourself, the Other Party, and the child or children. If you have children with multiple people, please submit an additional enrollment form for each of the Other Parties.


View Enrollment Summary

Once you have submitted your enrollment form for Child Support Services, you will be able to view and download a copy of the form.


Required Documents

Once you have submitted your enrollment form, you will see a list of documents that may be needed for your enrollment. Depending on the type of form you submitted, we will either ask that you return your documents to us directly from this app or we will provide a list of documents that you should bring with you to court. If you are returning documents to us through our mobile app, you can take a photo from your camera roll straight from the list shown to you on the screen. After you submit your enrollment form, someone from the NYC Office of Child Support Services will reach out to you to confirm the information and required documents.


Forms

New forms are available to submit for your Child Support case, including Challenge Forms and forms for programs such as the Arrears Credit Program and the Arrears Cap Program. 


Appointments and Notices

Cash Assistance clients can view NYC Child Support Appointments and Notices in the app.


For custodial parents

The app simplifies the child support enrollment process by asking you questions that more quickly help you complete the appropriate form. Once submitted, the forms and any required documentation is reviewed by an Office of Child Support Services (OCSS) staff member, who will contact you to confirm your submission and talk to you about the next steps. You can also use the app to provide OCSS your updated contact information and receive child support appointment reminders.


For noncustodial parents

As of December 2022, you can make child support payments to the government or the custodial parent directly through the app, without a fee, by using a credit card, debit card, PayPal, or Venmo. The app also provides you access to child support enforcement challenge forms and debt reduction application forms, which can be completed and submitted via the app. Once OCSS receives the submission, you will be contacted to discuss whether you qualify and the next steps.  You can also provide your updated contact information via the app.


ACCESS HRA Child Support Mobile is available in English, Spanish, Korean, Arabic, Russian, Traditional Chinese, and French.

bluejetty:00115438:ios.description:
Clean Up Now is a smart application designed to keep your iPhone clean, organized, and running smoothly.
Your phone fills up faster than you realize — similar photos, large videos, random screenshots, forgotten screen recordings, and even outdated calendar events slowly take over your device. Clean Up Now gives you the simplest and safest way to manage your storage and stay in control.
It’s the perfect solution for anyone who wants their iPhone to feel light, fast, and organized again. Try Clean Up Now today and discover how effortless storage management can be!
KEY FEATURES
Similar Photos Cleanup: Instantly detect and remove look-alike photos to declutter your gallery while keeping your best memories safe.
Large Video Cleanup: Sort your videos by size and quickly delete the heaviest files that take up gigabytes of storage.
Screen Recordings: Get rid of old recordings you no longer need, freeing up space in your library.
Screenshots: Easily remove random or outdated screenshots that clutter your photo gallery.
Calendar Cleanup: Detect and clear past events to simplify your schedule and keep your calendar relevant.
Duplicate Contacts: Merge duplicates and keep your address book organized.
Contacts Backup: Create secure backups of your contacts and restore them anytime.
Smart AI Enhancements: Powered by advanced AI that helps you organize, clean, and refine your photos effortlessly.
AI-POWERED PHOTO ENHANCER
Meet the next generation of smart tools that do more than clean — they restore, refine, and relight your memories with a single tap.
Whether you’re reviving old family photos, fixing blurry selfies, or improving lighting in your favorite shots, Clean Up Now uses advanced AI to make every image look its best.
AI Photo Restore: Bring faded or damaged photos back to life. AI intelligently recovers lost details, fixes discoloration, and makes old pictures feel new again.
AI Sharpen: Instantly transform blurry or soft photos into sharp, clear, and vibrant images — without over-editing or losing natural texture.
AI Relight: Automatically balance brightness and color tone. Adjust lighting direction and mood for realistic, professional-looking photos in seconds.
Experience photo enhancement that’s effortless, intelligent, and true to life — powered entirely by AI.
HOW CLEAN UP NOW HELPS YOU
- Reclaim Space: Free up valuable gigabytes for new apps, photos, and updates.
- Stay Organized: Keep your gallery neat and your calendar focused only on what matters.
- Save Time: Smart grouping means you don’t need to scroll endlessly — Clean Up Now finds the clutter for you.
- Smooth Performance: A lighter phone feels faster, more responsive, and easier to use.
JOIN OUR COMMUNITY
Every day, more people choose Clean Up Now to keep their iPhones light and organized.
Join them and see for yourself how easy it is to manage your storage and keep your phone running smoothly.
DOWNLOAD CLEAN UP NOW TODAY!
Payment & Subscription Terms:
You can choose between the following subscription options:
• Weekly Subscription with Free Trial – includes a 3-day free trial, then renews weekly with access to all features.
• Weekly Subscription (Lower Price) – a weekly plan without a free trial, offered at a lower price.
3-DAY FREE TRIAL – UNLOCK ALL FEATURE:
The 3-day free trial provides access to all features. After the trial ends, your account will be charged for the weekly subscription with trial within 24 hours before the end of the trial 
period.
Cancellation & Management
You can cancel auto-renewal at any time, as long as the cancellation is made at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited upon purchasing a subscription.
Manage your subscription directly from your iPhone:
Open the Settings app.
Tap your name.
Tap Subscriptions.
Select the subscription you want to manage.

The OTTO SPORT mobile app is built for the people who make youth sports happen.
It brings clarity to busy schedules, keeps teams connected, and helps seasons run smoothly—whether you’re organizing the league, coaching from the sidelines, or supporting from the stands. Members can access teams, rosters, schedules, assignments, and messaging tools in one reliable place.
The OTTO SPORT app is permission-based. Administrators control access, and only teams with permissions enabled will be visible in the app—ensuring the right people see the right information, at the right time.
What You Can Expect
 - Seamless integration with the OTTO SPORT sports management system, including teams, rosters, and schedules (games, practices, assignments, and other events)
 - Easy schedule management for parents and athletes—so practices, games, and assignments are always clear and up to date
 - Built-in messaging between admins, coaches, parents, players, and officials
 - Access to households, profiles, registration orders, and payments
 - A clean, focused interface with system-wide light and dark mode
 - Administrative control over team visibility
 - Referee and game official schedules and assignments
From planning to game day and everything in between, OTTO SPORT: is a smarter, steadier partner—keeping everyone aligned, informed, and moving the season forward.

bluejetty:00073454:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00073454:ios.description:
N12 הראשון בחדשות, עם LIVE ללא הפסקה - מסך צף חדש הנשאר פתוח בכל מצב, צ'אט הכתבים עם עדכונים שוטפים ופרשנויות מנבחרת הכתבים המובילה בישראל.
אפליקציית החדשות N12 מציעה חוויית צריכת חדשות שלא הכרתם. תהיו הראשונים להתעדכן בכל הדיווחים והפרשנויות ותתעדכנו ישירות מנבחרת הכתבים המובילה של חדשות 12.
באפליקציה תתעדכנו בזמן אמת בכל ההתרחשויות בארץ ובעולם; מצב הכלכלה, ביטחון, פוליטיקה, פלילים, צבא, צרכנות, כסף, תרבות, בידור, ספורט, דיגיטל ועוד.
צ'אט הכתבים לכל העדכונים בזמן אמת
נבחרת הכתבים שכולכם מכירים, עובדת בשבילכם 24/7 ומאפשרת לכם גישה מהירה ונוחה לעדכונים בזמן אמת באמצעות מבזקים בצ'אט הכתבים. הרכיב הייחודי מוצע למורידי אפליקציית N12 ומציג צ'אט ובו נבחרת החדשות המובילה בישראל ומיטב כתבי חברת החדשות הידועים והמוכרים מחדשות 12, מעדכנים במשך כל שעות היום בזמן אמת במבזקי חדשות מהארץ ומחו"ל.
צ'אט הכתבים הינו קבוצת ההתכתבות הפנימית של כתבי חדשות 12, שהחלטנו לחשוף גם בפניכם. תהיו הראשונים לקבל דיווחים מהשטח, תמונות וקטעי וידאו בלעדיים.
אתם מחליטים איך לצרוך את החדשות שלכם
אפליקציית N12 מסקרת עבורכם את כל ההתרחשויות והאירועים הבולטים ברחבי העולם ובארץ, במגוון רחב של תחומי עניין; כלכלה, ביטחון, פוליטיקה, צרכנות, כסף, תרבות, בידור, ספורט ועוד. האפליקציה מאפשרת לכם לצרוך את החדשות שהכי מעניינות אתכם באמצעות בחירת התראות וקבלת מבזקים בנושאים חשובים. האפליקציה גם מאפשרת לכם לבחור את גודל הגופן על מנת שתוכלו לראות את החדשות על המסך בצורה טובה ונגישה יותר. תוכלו גם לנווט בסרגל החיפוש בהתאם לנושאים שמעניינים אתכם ולמצוא תכנים ותוכניות שתרצו לקרוא או לצפות בהם.
צפייה במהדורות ובתוכניות של חדשות 12
באפליקציית N12 ניתן לצפות בכל זמן בכל התוכניות של חדשות 12: המהדורה המרכזית, אולפן שישי, חדשות סוף השבוע, שישי בחמש עם גדעון אוקו, מבזקי חדשות, תוכנית חיסכון, פגוש את העיתונות עם רינה מצליח, סדר עולמי עם ערד ניר, מהדורה ראשונה עם אורן וייגנפלד, שש עם עודד בן עמי, חמש עם רפי רשף, שלוש עם עופר חדד, המהדורה הצעירה והשבוע בערבית. כמו כן, ניתן לצפות בקטעים ספציפיים מתוך המהדורה המרכזית באמצעות סרטונים קצרים שיצרנו עבורכם על מנת שתוכלו לצרוך את החדשות שמעניינות אתכם בצורה היעילה ביותר.
עם אפליקציית N12 לא תפספסו מבזקי חדשות ותמיד תהיו מעודכנים הרבה לפני כולם בנוגע לכל הקורה בשיח הציבורי הישראלי וברחבי העולם. הורידו את האפליקציה והישארו מעודכנים.

bluejetty:00041608:ios.name: Photo Cleaner: Daily Delete
bluejetty:00041608:ios.summary:
Open Daily Delete and you see every photo you took on today's date — this year, last year, the year before that. One short deck, already waiting. Swipe left to delete, swipe right to keep. Tomorrow there's a new one.
That is the whole idea
bluejetty:00041608:ios.description:
Open Daily Delete and you see every photo you took on today's date — this year, last year, the year before that. One short deck, already waiting. Swipe left to delete, swipe right to keep. Tomorrow there's a new one.
That is the whole idea. Your camera roll didn't fill up in a single day, so you don't clear it in a single day either. You clear today's, and then you get on with your life.
HOW IT WORKS
Every morning there's a fresh deck: the photos you took on this date, across every year you've had a phone. Usually a handful. Sometimes a wedding. Each one fills the screen so you can decide in a second.
Swipe left to delete. Swipe right to keep. A counter tracks the run as you go.
Nothing is actually gone until you say so. Deleted photos land in a review grid first, and you can pull any of them back before you confirm. You are never one wrong swipe away from losing something.
Most people clear their first day in under two minutes.
WHEN YOU WANT TO GO FURTHER
The daily deck is the habit. The month calendar is for when you have time to burn.
Pick any month from any year and swipe the whole thing. The calendar fills in as you go, so you can see exactly which months you've cleared and which ones are still a mess. Some people do a month on a Sunday. Some people do three years in a weekend.
WHAT DAILY DELETE HANDLES FOR YOU
Similar shots, grouped — when you took eight photos of the same thing in twelve seconds, they come up together as one card instead of eight. Pick the keeper, drop the rest, move on.
Screenshots skipped automatically — receipts, memes, and boarding passes never enter your deck. You only triage photos you actually took.
Videos included — the biggest files on your phone are almost always videos you'll never open again.
Your progress, kept — how many photos you've cleared, how many you've kept, and roughly how much space you've won back.
YOUR PHOTOS NEVER LEAVE YOUR PHONE
Daily Delete works entirely on your device. We don't upload your photos to any server. We don't look at them, we can't look at them, and we don't track what you swipe. No ads, no data collection, no third-party trackers.
Other photo cleaners monetise your library. Ours is a simple trade: you pay us, we help you clean up your phone, and that's the entire relationship.
WHY A DAILY HABIT BEATS A BIG CLEANUP
Everyone has tried the marathon session. You sit down with 40,000 photos, you get through 300, you feel worse than when you started, and you never open the app again.
Two minutes a day is a job you'll actually finish. Do today's date every day for a year and you will have looked at your entire library — without ever once sitting down to "deal with your photos."
And you'll like it more than you expect. Most of what surfaces isn't clutter. It's the afternoon you forgot about, four years ago today.
Daily Delete is a subscription. Questions, problems, or feature requests: support@dailydelete.ai
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00029579:ios.summary: Is your goal to ACTUALLY SPEAK a new language? Tired of gamified tapping apps that just waste your time? Try Natulang! While other language-learning apps may focus on tapping and typing, Natulang is all about speaking. Our cutting-edge voic
bluejetty:00029579:ios.description:
Is your goal to ACTUALLY SPEAK a new language? Tired of gamified tapping apps that just waste your time? Try Natulang! While other language-learning apps may focus on tapping and typing, Natulang is all about speaking. Our cutting-edge voice generation and recognition capabilities allow you to learn real-life dialogues by speaking them out loud, giving you the confidence you need to speak with native speakers. With Natulang, you'll spend most of your time speaking, which is the key to mastering any language. 
Currently supported languages:
Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese (BR), Dutch, Turkish, Ukrainian, Polish, Czech, English, Japanese
Why Natulang?
•Speak your way to fluency: With Natulang, you'll spend most of your time speaking, which is the key to mastering any language.
•Real-life dialogues: Our cutting-edge voice generation and recognition capabilities make it easy to learn real-life dialogues, giving you the confidence you need to speak with native speakers.
•Personalized learning: Our personalized lessons are tailored to your unique needs, ensuring that the information sticks in your long-term memory.
•Hands-free language learning: With Natulang, you can learn a new language without having to constantly look at your phone or tablet. Our voice generation and recognition capabilities allow for hands-free language learning, so you can practice speaking while cooking, exercising, or doing other activities.
•Accessible for blind users: Natulang fully supports VoiceOver, making it an excellent choice for blind and visually impaired users. The app’s speech-centric approach enables effective, immersive language learning without visual interaction.
•Japanese, step by step: Learn hiragana and kanji with tables, flash cards and kanji explanations, show Japanese with furigana or romaji, and practice reading with short stories built from words you've learned.
PLEASE NOTE:
Some of the lessons in this app are free, but you will need a subscription to access all of them. Your subscription will automatically renew unless you turn off auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the end of the current payment period. Your iTunes account will be charged at the same price for renewal within the 24 hours before the end of the current payment period unless you change your subscription preferences in your Account Settings.
You can manage your subscriptions through your Account Settings after purchase.
Privacy Policy: http://support.natulang.com/privacy_policy.html
Terms of Service: http://support.natulang.com/eula.html

bluejetty:00095101:android.name: Style My Day: Makeup Tales
bluejetty:00095101:android.summary:
Style My Day: Makeup Tales - Unleash Your Inner Style Guru and Transform Lives!
Step into the captivating world of Style My Day: Makeup Tales, where you're not just a stylist – you're a pivotal part of your clients' journeys. Immerse yours
bluejetty:00095101:android.description:
Style My Day: Makeup Tales - Unleash Your Inner Style Guru and Transform Lives!
Step into the captivating world of Style My Day: Makeup Tales, where you're not just a stylist – you're a pivotal part of your clients' journeys. Immerse yourself in a heartwarming blend of creative expression and engaging narratives as you master the art of makeup, hairstyling, and fashion to help a diverse cast of characters look and, more importantly, feel their absolute best.
Each day in Style My Day: Makeup Tales brings new faces and unique stories. Meet a vibrant array of individuals – from aspiring professionals preparing for crucial interviews and nervous sweethearts heading out on first dates, to radiant brides dreaming of their perfect wedding day and talented artists getting ready for their moment in the spotlight. They all come to you with a vision, a need, and a hope for a transformation that goes beyond mere appearances.
As their trusted style expert, you'll dive deep into their individual needs and desires. Understand their personalities, the significance of their upcoming events, and their personal style preferences. Then, unleash your creative prowess to craft stunning head-to-toe makeovers that not only enhance their beauty but also boost their confidence and empower them to shine.
Become a Master of Transformation:
Masterful Makeup Artistry: Explore an extensive palette of foundations, concealers, eyeshadows, liners, mascaras, blushes, lipsticks, and more. Learn to apply countless techniques, from natural everyday elegance to glamorous red-carpet looks and bold, creative expressions. Discover the power of makeup to highlight features, conceal imperfections, and truly transform a face.
Trendy Hairstyling Expertise: Discover the perfect hairstyles to complement each client's features and the occasion. Cut, color, style, and add intricate details to create everything from sleek and professional looks to flowing romantic waves and edgy modern styles. Experiment with a variety of hair tools and products to achieve stunning results.
Curate Fashion-Forward Outfits: Browse through a diverse wardrobe of stylish clothing, elegant dresses, chic separates, and eye-catching accessories. Develop your fashion sense to select the ideal ensembles that reflect each client's personality and the event they're preparing for. Learn how to coordinate colors, patterns, and silhouettes to create unforgettable looks.
Unravel Engaging Client Stories: Get to know your clients on a personal level. Listen to their stories, understand their challenges, and share in their triumphs. Your styling choices will directly impact their confidence and their ability to face the world with renewed vigor. Experience the satisfaction of knowing your artistry has made a real difference in their lives.
Tackle Exciting Makeover Challenges: Each client presents a unique styling challenge. Interpret their requests, understand the event's requirements, and put your skills to the test to deliver breathtaking results. From subtle enhancements to dramatic transformations, every makeover is an opportunity to showcase your talent and creativity.
Unlock New Styles and Premium Items: As you successfully complete makeovers and build your reputation, you'll unlock new and exciting makeup products, trendy hairstyles, and fashionable clothing items. Expand your styling toolkit and stay ahead of the latest trends to offer your clients the very best.
Express Your Unique Vision: With a vast array of customization options, Style My Day: Makeup Tales empowers you to express your own artistic vision. Experiment with different combinations of makeup, hair, and fashion to create unique and memorable looks that reflect your personal style.
Are you ready to embark on a heartwarming journey of creativity, style, and personal connection? Download Style My Day: Makeup Tales today and start making a real difference, one stunning makeover at a time!

bluejetty:00073578:ios.description:
If you are looking for a fun, relaxing, and addictive 3D puzzle game? Then Tap it 3D: Tap blocks out is a great choice for you
In this 3D block puzzle game, you will tap the blocks in order to clear them out. Keep in mind that the tiles or blocks will move in only one direction. Also, some tiles will be blocked by other tiles, therefore, you have to choose the tiles carefully to unblock all the cubes. The level will be completed once you tap all blocks out and clear the screen.
As you progress to a higher level, there will be bigger, harder, and more complicated shapes. These levels will be a great challenge and brain teaser. Thus, this Tap it 3D: Tap block out will bring your IQ to a next level.
HOW TO PLAY
This tile puzzle game is very easy to play. All you have to do is tap it and unblock all cubes. Each block will fly away in only one direction, and their direction is indicated on the blocks. Thus, you have to approach this game carefully, so as not to get stuck.
Also, you can swipe your finger to change the viewpoint and angle of the blocks. Moreover, use 2 fingers to zoom in or zoom out, so that you can see the blocks more clearly.
FEATURES
- Relaxing and soothing background music and sound effects, promising to bring your stress away
- Many different block skins, with unique designs
- Including different effects that will please your eyes
What are you waiting for? Tap it 3D: Tap block out is a perfect game to leverage your brain!

bluejetty:00136171:ios.name: Île-de-France Mobilités
bluejetty:00136171:ios.summary: Île-de-France Mobilités is here to assist you daily. Purchase a digital ticket, recharge your Navigo pass, search for routes including trains, RERs, metros, trams, buses, coaches, bicycles, Vélib', car-sharing, or car rentals. Find schedule
bluejetty:00136171:ios.description:
Île-de-France Mobilités is here to assist you daily. Purchase a digital ticket, recharge your Navigo pass, search for routes including trains, RERs, metros, trams, buses, coaches, bicycles, Vélib', car-sharing, or car rentals. Find schedules in real-time or traffic information... Discover essential tools and information for organizing your travels in Île-de-France. Together, let's travel with ease.
Avoid queues at stations: buy your transport tickets from your iPhone!
The following tickets are available for purchase:
- Metro-Train tickets or Bus-Tram Ticket
- One Way from/to Airports (you cannot purchase this ticket if you already have a Metro-Train Ticket charged on your device)
- Navigo daily (this fare doesn’t permit you to go to airports), weekly, or monthly passes
- Special fares (Anti-pollution pass, Paris-Visit Passes etc.)
- Daily Vélib’ passes
Purchased tickets can then be (depending on the chosen purchasing path):
- Stored on the iPhone and validated directly at stations (from iPhone Xr and iOS 17.5)
- Loaded onto your Navigo pass (from an iPhone 7, with at least iOS 13. iPhone XR and XS are compatible starting from iOS 14.5)
For compatible tickets (Metro-Train and Bus-Tram Tickets, Navigo Day passes, special fares), no account is needed, and you can pay directly with Apple Pay!
You can prepare and plan your travels:
- Find nearby bus stops, train stations, and metro stations
- Search for real-time public transport routes, car-sharing, and bicycle routes
- Save upcoming trips in your phone’s calendar
- Check the next departures for your lines in real-time and all the timetable information
- View maps of public transport networks (accessible even offline)
- Follow pedestrian routes for walking segment
Stay informed and anticipate disruptions:
- Check your lines’ Twitter feed for real-time traffic updates
- Get alerts for disruptions on your favorite lines and routes
- Stay updated on the status of elevators in the stations you use
Customize your travel:
- Save your destinations (work, home, gym, etc.), stations, and stops as favorites
- Customize your profile (fast walker, with difficulties, reduced mobility, etc.)
- Select lines or stations to avoid
Prefer soft or alternative modes of transport:
- Book car-sharing and/or ride-sharing trips in partnership with leading providers
- Opt for bicycle routes for all your trips
- Rent a car or a van for a short period by choosing a Communauto car-sharing vehicle from a wide selection of stations around you and book it immediately for the duration of your choice.
--
Already using the Île-de-France Mobilités app and enjoying its services? Let us know with a 5-star rating!
Experiencing bugs or having feedback to give? Help us improve by sending your suggestions through the contact form available via the personal space.

bluejetty:00153177:ios.description:
Match and Organize in the Sweetest Kitchen Challenge!
Welcome to Kitchen Match, the satisfying and relaxing food matching game where your goal is simple: match 3 pairs, and serve up complete plates! With each tap, you’ll enjoy a soothing mix of strategy and creativity that turns everyday cooking chaos into pure puzzle bliss.
HOW TO PLAY
Drag and drop delicious foods and goods onto the plates. Group them into triples – that’s 3 of the same item – to complete the order. Sounds easy? Think again! As the shelves fill up and the grocery piles grow, your matching skills will be put to the test.
FEATURES
• Addictive match 3 style mechanics with a twist
• Satisfying matching game action with a cozy kitchen vibe
• Organize everything from desserts to grocery goods
• Hundreds of levels to challenge your brain
• A relaxing free game to unwind with
• Play offline anytime – no Wi-Fi needed
• Easy to learn, hard to master!
Whether you’re a cooking games fan or just love a good matching challenge, Kitchen Match is your new go-to free puzzle game. Designed for food lovers, puzzle fans, and everyone who enjoys matching, organizing, and keeping things tidy.
Ready to serve up some fun?
Download Kitchen Match now and see how well you can match, pair, and enjoy this relaxing puzzle experience.

SayWave is the fastest way to speak and be heard. Type anything and hear it in stunning, natural Apple voices. Or tap the mic and watch y
bluejetty:00080019:ios.description:
Turn text into natural speech — and speech into text. Instantly, privately, everywhere. Even offline.
SayWave is the fastest way to speak and be heard. Type anything and hear it in stunning, natural Apple voices. Or tap the mic and watch your words appear as you talk — transcribed entirely on your device.
TEXT TO SPEECH
• Every Apple voice, every language and accent — including Premium and Enhanced voices
• Follow along as each word is highlighted while it's spoken
• Continuous Reading: one message flows into the next, hands-free
• Reading speed from 0.5x to 3x — you set the pace
• Tap any message to hear it again, anytime
SPEECH TO TEXT
• Unlimited on-device transcription — fast, accurate, and private
• Automatic end-of-speech detection: just stop talking, and your words become text
• Dictate in dozens of languages
READ ANYTHING
• Import PDFs — every page becomes its own tappable message
• Point your camera at any text, or pick a photo — instant text recognition
• Share PDFs from WhatsApp, Mail, or Files straight into SayWave with "Open in SayWave"
YOUR LIBRARY
• Every text is saved in Topics — pin favorites and keep everything organized
• Search your whole Library and jump straight to the right text
• Recent Texts widget for your Home Screen
• The page follows the spoken word, with optional Sentence Pauses
• Polish your text with Apple Intelligence Writing Tools
SHARE AS AUDIO
• Export anything you write as MP3, M4A, WAV, AIFF, or FLAC
• Files named by date and time — ready to send anywhere
EVERYWHERE YOU ARE
• iMessage app: dictate and insert text right in your chats
• Apple Watch: speak from your wrist
• Home Screen quick actions and Siri shortcuts for instant dictation
• Designed for iPhone and iPad
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Works completely offline — no internet connection required
• No data collection. Ever. Your voice never leaves your device.
BUILT FOR EVERYONE
• Full VoiceOver support, Dynamic Type, Reduce Motion, and more
• Localized in 29 languages
• Free Family Sharing included
Works on iPhone and iPad with iOS 17 and later.
Download SayWave and give your words a voice.
Terms of use : https://iapps.app/Terms
Privacy-policy: https://iapps.app/Privacy

Freak out in the lab, let your imagination run riot, merge the DNA of different animals and create the ultimate mutant runner, then test your experiments by letting them loose on a varied range of obstacle courses to race against other multi-limbed freaks of nature in the ultimate competition in evolution where only the fittest will survive. 
A fun running game with a freaky difference, Merge Animals 3D combines strategy, lateral thinking and crazy science to fire your imagination and get your adrenalin pumping. Demonstrate your evil gene-ius, perfect every pixel of your runner, and put them on the track to evolutionary success.
► WIN THE MUTANT RACE
• Survival of the fittest – over 20 different levels with hugely varied obstacle courses, different aspects of which favor different advantages in evolution. Mod your mutant runner carefully in the lab, and if you don’t win first time, try merging other genetic variations to produce the right combination for the course. Keep on experimenting!
• Lucky rabbit’s feet – inject your runner with the DNA of over 10 different animals to create hundreds of genetic variations, each with their own unique genetic advantages that will help overcome a specific element of the obstacle course. Give your athlete the wings of an eagle to soar above the competition, the arms of a spider to scramble over rough surfaces, a giraffe’s neck to stretch across the finish line, and a pair of rabbit’s feet just for luck.
• Designer DNA – colorful graphics and cool character design merge with imaginative obstacles and eye-catching animation to make the world of Merge Animals 3D a beautiful game right down to the last pixel, as well as fun and vibrant place to spend your time as you play at mad scientist in style.
► MIX THE ULTIMATE GENETIC COCKTAIL
What do advances in gene science mean for the future of the human race? In this crazy casual game, the chance to make some freaking awesome changes to the human body with just a few jabs of a needle. 
Take advantage of these amazing advances in bio-engineering, download the game now, and merge animal genes to create the ultimate mutant athlete in this highly original running game that combines fast-paced races with strategic puzzle play as you combine the features of different animals in the lab to produce the best runner for each individual obstacle course. Live out your mad scientist dreams and create the wildest genetic experiments in this fun, fast and freaky running game. The evolutionary race is on!

Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00145955:ios.description:
Dinero Rápido te permite pagar desde tu celular de la forma más fácil y cómoda. Realiza pagos móviles al instante desde tus cuentas en bolívares o divisas y disfruta de todos sus beneficios.
Como persona natural puedes:
Realizar pagos, consultas y el cambio de tu cuenta predeterminada desde la posición global con el nuevo menú de operaciones.
Pagar a clientes de BBVA Provincial y de otros bancos escaneando el código QR del beneficiario.
Generar tu código QR con tus datos de pago móvil desde la posición global de la cuenta para recibir pagos al instante.
Autorizar pagos mediante la "clave de compra" solicitada por el comercio (C2P).
Compartir el comprobante digital con el beneficiario al finalizar cada transacción.
Como cliente jurídico puedes:
Gestionar cobros y consultar tus balances de cobro y ventas desde la posición global con el nuevo menú de operaciones.
Generar y compartir tu código QR con tus clientes para recibir pagos al instante.
Consultar las ventas por usuario (exclusivo para perfiles de supervisor y administrador).
Configurar claves y seleccionar la cuenta asociada al servicio (exclusivo para perfiles de administrador).
Requisitos:
Tener un dispositivo compatible con iOS igual o posterior a 12.0
Afiliarse al servicio de pago móvil a través de la App, Provinet web Personas o Provinet Empresas móvil.
Tener conexión a Internet.

bluejetty:00044786:ios.description:
Pay for Zona Azul street parking in Brazil with Digipare. Buy credits, activate a parking session and keep track of your parking time in supported cities.
Known locally as Zona Azul, Área Azul or Rotativo Digital, these are designated paid street parking areas with rules that vary by city.
PARKING MADE SIMPLER
• Buy credits using the payment methods available in the app.
• Select the city, vehicle license plate and parking rate to activate a session.
• Set reminders for when your parking time is about to end.
• Check your balance and usage history.
• Extend your session from your phone where the parking scheme and local rules allow.
HOW TO USE DIGIPARE
1. Create an account and add your vehicle's license plate.
2. Select your city and check the parking signs.
3. Buy the credits you need and select the appropriate parking rate.
4. Confirm activation and check when your session expires.
WHERE YOU CAN USE IT
Digipare is one of the accredited apps for Rotativo Digital in Belo Horizonte, Minas Gerais, and a payment option for Área Azul in Porto Alegre, Rio Grande do Sul.
In Cuiabá, Mato Grosso, use Digipare to pay for street parking under the Cidade Verde Estacionamento Rotativo Digital system.
Other partner cities are also supported. Check that your city is available in the app before parking. See the list at www.digipare.com.br/Home/Cidades.
BEFORE YOU PARK
Check the city, license plate, rate and activation confirmation. Follow the parking signs, operating hours and maximum stay. Buying credits does not activate a parking session: confirm activation for the correct vehicle. Keep notifications enabled and check the session's validity in the app.
Available in English, Spanish and Portuguese. Parking is available only in supported locations in Brazil.
Download Digipare to make paying for street parking easier.
Support: contato@digipare.com.br
Learn more: www.digipare.com.br

bluejetty:00044420:ios.summary:

Share your trip with your safety circle s
bluejetty:00044420:ios.description:
Stay safe — and make sure someone knows if you’re overdue.
Use offline maps and GPS to follow your route. See where you’ll have cell coverage and check distance, elevation, and your ETA as you go.
Share your trip with your safety circle so they can follow along on a live map. If you’re overdue, they’re alerted automatically.
Named one of the three best map apps for navigating the wilderness by Outside Magazine.
GET FOUND IF YOU’RE OVERDUE
• Automatic alerts: Your safety circle is notified if you’re overdue
• Live map: Your safety circle can follow your trip and see your location history
• Smart guidance: Your safety circle receives advice on when and how to respond if you’re overdue
STAY ON TRACK
• Offline maps: Download maps ahead of time so you can navigate without service
• GPS tracking: Record your route and see where you’ve been
• Cell coverage maps: See where you’re likely to have signal on the trail
SEE TRAIL STATS & ETA
• Trail stats: Track distance, elevation, and ETA in real time, customized for your activity type and speed—hiking, running, skiing, horseback riding, snow travel, mountain biking, and more
• Make better decisions: Know how far you have left and how long it will take
SHARE YOUR TRIP
• Choose who to share with—no app required for them
• Send a live map link so others can follow your progress
CAIRN IS
+ Simple: Set up a trip in under a minute
+ Flexible: Works for hiking, backpacking, trail running, horseback riding, skiing, cycling, climbing, camping, hunting, fishing, boating, and more
+ Customizable: Control how often location is recorded to balance accuracy and battery
FREE TRIAL
Maps, trails, and cell coverage data are always free. Start a 7-day free trial to unlock all safety features.
SUBSCRIPTION
Subscribing to Cairn Premium helps support the app and our continued efforts to improve outdoor safety. Subscribers also get full access to features that help you stay safer on the trail.
• Subscriptions automatically renew unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
• Your iTunes account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and will identify the renewal cost.
• Payment is charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase
• Terms: https://www.cairnme.com/terms
• Manage subscriptions: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
Need support?
Email us at adventure@cairnme.com

bluejetty:00034859:ios.description:
Get the latest Montana lottery results within minutes of the draws taking place. This easy-to-use app includes the following lotteries:
- Powerball (including Double Play)
- Mega Millions
- Millionaire for Life
- Lotto America
- Montana Cash
- Montana Big Sky Bonus
Powerball, Mega Millions, Millionaire for Life, Lotto America, Montana Cash and Montana Big Sky Bonus also include a full breakdown displaying the number of winners and amount paid out for each prize level.
The following features are also included:
Ticket Checker
----------------------------
Enter and save your chosen numbers to see if you have won or to see how often they have come up in the past. You can also label your tickets – great if you play multiple lines or if you run a syndicate. The ticket checker also highlights prizes won on each ticket as well as calculating the total for each lottery. Only play lotteries on certain days of the week? Not a problem, you can exclude your checked tickets from draws you do not play.
Customizable Notifications
----------------------------
Get notified instantly when the latest lottery results and prize breakdowns become available. The App allows you to customise notifications for specific lottery games and you can also choose which days of the week you play. Want to know when the jackpot has rolled over or has reached a certain amount? Just head to the Notification section of the app to set up your alerts. There is also the option to set notifications at times that suit you - great for reminding you to purchase tickets before the draw.
Random Number Generator
-----------------------------
Stuck for numbers? Use this handy tool and let the app choose your numbers rather than having to rely on house numbers and anniversary dates!
Results Archive
----------------------------
Access to the full archive of results dating back to the first draw of each lottery.
Settings
----------------------------
Customise which lotteries display in the app and in which order.
Support
----------------------------
If you have any feedback or suggestions on how we can improve this app, please get in touch at contact@lottery.net.

bluejetty:00019509:ios.name: Toobz
bluejetty:00019509:ios.summary:
Toobz is a challenging, fast-paced game that brings together quick reactions, planning, and a little bit of luck.
Your goal is to create a system of "Toobz" (pipes) beginning at a randomly-placed starting point. Your Toobz network must al
bluejetty:00019509:ios.description:
Toobz is a challenging, fast-paced game that brings together quick reactions, planning, and a little bit of luck.
Your goal is to create a system of "Toobz" (pipes) beginning at a randomly-placed starting point. Your Toobz network must allow water to flow without any spilling. As you advance through levels, you'll have less and less time to place the pieces before the water starts automatically. You can start the water at any time, allowing you to quickly advance to the next level and earn extra points. If you spill any water, though, your game is over and you'll have to try again.
Toobz features three game modes: "Classic Toobz" in which only one upcoming piece is displayed, "Show Toobz" game in which the next four pieces are displayed, and the new "Puzzle" game that starts you out with a full board. Along with each game mode is a "Big Board" option which increases the size of the playing area by more than 2x!
Multiple color themes are available, including a setting to match your system Dark Mode preference.

bluejetty:00044859:ios.summary:
juli can help you to take control of your condition: all your health data together to manage your depression, bipolar disorder, COPD or something else.
Having a chronic condition like COPD, depression or bipolar disorder means constantly w
bluejetty:00044859:ios.description:
juli can help you to take control of your condition: all your health data together to manage your depression, bipolar disorder, COPD or something else.
Having a chronic condition like COPD, depression or bipolar disorder means constantly worrying about getting into an episode again. There are plenty of triggers for that and often it is not clear, whether it is your sleep, your activity/workout or the weather that drives your wellbeing. Your physician probably told you to keep a journal but monitoring all that is more work that anyone would want to invest. 
Actually there is no need to: your smartphone, your apple watch, your step counter, or any other smartwatch, they all do this work for you. juli combines all this data to give you the relevant health information at your fingertips: from monitoring your activity, heart rate or sleep, adding external data like sunshine, pollen or air pollution. juli will also ask you daily a few quick questions about your condition related wellbeing. Questions like:
(For COPD) Did you have to use your inhaler yesterday or did you wake up due to an episode of shortness of breath?
(For depression) How are you today, how is your energy level 
All this data will allow you to find patterns and identify triggers that influence your COPD or depression. juli is the first start into a new you. 
juli’s functions in detail: 
TRACK YOUR WELLBEING: 
Gather health data collected on your smartphone or smartwatch: sleep, activity, workouts, heart rate, cycle, O2 saturation, period and much more
Get real time weather forecast, pollen and air pollution precisely for where your are
Track your daily situation: COPD episodes, mood, energy, medication intake - quick and easily with one touch
DISCOVER TRIGGERS
Visualize your situation on a daily basis, see trends and discover correlations between your wellbeing and other factors.
Take control of your health situation by identifying triggers for your COPD attacks or discovering what helps when you have a depressive episode.
GET REMINDERS
juli makes it easier to remember to take your medicine or use your inhaler, so you can worry less and live healthier. You can keep track of your medication intake and see what impact it has on your wellbeing as a person with COPD, depression or bipolar.
KEEP A JOURNAL
Have a full medical record at your fingertips and add to it personal notes about what is noteworthy. 
The juli founders suffer from various conditions like bipolar disorder themselves. They know exactly, how it is to be at the mercy of your COPD or depression. But they are electronic wizards and thought how to make use of Apple Health, weather data and more for their purpose. They came up with the idea of a health tracker or journal that minimizes the effort to monitor data related to COPD or depression and has a reminder functionality for medication. More chronic conditions are soon to come as well as recommendations and goal setting.
juli is all about you being the manager of your condition. You will find out how much exercise is good for your COPD, whether sunlight will help your depression or how much sleep is a warning signal for your bipolar disorder. Control is about finding out, what has an impact. With juli all your health data is conveniently kept in one place for you to find out. 
juli integrates with the Apple HealthKit API
Our Terms of Service: https://www.juli.co/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00128451:ios.description:
► CUSTOMIZE CARS IN YOUR OWN BODY SHOP
Have you ever dreamed of becoming a mechanic? Do you love watching shows about car restoration and repairs? Then it’s time for you to take a more active role and tune up vehicles in your very own professional garage in the Car Master 3D mechanic game!
Customers come to your auto body shop for you to pimp their rides! You offer a full range of services at your garage: car fixing, washing, tuning, painting, and much more. Help your customers and collect cash to upgrade your workspace, buy better tools, and unlock unique new personalization options.
► A FULL-SCALE CAR REPAIR GAME 
In your car restoration studio, you can make old rusty buckets of bolts sparkle and shine like they’re brand new! This challenging car fixing game allows you to give every vehicle a complete renovation. Time to rev your creative engine!
Mend fender benders for big spenders and repair dents and damage for unlucky customers who have totaled their cars. Inflate tires and pick out new wheels from different shapes and sizes. Decide if your customer is the go-big-or-go-home type, or if they would prefer a lowrider.
Wash and polish vehicles of all kinds. Customize cars with your choice of paint colors , fun stickers, awesome decals, cool logos, and a variety of spoilers. Replace broken windshields and windows with sleek tinted glass — you even get to choose the color! 
► GAME FEATURES
• Work as a mechanic at your own automotive shop in this addictive and free car maker game.
• Every car that pulls into your garage requires a unique service package based on the customer’s needs. Upgrade flashy sports cars, police vehicles, ambulances, food trucks, taxis, and more! Make sure your customers drive away happy.
• Turn a profit to become a true car master. Earn cash and score prizes to upgrade your auto bay, improve your equipment, and replenish your inventory! Go the extra mile for RARE parts, wheels, and designs.
• Acquire the skills to pay the bills. When you level up, your repair abilities will increase as well.
• Fun and satisfying gameplay that keeps you engaged and helps you unwind.
• Special levels with VIP cars for your high-rolling customers.
• Eye-popping and colorful 3D graphics.
Use the optional vibration setting to customize your gameplay experience the same way you customize cars!
Do you have what it takes to be a master? Fasten your seatbelt and take this car maker game for a spin! 
► Download Car Master 3D today and go on a joy ride to your own personal garage simulator and car customization station!
Privacy Policy: https://say.games/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

Speed Rush Moto is a fresh, fast-paced motorcycle racing experience built on a brand-new idea—crafted for players who crave speed, precision, and pure adrenaline. Race through intense tracks, outsmart rival riders, and push your limits as you chase victory in every high-speed challenge.
Feel the rush as you lean into tight corners, unleash powerful boosts on straight lines, and react instantly to dynamic obstacles. Each race tests your reflexes and rewards your skill with currency you can use to enhance your motorcycle or increase race earnings. Build and tune your bike exactly the way you want—focusing on acceleration, handling, or max speed.
Every level introduces new layouts, environments, and opponents with unique riding behaviors, keeping the action exciting and unpredictable. Whether you're a casual player or a racing enthusiast, Speed Rush Moto delivers fast, satisfying gameplay that feels great on mobile devices.
Designed with a renewed vision and a modern approach to arcade racing, this game brings a fresh twist to the genre—perfect for quick sessions and long playthroughs alike.
Features:
 • High-speed motorcycle racing with smooth, responsive controls
 • Fresh design built around a new gameplay vision
 • Challenging tracks with varied environments and layouts
 • Dynamic opponents with distinctive riding styles
 • Deep upgrade system: enhance your bike’s stats or boost your earnings
 • Satisfying progression that rewards precision and smart tuning
 • Optimized performance for all mobile devices
 • Addictive gameplay ideal for short and long sessions
Get ready to launch into the rush—Speed Rush Moto brings a brand-new racing experience to your device. Can you master the speed and dominate every track?

bluejetty:00075985:ios.summary:
Filmic Legacy is available only to filmmakers who paid for Filmic Pro v6 before the 25th of August, 2022. It will continue to receive bug fixes but will not receive any new features.
Filmic Legacy (previously FiLMiC Pro v6) features cuttin
bluejetty:00075985:ios.description:
Filmic Legacy is available only to filmmakers who paid for Filmic Pro v6 before the 25th of August, 2022. It will continue to receive bug fixes but will not receive any new features.
Filmic Legacy (previously FiLMiC Pro v6) features cutting-edge capabilities and a responsive manual filming experience.
A multi-time iOS Video Camera App of the Year, Filmic Pro has been used in more high profile video projects by award winning directors than any other app:
Unsane & High Flying Bird - Steven Soderbergh
Tangerine - Sean Baker
Lose You to Love Me - Selena Gomez
Stupid Love - Lady Gaga
Detour - Michel Gondry
Snow Steam Iron - Zack Snyder
Filmic Pro provides filmmakers, newscasters, teachers, vloggers, and artists with the capability to shoot in a true LOG gamma curve. LOG V2/V3/V3* allows for greater tonal range and flexibility in post production by expanding dynamic range and setting the iPhone’s capabilities on par with traditional camera systems costing thousands more.
Filmic Pro also offers a range of cinematic film looks that can be applied in-camera at time of capture to deliver a truly cinematic aesthetic without the need for timely grading in post.*
Note: Multicam support is not included in Filmic Pro but is available in our companion app: DoubleTake.
v6 Banner Features:
• Dual arc slider controls for manual focus and exposure
• Live analytics suite of Zebras, False Color and Focus Peaking (limited to 30fps at 4k and 60fps at 1080p)
• Dolby Vision HDR support (limited to 4K 30fps. Incompatible with CineKit)
• ProRes support on 13/14 series
• Realtime film looks (8-bit/DolbyVision)*
• Frame.io Camera to Cloud integration on iPhone 11 & newer
• 10-bit SDR support for 12 series & newer*
• Clean HDMI Out for monitoring & webcam use
• Ramped zoom rocker
• Waveform monitor including tri-mode histogram
• Manual white balance adjustment & custom presets
• Content Management (CMS) for file naming
• FiLMiC Sync account to store presets in the cloud and share between devices
• Gamma curve controls for Natural, Dynamic, Flat and LOGv2/V3/V3+*
• Shadow and highlight controls
• RGB, saturation and vibrance controls
Foundation Features:
• Standard, manual and hybrid shooting modes. A shooting style for any skill level.
• Apple Watch support for remote start/stop + video preview
• Vertical and landscape support
• Variable speed zoom
• Sync audio frame rates of 24, 25, 30, 48, 50 and 60 fps
• High speed frame rates of 60,120, 240 fps (hardware dependent)
• Slow and fast motion FX
• Time lapse capture
• Tri-mode histogram, including waveform
• Downsampling to lower resolutions
• Saved shooting presets
• Framing guide overlays
• Image stabilization
• Support for Filmic Remote. Remote allows you to control an iOS device running Filmic Pro with a second device running Filmic Remote.
Full manual controls with pull capabilities for:
• Exposure: ISO and shutter speed
• Manual focus
• Zoom
8 aspect ratios including:
• Widescreen (16:9)
• Super 35 (2.39:1)
• Ultra Panavision (2.76:1)
• Square (1:1)
Share your video through any iOS share-capable apps like: Facebook, DropBox, FTP.
4 encoding options to balance quality and file size:
• Filmic Extreme (~150Mbps encoding at 4K on latest gen devices)
• Filmic Quality

listings.name: Filmic Legacy
listings.description:
Filmic Legacy is available only to filmmakers who paid for Filmic Pro v6 before the 25th of August, 2022. It will continue to receive bug fixes but will not receive any new features.

Filmic Legacy (previously FiLMiC Pro v6) features cutting-edge capabilities and a responsive manual filming experience.
 
A multi-time iOS Video Camera App of the Year, Filmic Pro has been used in more high profile video projects by award winning directors than any other app:
 
Unsane & High Flying Bird - Steven Soderbergh
Tangerine - Sean Baker
Lose You to Love Me - Selena Gomez
Stupid Love - Lady Gaga
Detour - Michel Gondry
Snow Steam Iron - Zack Snyder
 
Filmic Pro provides filmmakers, newscasters, teachers, vloggers, and artists with the capability to shoot in a true LOG gamma curve. LOG V2/V3/V3* allows for greater tonal range and flexibility in post production by expanding dynamic range and setting the iPhone’s capabilities on par with traditional camera systems costing thousands more.
 
Filmic Pro also offers a range of cinematic film looks that can be applied in-camera at time of capture to deliver a truly cinematic aesthetic without the need for timely grading in post.*
 
Note: Multicam support is not included in Filmic Pro but is available in our companion app: DoubleTake.
 
v6 Banner Features:
 
• Dual arc slider controls for manual focus and exposure
• Live analytics suite of Zebras, False Color and Focus Peaking (limited to 30fps at 4k and 60fps at 1080p)
• Dolby Vision HDR support (limited to 4K 30fps. Incompatible with CineKit)
• ProRes support on 13/14 series
• Realtime film looks (8-bit/DolbyVision)*
• Frame.io Camera to Cloud integration on iPhone 11 & newer
• 10-bit SDR support for 12 series & newer*
• Clean HDMI Out for monitoring & webcam use
• Ramped zoom rocker
• Waveform monitor including tri-mode histogram
• Manual white balance adjustment & custom presets
• Content Management (CMS) for file naming
• FiLMiC Sync account to store presets in the cloud and share between devices
• Gamma curve controls for Natural, Dynamic, Flat and LOGv2/V3/V3+*
• Shadow and highlight controls
• RGB, saturation and vibrance controls
 
Foundation Features:
• Standard, manual and hybrid shooting modes. A shooting style for any skill level.
• Apple Watch support for remote start/stop + video preview
• Vertical and landscape support
• Variable speed zoom
• Sync audio frame rates of 24, 25, 30, 48, 50 and 60 fps
• High speed frame rates of 60,120, 240 fps (hardware dependent)
• Slow and fast motion FX
• Time lapse capture
• Tri-mode histogram, including waveform
• Downsampling to lower resolutions
• Saved shooting presets
• Framing guide overlays
• Image stabilization
• Support for Filmic Remote. Remote allows you to control an iOS device running Filmic Pro with a second device running Filmic Remote.
 
Full manual controls with pull capabilities for:
• Exposure: ISO and shutter speed
• Manual focus
• Zoom
 
8 aspect ratios including:
• Widescreen (16:9)
• Super 35 (2.39:1)
• Ultra Panavision (2.76:1)
• Square (1:1)
 
Share your video through any iOS share-capable apps like: Facebook, DropBox, FTP.
 
4 encoding options to balance quality and file size:
• Filmic Extreme (~150Mbps encoding at 4K on latest gen devices)
• Filmic Quality
• Apple Standard
• Economy
 
3rd Party Hardware Support:
• 1.33x and 1.55x anamorphic desqueeze
• 35mm lens adapters
• Horizontal flip
 
Supported Gimbals:
• Zhiyun Smooth 4/5
• DJI OSMO Mobile 1/2/3/4/5
 
Advanced Audio Features:
• Pro audio formats: PCM, AIFF, AAC
• 44.1 & 48kHz
• Headphone monitoring
• Pro audio meter
• Manual input gain
• External microphone level control
 
*Note: Not all features available on older devices and resolution and frame rate restrictions may apply.*

bluejetty:00170573:ios.description:
Companion App for the PhotoShare Smart Frames
Simply select your favorite photos & videos, select one or more PhotoShare Frames, and Send - your memories will arrive instantly, ready to be enjoyed by family & friends!
- Add and Manage your network of PhotoShare Frames - both yours and others!
- Easily Send Images & Videos to one or multiple frames
- Personalize photos with Captions
- Crop Photos for the Perfect Fit
- Enhance photos with Filters
- Add fun Stickers or Borders
All Edits (Crop, Enhance, Effect, Captions, etc) do NOT modify your original photo - only the photo sent to the target PhotoShare Frame is modified.
As a PhotoShare Owner, the app gets even better:
- Remotely Approve or Deny guest requests to add your PhotoShare Frame
- Manage your Frame Remotely: Settings and even Images/Videos you can manage from anywhere
- Enhance, Edit, or Delete Photos & Videos already on your Frame
- Send "Frame to Frame" easily, from one of your PhotoShare Frames to another without needing the image on your phone/tablet
- Flip on Smart Auto Effects which automatically add effects and borders that change based on the season, holidays, or even birthdays of your choosing - the only Smart Frame that literally celebrates with you year-round.
- Manage Volume, Auto On/Off, and all other Frame Settings from the App
All under our proprietary PhotoShare Shield ecosytem, truly unique built in Silicon Valley with a foundation for Privacy & Security.
Note - Some listed features are only available on PhotoShare Frames produced from 2021, these became our current and always latest generation moving forward. Your Frame will receive updates and feature drops, constantly improving, for as long as you have the frame. 
Feedback? We really listen and want to hear from you, our development is driven by your requests so don't hesitate to reach out to our Support.

bluejetty:00159323:ios.description: Introducing StaffNow by LGC – your ultimate answer to streamlined staffing management. Backed by LGC Staffing, the leading name in staffing solutions, StaffNow transforms how clients request services and how employees secure shifts, making the process effortless and highly effective. At LGC, we understand the importance of flexibility and choice. That's why we empower our clients and candidates with the freedom to choose how they work with us. With StaffNow, you can embrace cutting-edge technology for seamless staffing processes or opt for time-honored staffing methods – the choice is yours. Because at LGC, we believe in providing you with the flexibility you need to do what's best for you. For Clients: Are you in need of reliable and skilled staff for your business? Look no further than StaffNow. Our app simplifies the entire staffing process, allowing you to place orders for temporary staff members quickly and conveniently. Whether you need extra hands for a special event, a busy weekend, or unexpected staff shortages, StaffNow has you covered. With our user-friendly interface, you can submit orders, specify requirements, and manage your staffing needs seamlessly. Even though you can do everything through this app, LGC is always one call away. Our dedicated staffing team is ready to assist you and provide personalized support whenever you need it. For Employees: Are you seeking flexible work opportunities as a hospitality professional, or are you aiming to kickstart your career in the industry? StaffNow provides you with the freedom to select shifts that align with your schedule. Browse through available shifts, choose the ones that interest you, and confirm your availability – it's that simple. StaffNow connects you with exciting job opportunities at top establishments. Say goodbye to lengthy job searches and hello to hassle-free shift bookings with StaffNow. Key Features: -Easy Order Placement: Clients can place orders for temporary staff members with just a few taps, specifying job requirements and preferences. -Shift Selection: Employees can browse through available shifts, view details, and pick the ones that match their skills and availability. -Real-time Notifications: Stay informed with instant notifications about new job orders, available shifts, and shift confirmations. - Rating and Feedback: Rate your experience after each shift and provide valuable feedback to ensure continuous improvement and satisfaction. Join thousands of satisfied clients and employees who rely on StaffNow by LGC for their staffing needs. Download the app now and experience the future of hospitality staffing management!
